title: The Forsaken Imperial Concubine? This Concubine Can Read Minds!
author: Snail MM
synopsis: Shen Qinghuan was originally the Emperor's favored concubine, but she was framed by the Empress and falsely accused of using witchcraft to curse the imperial heir. Enraged, the Emperor cast her into the Cold Palace. In her despair, she awakened the ability to read minds. The Empress, however, is determined to root out the problem at the source...

chapters.title: Wronged and Cast into the Cold Palace, Utterly Humiliated
chapters.content:
In the seventeenth year of Daqi, summer, the blazing sun was scorching, yet it still fell short of the blistering atmosphere within the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

Shen Qinghuan knelt upon the icy golden bricks, trembling all over, her forehead pressed hard against the ground. Her dark hair was disheveled, and sweat and tears mixed with dirt, blurring her vision. In her ears rang sharp and piercing reproaches, every word like a blade, carving into her very heart.

"Shen Qinghuan! You poisonous woman! I have treated you well, yet you dared to practice witchcraft and curse my imperial heir! Do you know your crime?!"

The Emperor's voice was like thunder from the nine heavens, carrying unprecedented fury and disappointment. He sat high upon the dragon throne, draped in the imperial robe, his face distorted. Those eyes that were once full of doting now held only bone-chilling coldness and murderous intent.

Shen Qinghuan wanted to defend herself, but her throat felt as though it were blocked, unable to produce the slightest sound. She opened her mouth, but only desperate sobs came out. Her crime was using witchcraft to curse the imperial heir, in the imperial palace, this was an unforgivable capital crime that could implicate nine generations of her family! And this crime was the "irrefutable proof" personally presented by her mortal enemy, the reigning Empress.

Those "irrefutable proofs," little cloth dolls embroidered with the prince's birth characters, their hearts pierced full of silver needles, buried deep within the flower beds of her Brocade Embroidered Palace. And those "forbidden talismans" dug up, their handwriting distorted and brushstrokes bizarre, every stroke appearing drenched in malice.

She knew this was all a frame-up. She, Shen Qinghuan, had never disdained such evil methods. Yet these "evidences" were so conclusive that no matter how she tried, she could not clear her name.

In the hall, civil and military officials held their breath, none daring to speak on her behalf. Their past flattery and sycophancy had now turned into chilling detachment. In their eyes, there was gloating, there was sadness for a fellow creature, but not a shred of sympathy.

"Your Majesty, this concubine long ago said that Consort Shen's mind is crooked. Now it seems, it is indeed true!"

A soft yet bone-deep hateful voice came forth; it was the Empress. She draped a magnificent phoenix robe, sitting poised beside the Emperor, noble and icy. At this moment, she turned slightly, her vermilion lips parted, every single word sounding like a victor's declaration: "How can such a venomous woman be allowed to stay in the palace and pollute the sacred ears? I beg Your Majesty to punish her according to national law!"

Shen Qinghuan's heart constricted violently. The Empress, she had never imagined that she would hate her this much. Was it because of her overwhelming favor? Or because she stood in her way?

"Shen Qinghuan!" The Emperor's voice sounded once more, carrying an irreversible majesty. "Considering your noble birth and past contributions to the state, I originally intended to leave you with some dignity. But you have become so crazed! Today, I sentence you..."

He paused, every word seeming squeezed from between his teeth, carrying monstrous fury: "To be stripped of your imperial rank and reduced to a commoner! Cast into the Cold Palace, never to step foot outside for all eternity!"

"Boom..."

It was as if a thunderclap exploded in Shen Qinghuan's mind. Reduced to a commoner! Cast into the Cold Palace! Never to step foot outside for all eternity!

This meant she would plummet from the clouds into the mire, sinking from a once-favored concubine into a prisoner enduring a fate worse than death. Her father and brothers were still bleeding on the battlefield, sacrificing everything for the rivers and mountains of Daqi, yet she was to suffer such monstrous humiliation!

No! She was not resigned!

Shen Qinghuan abruptly raised her head. Beneath her scattered hair, her tear-filled eyes stared fixedly at the man on the dragon throne.

"Your Majesty! This concubine is wronged! This concubine has never practiced witchcraft! This concubine is utterly loyal to Your Majesty and holds no second thoughts!" Her voice was hoarse, laced with blood, yet no one paid her heed.

The Emperor coldly averted his gaze, as if looking at her one more time would pollute his eyes.

"Men! Drag this venomous woman away!" he commanded sternly.

Before the words fell, two burly imperial guards charged forward roughly. One grabbed Shen Qinghuan's arm while the other pulled her leg, dragging her down the white marble steps of the Hall of Supreme Harmony like a dead dog.

"Stop! Let go of me! I am Shen Qinghuan! I am Shen Qinghuan!" she screamed and struggled, but it was in vain. The golden bricks scraped her cheeks, the rough ground lacerating her skin, and blood slid down her temples, dripping onto the pristine floor in a startling manner.

In the corridor outside the hall, the concubines had been waiting for a long time. They gathered in groups of threes and fives, whispering among themselves, their eyes unable to hide their unconcealed triumph and gloating.

When Shen Qinghuan was dragged before them, the whispering concubines instantly quieted down, all gazes wrapping around her like venomous snakes.

"Oh my, isn't this Consort Shen? Look at this state, truly... how utterly wretched."

A giggle laced with schadenfreude rang out. Shen Qinghuan turned her head with difficulty, meeting the glamorous yet vicious face of Consort Li. Consort Li was the Empress's confidante and had always been at odds with her.

"Consort Li, you are too audacious!" Shen Qinghuan rebuked hoarsely in anger.

Consort Li acted as if she had heard a grand joke, stepping closer and looking down at her from above with a sneering arc to her lips: "Audacious? You, a mere abandoned person, are worthy of pointing fingers at me? Do you still think you are the high-and-mighty Consort Shen?"

She raised her hand, her bright red fingernails slicing an afterimage through the air.

"Slap!"

A crisp sound of a slap echoed through the silent corridor. Shen Qinghuan's head was struck violently to the side, and five bright red finger marks instantly appeared on her fair cheek. A burning, sharp pain surged straight into her mind, causing her ears to ring.

"This slap is a reward granted to you on behalf of the Empress! Bitch! How dare you attempt to curse the imperial heir; you deserve this end! Bah!" Consort Li shook her hand in disgust, then suddenly pulled an object from her sleeve, a glittering golden phoenix seal!

That was the symbol of the Empress, tied to the authority of the harem!

"And this... the Empress specially had me bring it for you to see. Haven't you always coveted it? You poisonous woman, are you worthy?" Consort Li sneered, raising her hand high, and in full view of everyone, hurled the phoenix seal, symbol of supreme power, viciously at Shen Qinghuan!

The phoenix seal drew an arc, striking Shen Qinghuan squarely in the face. The sharp pain made her let out a muffled groan. The seal bounced off and rolled into the mud beside her, the dirt and sand tracked in from the imperial guards' boot soles, mixed with the blood dripping from her temples.

Shen Qinghuan lay wretchedly on the ground, watching helplessly as the phoenix seal was stained with filth, flashing a blinding light of humiliation amidst the mire.

Her heart felt as though it were being ripped apart. This phoenix seal had once been her secret yearning; she had naively believed that relying on the Emperor's favor, she would one day wield it. Now, however, it was cast away into the mud with such contempt, mirroring her exact plight at this moment.

Seeing her miserable state, Consort Li smiled smugly and delivered another vicious kick to her waist.

"Why aren't you dragging her away already! She's dirtying my eyes!"

The imperial guards dared not delay, grabbing her and dragging her once more all the way through the palace pathways, past the once-flourishing imperial garden, and skimming the rockery and ponds where she had once left behind sounds of laughter.

Every step felt like it was treading on her bleeding heartstrings.

She saw the eunuchs and palace attendants who had once been deeply respectful to her now lowering their heads, their eyes filled with fear and alienation. The guards who once flattered her now showed only the indifference of executing their duties.

The mockery and pity permeating the surrounding air, those gazes piercing into her bones like thousands of steel needles.

Humiliation! Monstrous humiliation!

This deep palace of Daqi; she had once thought it was her harbor, her glory, the hall where she would spend her life with her beloved. Yet now, it had become her purgatory, her graveyard!

She, Shen Qinghuan, daughter of a loyal and righteous lineage whose father and brothers bled on the battlefield and performed monumental military exploits for the rivers and mountains of Daqi, was now being dragged, spat upon, and pointed at by thousands like a criminal!

She was not resigned!

She hated the Emperor's ruthlessness, hated the Empress's venom, hated Consort Li's arrogance, and hated everyone within these palace walls who watched with cold detachment!

Her hands clenched into tight fists, her fingernails digging deep into her palms, but the pain could not suppress the raging hatred burning in her heart. She had to survive! She had to make everyone who framed her and looked down upon her pay back in blood!

She must!

Amidst the dragging, a sudden chill struck her left wrist. It was the jade bracelet she had worn since birth, as warm and smooth as ever, yet now exuding an unusual chill. It had once been a protective amulet and her sole solace.

At this moment, the jade bracelet was bone-chillingly cold, seeping into her marrow, yet carrying a trace of a bizarre... calmness?

Shen Qinghuan was roughly hurled into the courtyard of the Cold Palace.

The Cold Palace lived up to its name. The halls were dilapidated, the walls mottled, the vegetation withered, and the air filled with the decaying smell of mold. This was the final destination of disgraced concubines, the most hopeless corner of the palace.

Behind her, the heavy wooden doors closed with a deafening "bang," completely cutting off all connection between her and the mortal world.

She was imprisoned in this tiny patch of heaven and earth, thoroughly abandoned.

The setting sun sank below the horizon, its last rays swallowed by the high walls, and the Cold Palace plunged into boundless darkness.

Shen Qinghuan knelt upon the icy ground, numbly feeling the burning pain on her cheek, the exhaustion of her body, and the endless despair and hatred deep within her soul.

She raised her hand to stroke the icy jade bracelet on her left wrist. It was so cold it seemed colder than her own skin, yet it exuded a faint, illusory warmth.

Leaning against the mottled wall, she slowly closed her eyes.

At this moment, Shen Qinghuan had only one thought left in her mind: survive.

She had to survive, until the day she saw the light of day once more, and returned the humiliation she had suffered a hundredfold!

And that cold jade bracelet seemed to sense her burning hatred and unwillingness, beginning to emit a faint, miraculous glow... A light like a tiny glimmer in an abyss, or perhaps a silent summons out of the dark.

chapters.title: On the Brink of Death, the Jade Bracelet Activates
chapters.content:
The Cold Palace, night.

The damp, decaying air wrapped around Shen Qinghuan's throat like an airtight net. She lay on a dilapidated wooden bed, covered only by a thin, mildew-smelling quilt. The pain from being dragged, slapped, and kicked during the day washed over her like a tide, eroding her already frail body.

A high fever made her whole body burn as if she were in purgatory. Her consciousness flickered between clarity and blurriness, the humiliating scenes from the Golden Chozhen Hall flashing before her eyes: the Emperor's icy gaze, the Empress's triumphant smile, Imperial Consort Li's arrogant and overbearing slaps, and that Empress's seal thrown into the mud...

"I am wronged... I am wronged..."

She muttered unconsciously, her voice hoarse and weak, so weak she could barely hear it herself, seeming so pale and powerless in this dead silence of the Cold Palace.

No one... no one would come... This place was... a place to wait for death...

The cold wind roared through the cracks of the dilapidated window like a ghost's whisper, carrying a freezing dampness that made her tremble uncontrollably. Cold and burning heat intertwined within her body, gnawing away at her last shred of vitality.

She felt her life force draining rapidly; the darkness before her grew thicker, like a giant mouth about to swallow her completely. She could even hear the violent beating of her heart; beat by beat, heavy and weak, as though it could stop at any moment.

"Mother... cough cough... Father... your daughter is unfilial... unable to protect... our family..."

Hot tears mixed with cold sweat fell, burning the wounds on her face and bringing an even sharper pain.

She thought of her father and brother far away on the battlefield, and the mother who had raised her through untold hardships. Her mother had passed away when she was young, leaving her only this jade bracelet worn all year round on her left wrist. Warm and translucent, worn against her wrist year-round like jade, it provided her with endless warmth akin to a mother's embrace.

Yet at this moment, the jade bracelet was exceptionally cold, forming a sharp contrast with her burning skin; that chill even felt somewhat piercing.

Her consciousness grew increasingly hazy, and the darkness completely enveloped her. She felt her body light and airy, as if about to be extracted from this tortured, shattered shell. She knew she was dying.

Resentment!

Monstrous resentment! Bone-gnawing hatred! It exploded like hellfire deep within her extinguishing soul!

She could not die! She could not die carrying such a grievance! Her father's wrong had not yet been avenged, her maternal family's glory had not yet been restored, and she had not yet trampled those who harmed her underfoot, nor seen their retribution with her own eyes! She was unwilling!

Right at this moment of chaos and desperate nearing of death, the jade bracelet on Shen Qinghuan's left wrist suddenly underwent an unusual change.

The originally cool and translucent jade bracelet now began to emit a faint, soft white light. The white light came from the inside out, starting as a faint glow before gradually intensifying, clear and holy like moonlight. Even more amazingly, it was no longer cold; instead, it began to radiate an incredible, gentle warmth. That warmth spread rapidly along her wrist and throughout her entire body.

Upon contacting this warmth, her burning body felt an unprecedented comfort. That warmth was not an ordinary heat, but a nourishment carrying a powerful life force, flowing like a clear spring slowly pouring into her withered meridians and soothing her aching internal organs.

Her weak breathing gradually stabilized, and the violent, near-death throes of her heart began to steady and grow strong.

Just as this warmth swept through her entire body, a cold, flat voice, sounding like the clashing of gold and stone, abruptly exploded deep within her consciousness. Every syllable was clear, icy, and unquestionable, so distinct that she could not tell whether it was reality or hallucination.

"Hum..."

"Host's vital signs detected as extremely weak, on the verge of death."

"Host's intense resentment and desire to survive sensed, meeting activation conditions."

"Core program initiating... Loading... 99%... 100%..."

"'Mind-Reading Jade Bracelet', Binding complete!"

"Novice protection period initiated: To assist the host in adapting to the ability, the bracelet's ability will be temporarily locked to the 'Mind-reading within the Cold Palace' mode. Novice protection duration: Twelve hours. Countdown begins..."

Shen Qinghuan abruptly opened her eyes.

Before her was no longer blurry darkness, but the clearly visible, dilapidated roof. The high fever overhead seemed to vanish instantly, and the pain in her body had lessened greatly. She could even clearly feel the flow of the surrounding air, and...

And some noisy, malicious, and contemptuous voices, buzzing directly in her brain like countless flies!

"This Imperial Consort Shen is probably not going to make it, right? Look at how fiercely the guards dragged her; her skin is all scraped up."

The voice of a raspy old woman sounded, carrying undisguised gloating.

"Served her right! Who asked her to be so favored, overshadowing the Empress herself? Now look, once she enters the Cold Palace, she's bound to die of illness, saving her from dirtying His Majesty's eyes."

Another sharp and vicious voice immediately followed, filled with malice.

"What are you afraid of? In this ghost place, besides us few old hags with one foot in the grave, even rats are too lazy to come! She heard it? What can she do even if she heard it? Just a dying useless person anyway!"

A third, slightly raspy voice sounded indifferently.

"Exactly, she deserved it! I heard her parents were both stubborn old fools who refused to ally with the Empress, which is why they were targeted by the Empress. This time, it's only right!"

The first raspy voice sounded again, carrying a ruthless edge.

Shen Qinghuan confirmed with terror that these malicious whispers were not coming from outside the house, but were directly branded deep into her mind! She could clearly distinguish the speakers' timbres, every shred of malice in their tone, and even feel the viscous, sickening gloating.

Suppressing her churning emotions, she concentrated her mind once more.

"Damn weather, freezing a person to death! Guarding this unlucky place, not even a hot drop of water! That plague god in the room, if she's going to die, she should hurry up and die completely so this old lady doesn't have to crawl up in the middle of the night to collect a corpse!"

A voice full of grievance complained.

"Better if she dies! His Majesty spoke with golden words; she is a person of this Cold Palace alive, and a ghost of this Cold Palace dead! All ties with the outside are completely cut off! We'll just dig a hole and bury her, nice and quiet!"

The sharp and vicious voice carried a trace of relieved pleasure.

"Right! I heard all those gold bowls and jade cups she used to use were moved away by people from the Empress's palace. Tsk tsk, that quality... falling to our hands, we can't even drink a warm sip of spoiled rice soup!"

The raspy voice was filled with jealousy and resentment.

The voices were noisy and clear, rising one after another, filled with negative emotions.

Shen Qinghuan was completely stunned. She struggled to sit up; although her body remained weak, the fatal burning sensation and severe pain had receded like a tide. Reaching out to touch her forehead, the high fever was gone, leaving only a layer of cold sweat. She abruptly lowered her gaze to her left wrist; the jade bracelet remained warm, but at this moment, it was emitting an indescribable, restrained, and mysterious faint light.

Looking at the jade bracelet on her left wrist, it remained warm and translucent, emitting a faint white light, now visible now hidden. "Mind-Reading Jade Bracelet..." she softly recited the name spoken by that cold, mechanical voice in her mind.

So, those poison-laced curses, cold calculations, and vulgar complaints from just now... were not hallucinations?! They were the dirtiest, truest thoughts deep in the minds of those old crones guarding the Cold Palace?!

This... this was simply a power beyond ghosts and gods! Her mother's final amulet left to her, and also... a blade for revenge?!

Closing her eyes, she took a deep breath and concentrated to listen again. Those malicious, numb, fearful, and vulgar thoughts poured into her mind once more like opened floodgates of sewage.

Shen Qinghuan's fingertips dug deep into her palms from the force, almost drawing blood, but this pain made her even more awake and more certain; all of this was real!

That cold voice said this was the 'Mind-Reading Jade Bracelet'!

This was the novice protection period! She could only hear thoughts within the scope of the Cold Palace! And only for... twelve hours!

What did this mean?

It meant she could know everyone's secrets, everyone's plots, and everyone's true thoughts!

Those hypocritical palace maids, those honey-mouthed and dagger-pious imperial concubines, and even... that ruthless, cold-blooded emperor on the dragon throne; what kind of calculations and ruthlessness was he hiding deep in his heart toward her, Shen Qinghuan?!

Thinking of this, Shen Qinghuan's heart hammered violently as if struck by a heavy sledgehammer, a torrent mixed with wild joy, resentment, and disbelief instantly breaching the embankment of despair!

She had thought herself at her wit's end and on the verge of death. But now, this golden finger dropped from the heavens had given her a lifeline, a glimmer of hope!

She would use this ability to find out the truth! She would use this ability to clear her grievances! She would use this ability to make those who framed her suffer the punishment they deserved!

Inside the Cold Palace, darkness and dead silence remained, but in Shen Qinghuan's eyes, blazing fires rekindled. That was not a fire of despair, but the flames of vengeance and the hope of rebirth.

Slowly yet with extraordinary firmness, she stood up. The cold wind blew through her disheveled hair, and she felt a strength surging from deep within her marrow, accompanied by an unprecedented, all-perceiving clarity!

During the twelve-hour novice protection period, she had to race against time.

Although the Cold Palace was desolate, it was still guarded by palace maids, old nannies, and even imperial guards. Being able to hear their thoughts allowed her to piece together more news about the outside world and secrets deep within the imperial palace!

From this moment on, she, Shen Qinghuan, would no longer be a discarded concubine to be trampled upon!

She was the new Shen Qinghuan, wielding the power of "Mind-Reading," destined to stir up the winds and clouds of these ninefold palace towers!

The jade bracelet on her wrist emitted a faint yet steadfast glow, silently responding to the oath in her heart.

At this moment, the Cold Palace was no longer her tomb, but the starting point of her phoenix rebirth from the ashes.

The gears of fate, amidst dead silence, heavily and clearly... began to turn once more.

chapters.title: Showing Initial Edge, Overawing Palace Servants
chapters.content:
The breaking dawn in the Cold Palace brought a bone-chilling cold. The faint light struggled to pierce through the shattered lattice window, reflecting Shen Qinghuan's unusually bright eyes. Her high fever had completely subsided; though her limbs felt weak, her mind was like a taut bowstring. The jade bracelet on her wrist radiated an almost imperceptible, warm white glow, and the inner voice in her mind remained clear; last night was no dream; she was no longer meat on a chopping block.

"Buzz, Novice protection remaining: eleven hours, twenty minutes." The cold, mechanical sound engraved itself into her mind.

Time and tide wait for no man! During these twelve hours, she had to squeeze every single breath: figure out the layout of the Cold Palace, grasp the guards' trump cards, and stockpile chips for her counterattack.

She closed her eyes and focused.

(The cheap wretch hasn't given up the ghost yet? Coughing like that yesterday, I thought we'd be collecting her corpse this morning.) (Eunuch Li's hoarse muttering.)

(She has a tough life! Empress Niangniang gave instructions to 'take good care' of her. Don't you understand the meaning? Find a way to let her 'accidentally' die here!) (Nanny Wang's shrill scheming.)

A sudden chill pierced Shen Qinghuan's heart. Just as she thought! These two slaves weren't guards at all; they were clearly executioners dispatched to take her life on imperial orders! The so-called "accident" was just an old palace drama whitewashing a butcher's knife!

She continued to hold her breath...

(That old eunuch swiped the Imperial Kitchen's 'Dahong' wine again last night and buried it under the crooked tree. Tsk!) (Nanny Wang's heart surged with sour jealousy.)

(That shrew is green with envy? She herself is hooking up with the guard Zhang Er, taking bribes to smuggle things for palace maids! Does she really think her dirty deeds are a secret?!) (Eunuch Li's inner voice was filled with disdain.)

A sharp gleam flashed in the depths of Shen Qinghuan's eyes! Good! Though the dirt was petty, it was enough to strike like thunder!

At that exact moment, the footsteps of the two approached the small cottage.

(Lead her to the well later. Frame her for being mad with thirst to draw water, and tripping! Drowning!) (Nanny Wang's murderous intent was laced with poison.)

(Understood. You deliver the porridge first. The room is dark, once we're outside... it'll be easy to make a move.) (Eunuch Li calculated precisely.)

Shen Qinghuan sneered inwardly: Wanting to make her "slip and fall"? In their dreams!

"Creak..."

The broken door was pushed open, and floating dust fluttered in the panic of the light.

Nanny Wang walked in with a stoop, holding a coarse porcelain bowl filled with cold, hard porridge gruel. The smile on her face was as hypocritical as a pasted-on mask, but venomous light flashed in her eyes.

"Oh, Niangniang is awake? Look at this sickly appearance, this old slave's heart aches. Drink a sip of hot porridge to warm up your body?" Her voice softened, but she screamed internally: (Why isn't she dead yet?! We need to finish this quickly! Otherwise, if the Empress blames us, we'll all be buried in coffins!)

Shen Qinghuan remained motionless, her pale little face calm as water, save for a pair of eyes, bottomless and chillingly oppressive.

"Troubling you, Nanny." Her hoarse voice carried an inherent authority.

Nanny Wang's spine grew cold: This gaze... too calm! Suppressing her unease, she feigned a smile and handed over the porridge: "Niangniang, please don't mind the crude fare..." (Drink up quickly! Drink so I can send you on your way!)

Eunuch Li followed closely behind, his thieving eyes roaming over Shen Qinghuan. "Niangniang is precious, lying down too long makes one weak, shall this old slave help you out to the courtyard for some fresh air?" (Once this old hag makes her drink the porridge, we'll lead her toward the well...)

Hearing the two speak with honey on their lips and murder in their hearts, Shen Qinghuan found it grimly laughable.

She neither took the bowl of porridge nor responded. Her gaze, like an ice-forged blade, suddenly pierced Nanny Wang's mask.

"Since Nanny Wang has this kind of heart, why not tell me; how does the Imperial Kitchen's 'Dahong' wine buried under the crooked tree taste?"

The fake smile on Nanny Wang's face instantly cracked, her pupils rapidly contracting in sheer terror: "Y-You, what are you spouting?!" Her mind collapsed like the heavens falling: (How does she know?! It was buried so secretly! Even this old eunuch couldn't figure it out!)

Shen Qinghuan turned a deaf ear, her cold eyes shifting to Eunuch Li, her words like ice picks: "And Eunuch Li, does the Imperial Household Department truly know nothing of your dealings with Guard Zhang Er? Accepting bribes and privately letting palace servants out of the palace, do you find your head too heavy on your shoulders?!"

"Clang...!"

The tray slipped from his hands, shattered porcelain scattering everywhere. Eunuch Li turned ashen, his old eyes bulging, pointing a finger at Shen Qinghuan that trembled like a withered leaf in the wind: "Mon... Monster! You're not her!!" His liver and gall split: (Top secret! How did she figure it out?! Even Nanny Wang was kept in the dark... A ghost! She must be a vengeful ghost demanding a life!)

Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li were struck as if by a thunderbolt, stiffening like puppets! The filthiest, most deeply hidden secrets they thought were airtight had been brutally torn open, word by bleeding word, by this dying abandoned consort!

Utterly absurd, a nightmare descending!

Watching the two frightened out of their wits, a sense of controlling the universe surged within Shen Qinghuan's chest. Using force against force and killing with a single blow was better than any miracle elixir!

She slowly stood up, her figure swaying slightly, yet her oppressive aura rose like a sudden tempest, like a collapsing mountain! Approaching step by step, those eyes that had once held tears now swept over the two slaves like ice blades, carrying the scrutiny of death by a thousand cuts.

"Do you two truly think the Cold Palace is a lawless place outside the law? Do you think that because I am discarded like worn-out shoes, I am yours to trample and kill?" Her voice was not loud, but it rolled like muffled thunder, capturing souls and freezing spirits!

"Whether it is the Empress's verbal decree or the petty, filthy schemes in your bellies..." She leaned forward slightly, her words like a venomous snake darting its tongue, "I, have seen it all! Wanting me to 'slip and fall'? Why not wait and see who has the 'accident' first!"

Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li felt their livers and galls shatter! Their eyes met, leaving only boundless fear.

"Thud!" "Thud!"

Their knees slammed heavily onto the ground, both trembling like sieves, their foreheads smashing against the cold ground with heavy thuds.

"Niangniang, spare my life!! This old slave was blinded by lard and bewitched by the Empress! I will never dare again!!" Nanny Wang wept tears and snot, her arrogance completely gone.

"Niangniang, show mercy! This old slave was momentarily confused! I am willing to be a beast of burden for you, to shatter my body and spill my brains!!" Eunuch Li wailed like a gibbon, voice hoarse and desperate.

They were terrified! Someone who could tear through psychological defenses and look straight into the underworld was more terrifying than a rakshasa. At this moment, they would rather believe she had acquired divine or ghostly powers, and they didn't dare harbor the slightest rebellious thought.

Shen Qinghuan looked down indifferently, her heart as hard as ice. From this moment on, these two vicious dogs had become puppets in the palm of her hand.

"Your lives now hang from my hands," her voice as cold as the frost of the netherworld. "If there is any movement, or if the slightest word of today leaks out... I will make you taste, a fate worse than death!"

"Yes, yes, yes! We wouldn't dare! We absolutely wouldn't dare!" The two kowtowed like pounding garlic.

"Get up." Her command was as concise as a blade.

"What you need to do is simple: three meals a day, according to the Imperial Kitchen's standards; charcoal and brocade quilts, according to the highest grade; clothing and bedding, ensuring cleanliness as new. As for outside the Cold Palace..." Her eyes blazed like torches, "Report every single piece of news, big or small, without missing a word!"

"Understood! This servant obeys the decree!" Granted a reprieve, the two scrambled to their feet, their legs still shaking.

Suddenly, hurried footsteps sounded outside the Cold Palace gate!

"The Imperial Decree has arrived...!" A shrill, familiar voice pierced the courtyard.

Shen Qinghuan's heartstrings tightened, Grand Eunuch Su! The Chief Eunuch of the Imperial Presence! Shocking the Emperor in the Cold Palace?!

Grand Eunuch Su stepped into the small courtyard, clad in a scarlet robe, a whisk draped over his arm. His expression remained respectful as ever, but the depths of his eyes could not conceal a trace of startled anxiety.

When he saw Shen Qinghuan standing in the courtyard, surrounded by an invisible, oppressive aura, his pupils contracted violently, and his astonishment could no longer be concealed!

"Consort Shen, peace be with you. This servant has come by imperial decree." Grand Eunuch Su bowed, his courtesy concealing alienation.

Before his voice faded, the jade bracelet on Shen Qinghuan's wrist suddenly grew scorching hot!

An extremely secretive, anxious, and panicked inner voice violently crashed into her mind:

(The Empress Dowager is critically ill! In her delirium, she repeatedly calls only for 'Consort Shen'! The Emperor... seems to have his resolve shaken because of this! But will His Majesty... will he use the Empress Dowager's critical condition or... or once she passes away, shift this monstrous crime onto Consort Shen?! Heavens! Serving the ruler is like serving a tiger! This is a phoenix personally struck down by the Emperor himself! To summon her now, I'm afraid... it bodes ill!)

Shen Qinghuan's mind shook violently!

The Empress Dowager is critically ill?!

A dead end?!

A turning point?!

Outwardly calm as an unruffled lake, her inner heart was turbulent like raging waves! What Grand Eunuch Su's inner voice revealed was an unforeseen peril and... a sliver of survival! The Empress Dowager was the Emperor's biological mother and the stabilizing pillar of the palace. She had never had deep ties with the Empress Dowager, so why did she call for her alone on her deathbed? And what murderous intent was hidden behind the decree of the emperor who had listened to slander and ruthlessly cast her into the Cold Palace?!

Beyond the heavy palace gates of the Cold Palace, because of the Empress Dowager's impending death, a crack had suddenly opened up! Was it a narrow bridge leading to life, or the starting point of a fall into an even deeper abyss?

Shen Qinghuan's heart surged. The dark struggles of the palace were merely the opening gongs. And at this moment, she grasped the, power, to upend the chess game!

chapters.title: Insight into the Netherworld, Grasping the Cold Palace's Hidden Pulse
chapters.content:
"Niangniang..."

Grand Eunuch Su's shrill voice dragged on long and lingering in the dilapidated courtyard of the Cold Palace, yet the tail end carried a trace of suppressed anxiety. The young eunuchs behind him stood with lowered heads, their faces unable to mask their bewilderment.

Shen Qinghuan's heart churned like boiling oil, but her expression remained as still as an ancient well. The Empress Dowager was dying, where could there be any sentiment of old relations? The Emperor's summons was clearly poison wrapped in honey! Yet for now, she had to respond first.

"Read the decree," Shen Qinghuan said lightly, her tone naturally revealing the composure and majesty of a superior.

Grand Eunuch Su's pupils constricted slightly; this deposed consort before him was worlds apart from the wretched woman dragged out of the Golden Throne Hall that day! Suppressing his astonishment, he unfurled the bright yellow scroll in his hand.

"By heaven's decree, the Emperor proclaims: The Empress Dowager has suffered a protracted illness, her mind entangled with old acquaintances. Remembering that the deposed consort Shen once served medicine by her side, she is specially permitted to enter the Cining Palace for an audience to comfort the imperial benevolence. Respect this!"

The decree was airtight. The grave crime of witchcraft was not mentioned at all; it merely borrowed the Empress Dowager's sickly body to cast a net and wait. Shen Qinghuan's heart turned icy: Was she being pushed onto the sacrificial altar as a "medicine guide"? Or were they waiting to use the words of the dying to seal her doom beyond redemption?

"This concubine receives the decree with gratitude." Shen Qinghuan indifferently accepted the fiery-red silk roll.

Grand Eunuch Su stared closely at her, seeing her expression bland, showing neither panic nor wild joy, which filled his heart with growing suspicion and mounting unease.

"There is no time to lose; please, Niangniang, follow this servant to Cining Palace immediately. The Empress Dowager... can hardly hold on much longer." Grand Eunuch Su urged, panic gripping his heart: (If the Empress Dowager truly collapses... the Emperor's wrath will mean my entire clan won't be spared!)

Shen Qinghuan's gaze swept over Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li, who were trembling like cold cicadas on the ground; the two slaves curled up like maggots, not daring to breathe loudly.

"Nanny Wang, Eunuch Li, my words are etched in your hearts. Remember, I, will eventually return." Every word was like an ice pick piercing into the bone marrow.

"Yes! This servant/slave respectfully obeys Niangniang's edict!" The two trembled like mosquitoes.

Shen Qinghuan turned, following Grand Eunuch Su out through that gate of the Cold Palace that separated life from death.

Outside, the daylight was blinding, yet it carried not a shred of warmth. Shen Qinghuan did not head straight for Cining Palace; instead, under the guise of washing up, she was led to a slightly neater side hall near the Cold Palace to wait temporarily.

"Buzz, Novice protection remaining: ten hours, fifty-eight minutes."

The warning bell tolled loudly! The road to Cining Palace was long and complicated; once trapped by the Empress Dowager's sickbed, surrounded by countless palace servants, the noisy inner voices like a boiling cauldron would make it impossible to perceive the full picture of the "Cold Palace" within the protection period. This was the final opportunity! She had to completely "penetrate" this cage that isolated the mortal world!

Dismissing everyone, the hall was left in dead silence. Shen Qinghuan sat cross-legged with her eyes closed, her mind focusing on the jade bracelet, driving her "Mind-Reading" ability to its absolute limit!

Her perception spread like an invisible wind, penetrating every crack in the decaying wooden walls, seeping into cold, damp, dark corners, and engulfing the entire Cold Palace within her "ears."

Insight into the Netherworld:

Corner of the Side Hall (Sweeping servant)

(Bah! A pheasant wearing a phoenix skin! That rag of hers, even beggars would despise it!) (The young palace maid's inner voice was laced with acidic venom.)

(Endure! Only by latching onto the Empress's golden branch... otherwise, this will be my end... rotting in the Cold Palace!) (The young eunuch's inner voice overflowed with despair and a hunger for power.)

Kitchen (Thick smoke from stoves)

(Bah! A bunch of old waste still picking and choosing? Even pigs would find this slop unpalatable! Deserve to starve to death!) (The fat cook's vulgar inner voice dripped with naked contempt.)

(Old hag! Hiding two more steamed buns again! The moment you kick the bucket, I'll dig out those copper coins you've saved for your coffin!) (The kitchen assistant's inner voice was gloomy, his calculations deeply ingrained.)

Deep Palace Abandoned Courtyard (Cut off from human trace)

(Cold... ice has formed in the marrow of my bones... Does His Majesty... still remember how this concubine was back then...) (An aged, withered consort's inner voice wept, drowning in the leftover wine of past favors.)

(That old madwoman next door! Screaming like a ghost every night! Why hasn't she given up the ghost yet! Truly bad luck!) (Another aged consort's inner voice was numb, her resentment like maggots.)

(...Rivers and mountains... jade soul... supreme treasure... do not... fall into the hands of... villains!) (A faint, intermittent inner voice struggled to overflow from the deepest, perpetually decaying cell in the Cold Palace! Shen Qinghuan's mind suddenly concentrated! The voice seemed sober for a fleeting moment, only to be immediately drowned out in the roaring tide of the surrounding concubines' raving laments, returning to chaotic and muffled silence.)

Shen Qinghuan's mind flashed like lightning! "Rivers and mountains jade soul," it sounded like a supreme treasure! And it was connected to "villains"?! The speaker was the mad consort at the far end of the Cold Palace, who usually muttered endlessly, but at this moment revealed an unusual sobriety! She wanted to investigate further, but the inner voice snapped like a thread of gossamer. Though the clues were fragmented, they were like sparks in the dark night! She carved them deeply into her sea of consciousness.

Wellhead Edge (Deep Water Reflection)

(Xiaocui... is a nail planted here by the Empress Niangniang! In the drinking water given to Consort Shen a few days ago... she tampered with it! (When that trigger acted up, it was like a plague, yet she actually survived it!)) (The water-drawing eunuch's inner voice held a deep fear of the Empress's malice.)

Shen Qinghuan's spine turned slightly cold! No wonder she had inexplicably weakened with no evidence found! The Empress dealt poison silently and imperceptibly! That Xiaocui was a transformed venomous snake!

She instantly locked onto her target, beside the wellhead, the slender figure burying herself in washing clothes, and the clear inner voice arrived:

(Bitch! She has a tough life! When she rolls back from the Empress Dowager's place... the 'Dream-Breaking Intestine' gifted by Niangniang... mixed into her food... let her intestines rot away silently...) (Xiaocui's inner voice was excited, filled with cruel gratification.)

A cold light flashed in the depths of Shen Qinghuan's eyes! Indeed, it was riddled with thorns! This fiend had to be... uprooted as soon as possible!

Prison Guard Room (Choked with foul air)

(That gambler old Chen! The hole his wife dug outside is being filled with his daughter! If there's no more silver, she'll have to be sold to a brothel to pay off the debt!) (A prison guard's inner voice was contemptuous.)

(This ghost place... the geomancy is cursed! Consort Zhang, who starved to death a few years ago... skin and bones... the Empress Niangniang's 'thunderous methods'... thinking of it sends a chill down the back of my neck!) (Another prison guard's inner voice was filled with terror, the shadow of death deeply engraved in his bones.)

As all these inner voices entered her ears, Shen Qinghuan's mind shook violently!

The Cold Palace was not a place of exile. It was a dark prison, rotting soil, a hotbed for conspiracies and death.

Beneath submissiveness lay filth, within humility wrapped calculations, within madness perhaps hiding heaven-shaking secrets... Most chilling was the bloody case of the "starved to death" imperial concubine! The Empress eliminated dissidents as ruthlessly as crushing ants!

"Buzz, Novice protection remaining: nine hours, forty-five minutes."

Time flew, but Shen Qinghuan felt as though she had acquired a treasure pouch.

With the aid of "Mind-Reading," the structural network of the Cold Palace's invisible web, the identities and backgrounds of every hidden pawn, and their respective deep-seated weaknesses and handles, were as clear as viewing the patterns on her own palm.

Who took bribes? Who was lustful? Who was blindly loyal to the Empress? Whose family faced hardship... What others saw as trivial dust, in her hands, became the keys to lock down the lifeblood of the Cold Palace!

She could instantly uproot hidden stakes, win over trusted aides, and even... make certain "troublesome" figures "disappear" naturally.

An arc like a shard of ice crossed the corner of Shen Qinghuan's lips.

From this moment on, this lifeless cage would be her lair to harbor her hidden ambitions and hone her claws and teeth!

As for that ghostly whisper about the "Rivers and mountains jade soul"... Her thoughts turned: when she had an audience with the Empress Dowager, she might take the opportunity to catch a glimpse of it.

The time had come; it was time to head to the unpredictable Cining Palace.

With a penetrating insight into the subtle faces of the Cold Palace and a heightened alertness to the surrounding venomous snakes, Shen Qinghuan pushed open the tightly shut doors of the side hall.

She knew that the Shen Qinghuan on the chopping block had been buried yesterday.

From this day forward, she would use these sharp eyes capable of piercing human malice and ghostly auras to cut through the heavy veils of the palace and grind every enemy who had once trampled her into mud from which they could never rise again!

Outside the door, the daylight burst forth, the warmth still seeping with the deep palace's chill, but deep within Shen Qinghuan's heart, the flame of revenge was burning fiercely, tempering her will like a sharp blade about to be drawn from its scabbard.

chapters.title: Taming the Lackeys, Secretly Laying the Foundation
chapters.content:
When Eunuch Su led Shen Qinghuan out of the Cold Palace, Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li were still like clay statues frozen by a binding spell, prostrate on the ground. Not until that slender figure vanished completely into the shadows of the palace gates did the two of them dare to shake and struggle to their feet, limp as if their bones had been sucked out.

"Th-this... this mistress... was she truly... possessed by ghosts and gods?!" Nanny Wang's face was the color of beaten gold, her fingertips trembling uncontrollably.

"Who's to say otherwise! Those matters... those shady dealings... how could she possibly know?! That gaze... just looking into it froze one's very soul!" Eunuch Li spoke with a sob, recalling Shen Qinghuan's pool-like eyes and feeling an icy chill at the back of his neck, as if a venomous snake had coiled around him.

"Wh-what are we to do now?" Nanny Wang was completely lost, her voice fluttering.

Eunuch Li slumped onto the ground, his gaze vacant: "What else can we do? She was right! Our lives are pinched between her fingers! If she wants us to go east, do we dare go west? She... she truly could let us meet with an 'accident' and perish thoroughly!"

A bone-chilling cold had completely frozen and subdued these two servants. They knew clearly that this was no empty threat. The eerie and unfathomable aura about Shen Qinghuan was not something mere ants like them could fathom in the slightest, let alone resist.

After resting briefly in the side hall, Shen Qinghuan proceeded to the Cining Palace at Eunuch Su's urging. Forcing down her churning emotions, she focused on dealing with the Empress Dowager's critical illness and the arts of the imperial mind, yet the stagnant, slightly rippling chess game of the Cold Palace constantly occupied her thoughts.

She had long since cast off her former innocence. Bearing the "Mind-Reading" jade bracelet, the dark malice of human hearts had nowhere to hide in her ears. She knew deeply that in the dragon's pool and tiger's den of the Cining Palace, only by playing the part of a grieving, fragile abandoned wife could she carve out a tiny slit of opportunity and glimpse a chance of survival.

By the time she returned from the Cining Palace to the Cold Palace, the night was already deep. Surrounded as the Empress Dowager was by a crowd of imperial physicians, Shen Qinghuan ultimately failed to see her, and by imperial decree, Eunuch Su had no choice but to send her back.

Before the palace gates, Eunuch Su paused, giving her a deep look, his voice dropping extremely low: "Consort Shen, take care. Though the Empress Dowager's... sacred constitution is heavy, there must still be a turning point. My lady... you must await this with a tranquil mind." His inner voice was a tide of anxious worry: [The Empress Dowager is truly thinking of Her Ladyship this time... His Majesty... also seems to harbor some old affection. If Her Ladyship can help the Empress Dowager recover, there may yet be a glimmer of survival. But if the Empress Dowager... alas, in this deep palace... to live is sometimes harder to bear than death.]

Shen Qinghuan understood in her heart. Eunuch Su was giving a veiled hint: this summons was solely for the sake of the Empress Dowager. If the Empress Dowager was well, she might eke out a living; if the Empress Dowager met with misfortune, she would be the ready-made scapegoat!

The heavy wooden door of the Cold Palace banged shut behind her with a thud, cutting off the mortal world.

The moment she stepped into the courtyard, she sensed a completely different atmosphere. The cracks in the doors and windows of the dilapidated rooms had been meticulously stuffed with thick straw mats; though crude, they blocked out the biting cold wind by more than half. Inside, a brazier of charcoal burned faintly, emitting a long-absent warmth.

Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li stood respectfully with their hands at their sides beside the door, their faces plastered with cautious, almost fawning smiles.

"Her Ladyship has finally returned! This old slave (this old woman) has tidied the room warm and lit the charcoal just as you ordered!" Nanny Wang stepped forward eagerly, her aged face smiling like a dried orange peel.

Eunuch Li bowed and offered a steaming bowl of porridge: "Her Ladyship must be exhausted from your travels. This is specially watched over and boiled by this old slave, using the new tribute rice from the Imperial Kitchen this very morning. I would never dare cut corners in the slightest!"

Shen Qinghuan's mind stirred, and the inner voices of the two clearly reached her ears.

Nanny Wang: [Hmph! This charcoal is the bottom-of-the-barrel stale stock from the storeroom, almost choked someone to death last time! Let's see if this fiend dares to be picky burning this!]

Eunuch Li: [I really bled for this porridge, watching it boil, a hundred times better than slop for pigs! If Her Ladyship thinks it's good, she had better not forget this old slave's loyalty!]

Though their inner voices still carried private schemes and calculations, at least they were executing orders and dared not slack off.

"Acceptable." Shen Qinghuan said faintly, taking the bowl of porridge. The taste was mediocre, but its virtue lay in being warm and comforting, far superior to the icy slush of porridge from daytime.

"Her Ladyship... would you like to hear some news from outside the palace tonight?" Nanny Wang probed cautiously, her posture extremely low.

Shen Qinghuan nodded. Information was her only blade in this deadlocked game.

All night long, Shen Qinghuan sat surrounded by the weak charcoal fire, listening to Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li take turns reporting. From time to time, she dropped a few words, precisely "awakening" the two to spit out the whereabouts of supplies that she had long since discerned were being skimmed layer by layer.

"This palace hears that the monthly allocation of charcoal for the Cold Palace is by rule the finest Silver Frost charcoal. Why is it that what this palace receives is nothing but smoky, inferior wood?" Shen Qinghuan's tone was flat and waveless, yet it pierced like an ice awl into Nanny Wang's heart.

Nanny Wang's inner voice: [How does she know about Silver Frost charcoal?! That batch of good charcoal was long ago fenced by me to the black market for silver!]

"M-My Lady, please examine the facts! It must be those scoundrels further down who embezzled it! This old slave will go investigate right now! Even if I have to dig three feet into the ground, I'll find the best Silver Frost charcoal for Her Ladyship!" Nanny Wang fell to her knees with a thud, cold sweat instantly soaking her undergarments.

"And the drinking water in the Cold Palace has always been drawn from the living jade spring water of the Imperial Garden. Why is it that when this palace drinks it, it carries a muddy, earthy stench?" Shen Qinghuan's gaze turned to Eunuch Li, like scattered cold stars.

Eunuch Li's inner voice: [That jade spring water was long sold at a high price to wealthy households outside the palace looking to rub against the dragon's aura! What they drink here is just turbid water from that rotten mud well!]

"Her Ladyship is wise! It must be this slave's negligence and slackness! This old slave will personally fetch water from the source of the Jade Spring! I guarantee Her Ladyship will drink the clearest, sweetest spring!" Eunuch Li's face turned ashen as well, kowtowing repeatedly, his forehead banging loudly against the ground.

Shen Qinghuan did not reprimand them further, merely saying calmly: "The two of you are not entirely useless after all. If you can right the wrongs and return everything to its rightful place... this palace will naturally consider granting the two of you... a lifeline."

As soon as these words were spoken, they were like a ray of light cast into the darkness. Those four words, "a lifeline," instantly became a life-saving straw hanging over their heads, making them utterly devoted and leaving them with no other thoughts.

Overnight, the atmosphere of the Cold Palace changed entirely.

Early the next morning, accompanied carefully by Eunuch Li and Nanny Wang, Shen Qinghuan inspected this cage.

"When can this rat infestation be completely eradicated?" Shen Qinghuan's slender finger gently pointed at the sawdust gnawed into mottled patterns in the corner of the wall.

Eunuch Li's inner voice: [It's all the pantry leftovers' fault! The leftovers were skimmed by that old hag Nanny Wang, how could the rats not run rampant?!]

Nanny Wang's inner voice: [Bulls! It's clearly him who skimmed the cat-feeding allowance! Those fat cats of his are lazier than anything, that's why they can't catch rats!]

Shen Qinghuan knew well that the two were passing the buck to each other, dogs biting dogs.

"Nanny Wang, this palace hears you possess a family heirloom technique, skilled in making highly effective mouse traps. Could you solve this annoyance for this palace?" Shen Qinghuan suddenly turned to Nanny Wang, her tone carrying a trace of "expectation."

Nanny Wang's inner voice: [What family heirloom! It was just a crude method I figured out blindly back when I was stealing pastries in the Imperial Kitchen and afraid of rats eating them!]

"Her Ladyship flatters me! This old woman is vulgar and only understands a smattering; I'll go prepare it right away! I certainly won't let Her Ladyship down!" Nanny Wang spoke with outward humility while crying out in bitter agony inwardly.

Shen Qinghuan then looked at Eunuch Li: "Eunuch Li, this palace hears that the cats you raise are the cream of the crop for rat-catching in the palace. Can you lend them to this palace for a use to overawe the rodent pests?"

Eunuch Li's inner voice: [My precious cats! Oh well... for the sake of survival...]

"Since Her Ladyship commands, this slave will die without regret! I'll surely have those cats give their all for Her Ladyship!" Eunuch Li gritted his teeth and agreed, his heart bleeding.

The two had no choice but to bite the bullet and cooperate to eliminate the rats under Shen Qinghuan's invisible "guidance." Nanny Wang presented her "secretly crafted" mousetrap, and Eunuch Li reluctantly released a few sleek, well-fed "beloved cats." In less half a day, the shrill and desperate squeaks of rats resounded throughout the Cold Palace.

At the same time, Shen Qinghuan "heard" the inner voices of the palace maids and eunuchs, learning that deep within the Cold Palace there were still long-neglected, severely silted drainage ditches, dampness permeated them, extremely prone to breeding plagues. She therefore ordered Eunuch Li to immediately lead several young and strong eunuchs to dredge and clean them without delay.

At lunchtime, the meal brought by Eunuch Li was noticeably much richer, unexpectedly accompanied by a small dish of fresh sliced meat.

Eunuch Li's inner voice: [This is meat I gritted my teeth to get from outside at a high price! If I don't serve this ancestor until she's comfortable, my little life is done for!]

Nanny Wang's inner voice: [This old miser actually had the heart to bleed money to buy meat?! The sun must have risen from the west!]

Shen Qinghuan did not touch her chopsticks; her gaze fell upon Nanny Wang: "Nanny Wang, this palace hears you were once a skilled embroiderer in the palace, though your skills have grown rusty. This palace has some old garments; I must trouble you to alter them slightly so they suit the current season."

Nanny Wang's inner voice: [Embroiderer? That was eight hundred years ago! But... I can take the opportunity to stash some private money in the fabric!]

"Since Her Ladyship commands, this old woman will surely do her utmost! I wouldn't dare be sloppy in the least!" Nanny Wang hastily agreed, a flash of imperceptible cunning crossing her eyes.

Shen Qinghuan saw through their petty scheming as clearly as a torch, but as long as they could be put to use, she chose not to expose them for the moment. Through this imperceptible "guidance," she not only progressively improved the harsh living environment of the Cold Palace, but also firmly grasped Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li in the palm of her hand, turning them into her eyes, ears, and claws within this cage.

The suffocating dead air of the Cold Palace seemed to have been dispelled somewhat. Clean drinking water, edible meals, the gradually vanishing rat infestation, and the slightly drier air brought by the dredged ditches... a trace of feeble vitality quietly sprouted.

Shen Qinghuan's heart was as clear as a mirror; this was merely the beginning of gaining a foothold, and the predicament was far from resolved. Yet she had quietly shifted from fish on the chopping board to the chess player laying out the game.

Late at night, Shen Qinghuan sat alone in the room, by the faint charcoal fire, carefully sorting out what she had heard during the day.

Suddenly, her gaze was drawn to a pile of discarded debris in the corner of the wall. At the bottom of the debris, a corner of an old handkerchief, thickly covered with dust and mud and soaked in dark red bloodstains, was exposed.

She walked over slowly and cautiously picked it up. Though the handkerchief was old, damaged, and worn at the edges, it felt silky to the touch, of excellent quality, faintly revealing its former magnificence. The dark brown, shocking bloodstains silently spoke of the tragic past.

Shen Qinghuan looked closely and intently; in the corner of the handkerchief, an unusual and eerie totem was embroidered with extremely fine gold thread. It was neither the common flowers, birds, and auspicious signs of the palace, nor the dragon and phoenix cloud patterns exclusively used by royalty. The totem was intertwined from several twisted, coiled, vine-like, talisman-like eerie curves; the lines were archaic and vigorous, exuding an indescribable ancient aura and stern eeriness.

She had never seen this thing in any identification of palace consorts or noble clans.

The jade bracelet on her wrist quietly grew warm.

She concentrated, attempting to "hear" a word or two from this dead object, but in the end, it was in vain.

Why was this handkerchief dropped in the filthy corner of the Cold Palace? To whom did the mottled bloodstains on it belong? What did this eerie totem symbolize? Toward what faction did it point?

Layer upon layer of suspicion surged in Shen Qinghuan's heart. This handkerchief might be closely related to the sealed secrets of the Cold Palace, or perhaps... it might have a thousand-and-one connections to the "Jade Soul of Mountains and Rivers" muttered by the raving old consort!

This was undoubtedly an accidentally surfaced clue, pointing toward a deeper, more dangerous vortex of secrets. This Cold Palace seemed even more corrupt and undercurrent-ridden than she had anticipated.

Shen Qinghuan carefully folded the handkerchief, kept it close to her person, and secretly resolved to investigate the origin of this totem.

The night was like poured ink, and the Cold Palace was dead silent. Only Shen Qinghuan's pair of eyes glowed brilliantly in the boundless darkness, startlingly bright. She knew deeply that she had stepped onto a thorny road of vengeance paved with blood. And this blood-stained, eerie handkerchief might well be a spark, enough to start a prairie fire, deep within this gloomy, bewildering maze.

chapters.title: Poison to Test the Jade, A Malicious Plot Backfires
chapters.content:
Daylight had already broken, the air in the Cold Palace wrapped in the damp chill of dew, yet inside Shen Qinghuan's bedchamber, yesterday's purge had left a sort of bizarre "order." The faint glow in the charcoal brazier flickered across her calm profile, as though months of torment in the Cold Palace had failed to carve even a hint of panic between her brows.

Yet she knew the truth clearly: a real storm of blood and slaughter was brewing in the dark. The Empress Dowager's dying breath had pushed her into the spotlight, and the Empress; how could she possibly allow her to linger on in a base existence?

When the sun climbed to the eaves, a sharp, prolonged shout echoed from outside the gates of the Cold Palace:

"Her Majesty the Empress; the Imperial Edict has arrived...!"

Following this came two palace maids, their plain palace attire unable to mask their haughty arrogance. The one leading the way and holding a gold-inlaid food box was none of other than Xiao Cui, whose inner thoughts Shen Qinghuan had "heard" yesterday as she plotted to poison her with the slow-acting toxin "Dream's End"!

Shen Qinghuan sneered coldly in her heart, but on the surface, she appropriately showed a trace of just-right surprise and flattered astonishment, her voice even tinged with the weakness of one just recovering: "Her Majesty the Empress still remembers this concubine... Quickly, quickly invite the matron in." Though her demeanor was weak, her bearing remained unbroken.

At the mention of "the Empress," Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li instinctively bowed to welcome them, bending their waists even lower, while the corners of their eyes tightly tracked Shen Qinghuan, fearing they might make the slightest misstep.

Xiao Cui stepped into the room, her gaze sweeping over Shen Qinghuan's pale yet calm face, disdain surging in her heart:

[Hah, a plucked phoenix still wants to put on airs of high nobility! Wait until 'Dream's End' goes down your throat, let's see if you can still keep that poise! The weaker you are, the more agonizingly the poison will strike!]

Shen Qinghuan clearly heard her poison-laced inner thoughts, the cold glint in the depths of her eyes flashing like the edge of a blade. Sure enough, the Empress could no longer suppress her intent to kill!

"Consort Shen," Xiao Cui wore a formalized smile as she opened the food box, "Her Majesty the Empress heard that your noble health is indisposed here in the Cold Palace, and specifically commanded this servant to bring you the imperial-recipe 'Mind-Soothing Nourishing Soup,' saying it is the most restorative thing to help you return to health and peace early." Inside the food box, a bowl of clear soup with an overflowing medicinal fragrance sat quietly.

Her tone was soft, but her inner thoughts were like a venomous snake baring its fangs: [Drink up quickly, you bitch! This is the "Dream's End" carefully concocted just for you! Colorless and tasteless, once it enters your belly, it clings like marrow-eating worms, silently eating through your five viscera! Dying in this corner of the Cold Palace, rotting and stinking, you won't even find a trace of evidence left behind!]

Shen Qinghuan feigned tearful gratitude, a long-lost glimmer of hope even welling up in her eyes.

"The Empress's benevolence is vast as the heavens, this concubine cannot repay it even with her shattered bones! Troubling you, Madam..." As she spoke, she reached out tremblingly, her fingertips shaking slightly as she made to receive it.

Xiao Cui's heart swelled with even greater triumph, but on the surface she feigned concern: "Be careful, Your Ladyship, this servant will attend to you." She impatiently pushed the soup bowl closer, wishing she could pour it down directly.

Just as that bowl of "death-summoning soup" was about to fall into Shen Qinghuan's hands, her figure suddenly swayed violently, as if struck by an invisible, heavy blow!

"Ah...!"

Accompanied by a startled, short-lived feminine cry, her outstretched hand also went abruptly limp, losing strength as it wildly brushed across the rim of the bowl,

"Clatter...!!!"

A harsh, shattering sound exploded! The exquisite porcelain bowl slipped from her hands and plummeted to the ground, soup splashing everywhere! Most of the scalding medicinal broth spilled onto the cold floor tiles, rising in wisps of eerie vapor, with only a tiny fraction remaining at the bottom of the bowl.

The smile on Xiao Cui's face instantly froze! A wave of rage at being played and flustered panic rushed straight to her head:

[Dammit! She did it on purpose! Absolutely! She ruined the medicine! Is the Empress's freshly prepared 'Dream's End' something you can just get anytime?! If I ruin a major matter, how am I going to answer for this?!]

Shen Qinghuan clutched her brow and frowned, her breathing rapid, carrying heavy apology and self-loathing: "I'm sorry... truly... it's just this weak body of mine is uncooperative... I have failed Her Majesty the Empress's kind intentions..." Her voice was weak, her chagrin and self-reproach played to absolute perfection.

While "acting," she quietly captured Nanny Wang's inner voice.

Nanny Wang: [Oh dear! She smashed a bowl bestowed by the imperial family! This crime is no small matter! If the Empress blames us, we'll all be skinned alive!... Tsk tsk, this soup smells really fragrant, top-grade stuff! It's such a waste to spill it! If... if there's a way to scrape up some dregs and flip them to sell to those terrified old lords outside for 'prolonging life', wouldn't that be...]

A flash of imperceptible, cunning coldness crossed the depths of Shen Qinghuan's eyes. Greed, truly the best accomplice!

"Your Ladyship must not blame yourself, your health is what matters!" Xiao Cui forced out a few fake smiles, suppressing the raging waves in her heart, and was about to order the maids to clean up the mess,

"Madam Xiao Cui," Shen Qinghuan spoke faster than her, her slender finger pointing with feigned regret toward the remaining medicinal broth on the ground: "This soup still has some left... After all, it is the painstaking effort of Her Majesty the Empress; if it is just discarded like this, it truly is a heavenly waste..." Her gaze shifted, casually falling upon Nanny Wang, "If we could find a proper way to make use of it, it would at least not fail this grace, and show a modicum of heartfelt gratitude."

Nanny Wang's eyes couldn't help but glue themselves to that puddle of medicinal broth, greed surging in her inner voice: [Right! Good stuff! Spilling it is worse than letting me have it... Getting my hands on it means bright, shiny silver!]

"Nanny Wang." Shen Qinghuan's voice was as light as a feather.

"Yes! Does Your Ladyship have instructions?" Nanny Wang gave a start.

"Since this medicine has already been spoiled... there are always stray beasts running wild in the Cold Palace foraging for food." Shen Qinghuan's tone was as flat as if she were discussing the weather, "Why not... bestow these leftovers upon them. Consider it not wasting the medicine's properties and putting everything to use."

Nanny Wang's inner voice changed drastically: [Bestow it on stray cats?! What a squanderer! Such good stuff... But... if a stray cat eats it... I can always scrape up some dregs and leftovers for myself...]

Xiao Cui's face turned "swish" as pale as paper! This soup was violently poisonous! If a stray cat ate it and it took effect, its manner of death would be ironclad proof!

"Your Ladyship! This... this is inappropriate! This was bestowed upon Your Ladyship by the Empress..." Xiao Cui anxiously tried to stop her.

How could Shen Qinghuan allow her to interfere? Her gaze suddenly sank, pressure pressing down like a collapsing mountain: "Nanny Wang, are you deaf?!"

This light rebuke was wrapped in an unquestionable, majestic sternness! Nanny Wang trembled all over, awed by that momentum, and coupled with her lingering greed playing a role, she actually agreed as if in a trance.

"Yes! Yes! This old servant will go right now!" Nimble of hand and foot, she scraped the shattered porcelain shards along with the dregs of medicine at the bottom of the bowl into a cracked, coarse bowl. Holding this "death warrant," she bolted out the door as if fleeing for her life.

Watching Nanny Wang's figure disappear, Xiao Cui was so anxious her palms were covered in cold sweat, yet not a single syllable of obstruction could pass her lips! Could she really shout out "the medicine is poisonous"?!

Shen Qinghuan sat quietly in her chair, taking her sweet time to admire the pale-and-green, terrified, enraged, and sitting-on-pins-and-needles expression on Xiao Cui's face. The pent-up frustration in her heart all transformed into a chilling sense of gratification. This dumb loss, the Empress and Xiao Cui were bound to swallow it!

A moment later, a shrill shriek that didn't sound remotely alive suddenly erupted from outside the window!

"Meow-ao...!!"

That sound was filled with pain and terror, rapidly shifting from sharp and hoarse to a low, mournful cry, and finally... cutting off abruptly, returning to dead silence.

Nanny Wang practically crawled back into the room, her face as ashen as death, the coarse bowl in her hands completely empty.

"Your Ladyship... Your Ladyship!!" Her voice was shaking out of tune, her entire body trembling like a sifting sieve, her inner voice in a state of collapse: [Killing... killing a cat with poison! Heavens! That soup is fatal! I only... only wanted to scrape a little... That gluttonous cat... drank it all in one gulp... in the blink of an eye... puked black blood... kicked its legs and died! Her Majesty the Empress... is trying to end Consort Shen's life! Good thing... good thing Your Ladyship didn't drink it! Heaven has eyes!!]

Xiao Cui had already lost all color in her face upon hearing the cat's dying wails, and now seeing Nanny Wang's soul-frightened state, her legs went weak and she collapsed directly to the ground! Her inner voice was consumed by boundless terror: [Dead! Expired on the spot! Domi-... Domineering to this extent!... Fortu-... Fortunately Shen Qinghuan didn't drink it! If she had really swallowed it... and died right here... Even if Her Majesty the Empress protected me... His Majesty... how could he let me off lightly?! It's over... I'm finished...]

Shen Qinghuan's expression remained calm and unruffled, as though everything had been anticipated. She slowly turned toward Xiao Cui, who had collapsed like mud, her gaze as calm as a deep pool, yet within it lay a sharp blade capable of piercing the netherworld, stabbing straight into Xiao Cui's soul and mind:

"Madam Xiao Cui... just now the cat's commotion... was exceptionally mournful. Could it be... this medicine..."

"Thud!"

Scared out of her wits, Xiao Cui lunged to the ground, kowtowing like pounding garlic: "Your Ladyship, spare my life!! This servant didn't know! This servant truly didn't know!! This medicinal soup was concocted by the Imperial Pharmacy, this servant... this servant was merely running an errand to deliver it..." Eager to clear herself, she spoke incoherently, but she had already chiseled the words "guilty conscience" onto her forehead.

The corners of Shen Qinghuan's mouth lifted slightly, a trace of icy irony flashing and vanishing. She no longer looked at this clown's performance.

"Nanny Wang, Eunuch Li." Her voice was as cold and hard as iron. "Clean it up. Today's matter, if a single word or half a sentence leaks out of this door..." She paused, every word hanging like an ice blade overhead, "You lot, will go keep that stray cat company!"

"Yes! This servant obeys! We wouldn't dare beat it out of us!!" The two had long since been terrified to their core by the horror of the poison and the majesty Shen Qinghuan currently radiated, throwing themselves to the ground and kowtowing endlessly, cold sweat soaking through their clothes.

How could Xiao Cui dare to stay any longer? Stumbling as she climbed up, she could barely string her words together: "Your... Your Ladyship... This servant... this servant will return... return to the palace to report..." With that, she practically crawled and scrambled, fleeing away from this Cold Palace prison that she had thought would be Shen Qinghuan's end.

Shen Qinghuan's gaze was like needles quenched in freezing ice, piercing that hastily retreating back.

The prelude... had only just begun.

Almost the instant Xiao Cui's figure vanished, the jade bracelet on Shen Qinghuan's wrist suddenly turned burning hot!

"Hum..."

A chaotic noise burst forth, countless fragments of inner thoughts flooding into her mind, instantly locked onto Xiao Cui's return journey by her precise focus.

[...knocked over? Useless waste!... The cat... the cat died?! Poison took effect?! That fast?!... What kind of ghost thing did Imperial Physician Lin concoct?!... Fortunately... fortunately she didn't drink it!... But me... how am I going to answer for this?!... The Empress will definitely tear me apart!...]

Following that, a deep, tyrannical, vicious consciousness, tempered like boiling oil and carrying a suffocating sense of oppression, overcame all other noises, erupting like a volcano after Xiao Cui's humble retelling:

[Shen... Qing... huan...!]

The Empress's inner thoughts scraped across her consciousness like poison-tipped ice crystals:

[So stubborn to live?! Even a bowl of poisoned soup was dodged?! I really underestimated you! Is Heaven blind, or is there some other high-ranking master behind you?! Useless bitch (referring to Xiao Cui), failing to handle a task means she should be chopped up and fed to the dogs! Hateful!]

Instantly, it was followed by an even more deeply rooted, venomous, near-cursing calculation:

[Hmph! You think it ends here? In a dream! You block my path, and you block Grand Tutor's path even more!]

At the mention of "Grand Tutor" (Note: "Guojiu" usually means Maternal Uncle/Grand Tutor/Imperial Brother-in-law, here kept as Grand Tutor/Imperial Uncle or literal Grand Uncle, but let's stick to Grand Tutor as standard court rank translation for Guojiu in palace plots, or literally Maternal Uncle. Wait, Guojiu means Empress's brother. Let's use "Imperial Uncle" or "Grand Uncle", or "the Maternal Uncle". Usually "Imperial Uncle" or "Lord Grand Uncle" fits historical palace intrigue well), that anger originally belonging to the Empress was actually overridden by a trace of deeply hidden wariness and coldness:

[...The Imperial Uncle... wants you to die without a whole corpse far more than I do! If I can't do anything to you, the Imperial Uncle's thunderous methods are waiting for you! He will never tolerate you living to see tomorrow's sun! You, are dead!]

Shen Qinghuan's mind and soul felt as though they had been struck by a heavy hammer! The jade bracelet's heat was almost burning!

The Imperial Uncle!

This behind-the-scenes shadow that pressed upon the Empress's heart like a boulder and manipulated everything had finally been torn open by this towering hatred!

The Empress... actually seemed to fear this person as well?

He was the true mastermind wanting to put her to death! Far more unfathomable than inner palace struggles! And even... closely tied to whether she could survive! And that shadow pointing toward the Empress Dowager's critical illness... what kind of role did the Imperial Uncle play in it?!

A bone-chilling cold spread along her spine, yet it also ignited the fiercest fighting spirit deep within her chest!

The hidden giant crocodile had finally surfaced. Outside this deep palace cage, an all-killing net encompassing the imperial court and inner palace was quietly tightening.

The crisis was like boiling soup, instantly rising to its peak!

Yet at the corner of Shen Qinghuan's lips, an arc as sharp as an icicle and burning with a sky-incinerating determination slowly curled upward.

Since she knew who the "crocodile" was... the hunting game had only just begun.

She was no longer fish meat on the chopping block. She, was the calmest and most lethal hunter in this hunting ground!

chapters.title: Exhaustion of the Spirit Platform and the Secrets of the Jade Bracelet
chapters.content:
The night was as deep as ink.

In the humble, dilapidated room of the Cold Palace, Shen Qinghuan sat alone on the edge of the couch. Outside the broken window, the moonlight was cold, and a silent frost covered this cage abandoned by the mortal world.

"Buzz, Novice sanctuary remaining: zero minutes, zero seconds... Sanctuary status has been lifted."

The cold, mechanical sound rang in her mind, like the tolling of a final death knell.

In an instant, she felt an unprecedented wave of exhaustion surge over her, drowning her completely. It wasn't simple physical fatigue, but a mental weakness that penetrated deep into her marrow. Her mind felt hollowed out and buzzed loudly, her eyes becoming dry and heavy.

She abruptly lowered her head to look at her wrist. The jade bracelet, which had once emitted a warm, gentle white light, was now as dim as dust-covered dead stone. It was cold to the touch, silent, and devoid of the slightest vitality.

"So... this is what the novice protection period is like," Shen Qinghuan whispered softly, her voice carrying a trace of weakness.

She closed her eyes, recalling her experiences over the past twelve hours. From her activation in a desperate situation, to taking control of the Cold Palace, and finally to neutralizing the Empress's poisonous scheme, the power of the jade bracelet had made her invincible. She easily pried into people's hearts, saw through conspiracies, and even accurately predicted and counterattacked her enemies. This omniscient and omnipotent experience allowed her to complete the metamorphosis from an "abandoned consort" to a "controller" in just one day.

However, at this moment, the stripping away of power made her truly feel that this was not without a price. This mental exhaustion made even thinking somewhat sluggish.

She tried to activate the jade bracelet's abilities again, but no matter how hard she concentrated, the bracelet remained completely unresponsive, like an ordinary stone.

"Sure enough... power has a limit," Shen Qinghuan smiled bitterly.

She slumped back onto the couch, her body uncontrollably sinking into darkness. She knew she needed rest, and even more, she needed to find a way to recharge the jade bracelet.

I do not know how much time passed when Shen Qinghuan, between waking and sleeping, was awakened by a chill. Struggling to open her eyes, she found that the moon outside the window was already high in the sky, casting its clear radiance across the earth.

She tried to extend her wrist with the jade bracelet into the moonlight. The moonlight was like water, gently caressing the jade bracelet.

A miracle happened.

The moment the jade bracelet touched the moonlight, its previously dim surface actually lit up slightly. Although extremely faint, Shen Qinghuan felt it clearly.
