A trace of faint warmth came from the jade bracelet, flowing smoothly along her arm and into her body. Wherever that warmth reached, it seemed to alleviate a fraction of her mental exhaustion.

"Moonlight... can recharge it?" Shen Qinghuan felt a surge of joy, but the recharging speed was so slow it was almost negligible.

She maintained this posture, greedily sensing that sliver of faint warmth.

At that moment, a blurred and distant scene suddenly flashed into her mind without warning.

It was an ancient and mysterious setting: under a vast night sky, a huge and brilliant full moon hung on the horizon, with moonlight pouring down like the Milky Way, enveloping a towering and ancient altar. Atop the altar, a blurred figure raised both hands high as if praying to the moon, and on that figure's wrist, unmistakably, was worn a bracelet identical to the one in her hand!

The vision vanished in a flash, dissipating like a mirage.

Shen Qinghuan abruptly opened her eyes, her heart beating like a drum.

What was this? Was it a hallucination? Or... the memories of the jade bracelet, or perhaps some kind of portent?

That blurred image, that ancient altar, the object identical to her jade bracelet... everything pointed to a mysterious and ancient origin. The background of the jade bracelet seemed far more profound and ancient than she had imagined. It wasn't just a simple mind-reading tool; it was more like a "living thing" with its own history and secrets.

Yet the image was too blurred, and it appeared too suddenly, leaving her unable to grasp further clues.

"Beep, Energy value: 0.001%"

The prompt from the jade bracelet reminded her once again how inefficient moonlight recharging was. If she relied solely on moonlight, she would likely need months or even years to restore all her abilities.

She began to recall the scene when the jade bracelet was activated. At that time, it was her body and mind hovering on the brink of death, combined with monstrous hatred, unwillingness, and a desperate desire to live, that had awakened the bracelet.

Was hatred the source of power? Or...

Her thoughts began to drift. She recalled how in the Cold Palace, Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li went from their initial fear and unwillingness, to later awe and submission towards her, and even a hint of "loyalty" thinking "Her Ladyship is wise." Especially when she cleverly exploited their respective weaknesses to make them "willingly" work for her, deep in their hearts, they seemed to harbor a certain "trust" or "dependence" on her.

[Consort Shen is truly formidable. Following her, we might actually survive...]

[Her Ladyship is strict, but at least she isn't as ruthless as the Empress, and she's even left us a way out...]

[If not for Her Ladyship, my family's gambling debts might never have been paid off...]

[If Her Ladyship manages to make a comeback, we can enjoy the blessings with her...]

Although these inner voices carried their own selfish motives, they undoubtedly contained a certain recognition, dependence, and even what could be called... "willpower" or "belief" toward Shen Qinghuan.

As she recalled these inner voices, the faint glow on the jade bracelet seemed to brighten just a tiny bit more than before.

She felt the warmth transmitted by the jade bracelet, which was now noticeably more distinct than when it absorbed moonlight.

"Could it be... that the recharging of the jade bracelet is related to 'belief'?" Shen Qinghuan's heart stirred.

What if the recharging method of the jade bracelet wasn't just absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth (moonlight), but more importantly, absorbing a certain "energy" from human hearts, such as the strong emotional energies of others' fear, awe, loyalty, worship, and even resentment and unwillingness?

Especially those "beliefs" and "wills" transformed from fear into submission, and from utilization into dependence, could these be a more efficient way to recharge the jade bracelet?

If so, then her every future action would not only be for revenge, but also to accumulate power!

She could consciously employ methods to deter, to buy off, and to display her own strength, causing more people to feel awe, loyalty, and even fanatical worship toward her.

Could the anger, unwillingness, and jealousy of those villains she had slapped in the face also transform into a special kind of "energy"?

Shen Qinghuan's thoughts ran like a wild horse, instantly opening up a new train of thought.

If her guess was correct, then the foundation of her foothold in the palace was not merely using mind-reading to avoid crises, but taking the initiative, accumulating her power through wave after wave of face-slapping, subjugation, and displays of strength!

"Jade bracelet, oh jade bracelet, you've really given me a massive surprise!" Shen Qinghuan's eyes shone with excitement, and her exhaustion seemed to lessen somewhat.

A confident smile curled the corner of her lips.

The Marquis? The Empress? Even that supreme Emperor?

They thought that casting her into the Cold Palace would end all future troubles. Little did they know, the Cold Palace had instead become the hotbed for her to accumulate strength.

She was no longer just the wrongfully accused Shen Qinghuan; she was the "abandoned consort of the Cold Palace," and furthermore, an avenger wielding the "Mind-Reading Jade Bracelet." And the mysteries of the jade bracelet had only just revealed the tip of the iceberg to her.

What kind of secret was hidden within that blurred ancient vision and the altar connected to the origin of the jade bracelet? Were there other ancient artifacts with strange powers on this continent? And was what she could "hear" merely the surface layer of inner voices?

Shen Qinghuan knew that every limitation and revelation of her cheat meant deeper secrets. She was no longer satisfied with merely surviving in the Cold Palace; she would uncover the secrets of the jade bracelet step by step, and step by step, trample those who had once harmed her underfoot!

The path of revenge would be long, but she had already seen infinite possibilities.

chapters.title: Setting Out for the Empress Dowager's Palace, Crisis on All Sides
chapters.content:
When the first ray of morning sunlight filtered through the dilapidated lattice window of the Cold Palace and fell sparsely on the floor, Shen Qinghuan was already up. Although the jade bracelet's energy was not yet fully restored and the mental fatigue lingered, she knew the true test had arrived.

"Imperial decree arrives..."

Eunuch Su's shrill and bureaucratic voice rang out outside the gates of the Cold Palace, breaking the morning silence.

"Consort Shen, the Empress Dowager summons you. Please proceed immediately to Cining Palace for an audience." Eunuch Su's voice pierced through the gates and reached Shen Qinghuan's ears.

Shen Qinghuan took a deep breath, her face rapidly shifting into a just-right expression of paleness and weakness. Having experienced the "poison scheme" only yesterday, this was the prime moment to display a sickly and mentally traumatized state. She wanted everyone to believe that life in the Cold Palace had completely broken her, leaving her as nothing more than a dying, discarded consort of zero threat.

"Thank you for your trouble, Eunuch Su." Her voice carried an imperceptible tremor, sounding pitiful.

Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li hurriedly stepped forward, one supporting Shen Qinghuan while the other led the way ahead, carefully opening the gates of the Cold Palace.

The heavy doors creaked open, and what rushed in was an atmosphere entirely different from inside the Cold Palace. Although it remained desolate, it at least lacked that suffocating smell of decay.

The moment Eunuch Su saw Shen Qinghuan, a trace of imperceptible surprise flashed in his eyes. He knew Shen Qinghuan would suffer in the Cold Palace, but he hadn't expected her to look so haggard in such a short time; her face was pale, her lips devoid of color, and her figure so thin that a gust of wind seemed capable of blowing her over. Her eyes, usually bright and expressive, were now veiled in a layer of mist, carrying a trace of panic and unease, making her appear exceptionally fragile.

[Tsk, this Consort Shen looks even more pitiful than last time. It seems the Empress's dose of medicine truly damaged her foundation. Good. The more she's like this, the less the Empress will take her seriously.] Eunuch Su's inner voice carried a hint of gloating, mingled with the habitual speculation of an old servant trying to second-guess his superiors.

Shen Qinghuan sneered inwardly. She knew Eunuch Su had misunderstood, but that was precisely the effect she wanted. She wanted everyone to believe she was at the end of her rope.

"Consort Shen, please," Eunuch Su signaled.

Shen Qinghuan curtsied weakly, and supported by Nanny Wang, slowly stepped out through the gates of the Cold Palace. Every step she took was exceedingly slow, as if exhausting her entire strength. With lowered eyelids, she projected an image of extreme caution, daring not to look anyone in the eye, portraying the quintessential humiliated, disgraced consort filled with terror of the outside world to absolute perfection.

The journey from the Cold Palace to Cining Palace was not short. It was a passage toward the center of power, and also the prologue to Shen Qinghuan's return. Along the way, she encountered sweeping palace maids, patrolling guards, and passing eunuchs and maids from various quarters. Upon catching sight of Shen Qinghuan, every single one of them revealed complex expressions of surprise, curiosity, gloating, and even a sliver of sympathy.

While Shen Qinghuan appeared to keep her head lowered, the jade bracelet on her wrist flashed with an imperceptible micro-glow, silently activating her "mind-reading" ability. Though her energy was limited, it was more than enough to perceive the inner voices of these passersby.

[Oh, isn't that Consort Shen? She's not dead yet! What does the Empress Dowager want with her?], a sweeping maid, her eyes filled with gossip and curiosity.

[I heard the Empress Dowager is critically ill; are they bringing her in to bring good luck? But what use can a discarded consort be?], a young eunuch, his inner voice speculating on palace secrets.

[Poor Consort Shen. She used to be the apple of His Majesty's eye, yet she's fallen to this state. This palace truly eats people without spitting out their bones.], an elderly palace maid, a trace of pity welling deep in her heart.

[Hmph, a vixen like this should have died in the Cold Palace! Don't even think about coming out to harm people again!], a maid from the Empress's faction, her eyes showing obvious disgust and schadenfreude.

[Consort Shen's complexion is so poor; she looks genuinely sick. That's fine, the Empress can save herself some worry.], In the distance, an elaborately dressed nanny, her inner voice full of calculation.

Various inner voices flooded into Shen Qinghuan's mind like a tide. She filtered the information, confirming whether her disguise was succeeding. From the current standpoint, her "sickly and harmless" persona had indeed fooled the vast majority, making them lower their guard.

She continued walking, deliberately slowing her pace to force Eunuch Su to wait with gritted patience.

Just as she passed a secluded corner of the palace wall, Shen Qinghuan "heard" a remarkably clear and resentful inner voice. It was two young sweeping maids whispering complaints.

[Hey, the Empress's rations were cut back again recently; the food in our small kitchen has decreased, and the nannies still accuse us of stealing food!]; one maid complained, her inner voice filled with dissatisfaction over the poor meals.

[You're telling me! A few days ago, Xiaoyu was forced to kneel all night by Nanny Lan just because she took one extra pastry, and she was even slapped in the mouth by the Empress's people! They claimed she stole palace property! The Empress's people are getting more overbearing by the day!]; another maid replied, her inner voice filled with grievance and fear of the Empress's faction.

Shen Qinghuan's steps paused slightly, but she quickly returned to normal.

"The Empress privately cuts rations?"

"Privately imposing minor punishments, slapping faces?"

These pieces of information, like sparks, ignited the blueprint of revenge in Shen Qinghuan's mind.

She knew that within the palace walls, embezzling rations and imposing unauthorized punishments, especially exploiting and abusing maids and eunuchs, were major pieces of evidence pointing to the Empress's loss of virtue. Once brought to the Emperor or the Empress Dowager, it was enough to cause a massive uproar and shake the Empress's position. These seemingly trivial matters were actually the easiest handles to grab against the Empress.

She silently stored these inner voices deep in her heart, like an investigator collecting evidence. These would become the sharp blades she used to counterattack the Empress in the future.

[Hmph, this Consort Shen is a real disaster. Back then, His Majesty neglected so many consorts just for her. Now that the Empress Dowager is ill, she still dares to come out and swagger about. Shameless.], Another inner voice belonged to a maid jealous of Shen Qinghuan's former favor.

Shen Qinghuan sneered inwardly. Back then, the Emperor doted on her exclusively not because she actively seduced him, but because the Emperor had shown her an "affection" unlike any other. Now, the maids of those neglected consorts vented all their resentment onto her.

She knew this hatred could also become a tool she could exploit in the future.

Along the way, Eunuch Su maintained his bureaucratic posture, guiding the way neither too fast nor too slow. He occasionally turned back to look at Shen Qinghuan, and seeing that she maintained that sickly appearance, he became even more certain: [This Consort Shen is finished. It seems her coming out today is just a whim of the Empress Dowager, or merely a formality.]

Shen Qinghuan was well aware of this. This "harmless" illusion was precisely what she wanted.

Her gaze fell upon a flower bed by the roadside, where a pear tree was blooming at the height of its splendor. Its petals were white as snow, yet carried a hint of faint sorrow. Tangli pears. This was her favorite flower, the one the Emperor had promised to plant all over the courtyard when they first met. Now, they were blooming in lonely splendor along the path from the Cold Palace to Cining Palace.

"Your Ladyship, Cining Palace has arrived," Eunuch Su's voice pulled Shen Qinghuan back from her thoughts.

Shen Qinghuan raised her eyes. What came into view was the vermilion gate of Cining Palace, majestic and solemn. She knew that behind this door lay the battlefield of her future destiny.

The guards, nannies and eunuchs stationed at the entrance, also flashed expressions of surprise upon seeing Eunuch Su leading Shen Qinghuan forward.

[This discarded consort, why does the Empress Dowager want to see her? Could she want her to bring good luck?]

[Even the imperial physicians are helpless against the Empress Dowager's illness; what can a discarded consort from the Cold Palace do?]

Shen Qinghuan listened to these inner voices without changing expression. She knew her appearance had already attracted attention and speculation from all sides.

Eunuch Su led Shen Qinghuan into Cining Palace. Inside the hall, sandalwood smoke curled lazily, and the atmosphere was solemn and heavy. The doors to the Empress Dowager's bedchamber were tightly shut, guarded by several elderly nannies whose faces bore expressions of worry and fatigue.

Shen Qinghuan's gaze fell upon those tightly closed doors. Inside was the gravely ill Empress Dowager, her sole lifeline; outside was the eyeing-like-a-tiger Empress and the Marquis.

She took a deep breath, striving to calm the ripples in her heart. She adjusted her emotions to the absolute extreme, looking like a criminal facing judgment, or a drowning person buffeted by fate holding onto a final shred of hope.

She wanted everyone inside the hall, including the Empress Dowager, the Emperor, and the Empress's spies, to believe in her helplessness and despair.

Only thus could she extract more information during the ensuing encounters and find the opportunity to break the game.

Yet, at the very moment before she stepped across the hall threshold, the jade bracelet once more transmitted a faint wave of warmth. She sensed a deeper layer of resentment coming from a seemingly obedient palace maid who brushed past her.

[That bitch! If she manages to make the Empress Dowager better, won't she regain favor? Then my mistress will have even less hope of rising up! His Majesty must have been blind back then!]

This resentment did not stem from the Empress's faction, but from the maid of another fallen consort. Shen Qinghuan realized that besides the Empress, there were many others in the harem harboring resentment due to her former glory.

These hidden resentments would likewise become chess pieces she could utilize in the days to come.

Shen Qinghuan took a deep breath and stepped across the threshold into the main hall of Cining Palace. From this moment onward, her destiny was once again pushed into an unknown vortex. And she was no longer a lamb waiting to be slaughtered. She possessed the jade bracelet, she possessed intellect, she possessed hatred, and she possessed that continuously accumulating power.

chapters.title: The Empress Dowager's Bedchamber, Eavesdropping Amidst an Assembly of Elites
chapters.content:
Stepping into the main hall of the Cining Palace, a rich medicinal scent rushed over them, mixed with sandalwood and a faint, indefinable smell of decay that weighed heavily upon the heart. The atmosphere inside the hall was solemn; the imperial couch behind the screen was vaguely visible, from which low coughs drifted out.

Shen Qinghuan stood with her head bowed, appearing like an insignificant shadow, yet she took the innermost thoughts of everyone in the hall into her ears.

The Empress, dressed in a magnificent phoenix robe, sat upright in an armchair not far from the Empress Dowager's couch. Her expression appeared worried, but deep within her eyes lurked a trace of unperceivable coldness and scheming.

[Hmph, this old hag is finally about to kick the bucket. As long as she dies, there will be no obstacles left to my Empress's seal! The entire inner court, no, the entire realm, will be within my grasp! That bitch Shen Qinghuan actually dares to come here, isn't she afraid of bringing bad luck? But it's just as well; taking advantage of her sickly and weak state, I can completely get rid of her once and for all!]

Imperial Noble Consort Li was as bright as a peach blossom, yet at this moment her brows were locked in a frown and her eyes were red, seeming genuinely worried for the Empress Dowager. However, her inner thoughts were not so pure.

[If Her Majesty the Empress Dowager passes away, the Empress will surely seize the opportunity to monopolize power. And His Majesty is so partial to the Empress, what is to be done? I must quickly think of a way, find an opportunity to perform before His Majesty. The Empress Dowager is His Majesty's biological mother; if I appear heartbroken to the extreme, His Majesty will certainly look at me in a new light.]

Imperial Consort De, whose rank was second only to the Empress and Consort Li, was speaking in soft tones to comfort Consort Li at that moment. The prayer beads in her hand kept turning, and her face was a picture of mercy.

[Amitabha, the Empress Dowager has her own natural blessedness. Only... why has this abandoned consort from the cold palace appeared here? Could it be that His Majesty still holds lingering affections for her? She must never be allowed to make a comeback! My imperial son, the future crown prince, must never have such a tainted mother by his side!]

Other high-ranking concubines in the hall whispered among themselves; some wore sorrowful expressions, but their inner thoughts all without exception revealed a focus on the Empress Dowager's illness, and the anxiety over the resulting reshuffling of power in the inner court.

[The Empress Dowager has fallen ill to this extent, and His Majesty has also been restless lately. If I can present a fine medicine, perhaps I might win His Majesty's favor.]

[Why hasn't that bitch Shen Qinghuan died yet? She actually dares to come to the Cining Palace! Could it be that His Majesty has taken a fancy to her again? No, I must never let such a thing happen!]

Several elderly imperial physicians were gathered around the Empress Dowager's couch, taking her pulse and holding a consultation. Their expressions were heavy, but their inner thoughts were each harboring their own agendas.

[This old servant has done his utmost regarding the Empress Dowager's illness. This medicine... is merely holding on to her last breath.]

[If something were to truly happen to the Empress Dowager, can my position as an imperial physician still be preserved? Will His Majesty place the blame?]

[I heard that Consort Shen has returned. Is His Majesty going to have her bring auspicious energy to drive away bad luck? Heh, sick to this degree, what use is bringing auspicious energy?]

As for the Emperor, at this moment he stood with his back to Shen Qinghuan, standing before the Empress Dowager's couch and tightly grasping her hand. His expression was haggard, and his eyes were bloodshot. His inner thoughts were so complex that they made Shen Qinghuan's heart tremble.

[Imperial Mother... you must not have any trouble! Imperial Physician Lin, do you still have a way? I cannot lose you!]

[Shen Qinghuan... she has come? I shouldn't have let her come; she shouldn't be dragged into these mire pits any further...]

[She... she looks so much like that person back then. Imperial Father's mistakes should not be repaid by her...]

[I... have failed you... Qinghuan.]

Shen Qinghuan's heart gave a violent twitch. The Emperor's inner thoughts exploded in her mind like a thunderclap.

"She looks so much like that person back then..."

"Imperial Father's mistakes should not be repaid by her..."

These few sentences contained an astonishing amount of information! Could this mean that her background, or her father, had some unknown entanglement with the Emperor's "Imperial Father," that is, the late Emperor? And this entanglement actually made the Emperor feel that he had "failed" her? Even thinking that "Imperial Father's mistakes should not be repaid by her"?

Could this be related to her father's old case? Back then, her father was executed under the charge of "secretly communicating with foreign enemies," the whole clan was exiled, and she was also implicated and sent to the cold palace. Could there be a hidden story behind this?

This discovery made Shen Qinghuan's hatred no longer limited merely to the Empress and those who framed her, but vaguely pointed towards a deeper royal secret! This might be the key to her future reversal of her case, or even completely subverting the imperial power!

Suppressing the shock in her heart, she continued to listen.

Eunuch Su led Shen Qinghuan to the center of the hall and reported respectfully, "Your Majesty, Empress, Consort Shen has arrived."

Hearing this, the Emperor's figure trembled imperceptibly, but he did not turn back.

The Empress slowly turned around, a pair of phoenix eyes carrying scrutiny and contempt as they landed on Shen Qinghuan.

[Hmph, what a sickly wretch, swaying even as she walks. With this ghostly appearance, seeing her will probably only make His Majesty loathe her even more.]

Supported by Nanny Wang, Shen Qinghuan slowly knelt and said in a weak voice, "This concubine Shen Qinghuan pays respects to Your Majesty, to Her Majesty the Empress, and to all the consorts."

Her voice carried the hoarseness of illness and was deliberately lowered a fraction, making it appear all the more feeble.

The Emperor finally turned around. His gaze fell upon Shen Qinghuan, his eyes complex, holding guilt, pain, and an unperceivable struggle.

[She really is sick to this extent... Why did I listen to those slanderous words... But now, I am powerless as well. Imperial Mother... Imperial Mother doted on Qinghuan the most, perhaps...]

Shen Qinghuan caught the phrases "Imperial Mother doted on Qinghuan the most" and the hesitation of "perhaps" in the Emperor's inner thoughts. She knew this might be the real reason the Empress Dowager summoned her; the Empress Dowager was gravely ill, and what she held in her thoughts and heart was this former favored consort, perhaps even wanting to make amends for something. And the Emperor knew of this, and even looked forward to it somewhat.

This allowed Shen Qinghuan to see a glimmer of survival; the Empress Dowager would be her greatest backing!

Seeing the Emperor look at Shen Qinghuan, anger flared in the Empress's heart, but her face did not show the slightest bit of it.

[His Majesty is still looking at her? What on earth is the magic of this bitch?! But with this ghostly appearance now, His Majesty surely won't fall for her heart again, right?]

She immediately spoke up, her tone gentle yet carrying a trace of hypocritical worry, "Younger Sister Shen, look at your health; you must have suffered hardships in the cold palace. The Empress Dowager is gravely ill, and with your weak constitution, it is probably not suitable for you to stay long. You should quickly return to the cold palace to recuperate. Do not disturb the dragon body of the Empress Dowager."

Her inner thoughts, however, were incomparably vicious: [Hurry up and crawl back to wait for death! Don't think about being an eyesore here!]

Shen Qinghuan sneered in her heart, but on the surface, she put on an expression that was flattered yet tinged with a hint of panic.

"Thanking Her Majesty the Empress for her concern. This concubine... this concubine only wishes to see Her Majesty the Empress Dowager once to pray for blessings for her... Though this concubine's body is weak, my intentions are pious." Shen Qinghuan's voice was weak yet firm. She knew this was the sole purpose for which the Empress Dowager had summoned her, and the only reason she could remain.

Seeing this, Consort Li hatched a scheme.

[This Shen Qinghuan really knows how to put on an act. But the more she acts pitiful, the more the Empress Dowager might pity her. I might as well step up and add fuel to the fire, letting the Empress Dowager know that I, Consort Li, am also a person who values affection and righteousness.]

Consort Li stepped forward and said warmly, "Her Majesty the Empress speaks improperly. Younger Sister Shen has a heart of filial piety, and the Empress Dowager has always doted on her. Now that the Empress Dowager is gravely ill, perhaps seeing Younger Sister Shen will make her spirits a bit better?"

Consort Li's inner thoughts made the corners of Shen Qinghuan's mouth twitch imperceptibly. This Consort Li had unexpectedly given her a helping hand. Consort Li wasn't truly trying to help her; rather, she wanted to use this to display her own "understanding" and "filial piety" toward the Empress Dowager in front of the Emperor.

The Emperor's gaze landed on Shen Qinghuan. He could sense Shen Qinghuan's cautious "filial piety" and "anticipation," coupled with Consort Li's "assist," and he hesitated.

[Perhaps... Qinghuan really can make Imperial Mother improve? Imperial Mother has constantly been muttering about her...]

In the end, the Emperor looked toward Eunuch Su. "Eunuch Su, go and invite Imperial Physician Lin over to examine Consort Shen's health and see if she can come close to visiting the Empress Dowager."

The Empress's expression instantly stiffened, and her inner thoughts were practically a roar: [What?! His Majesty actually asked Imperial Physician Lin to take her pulse?! Isn't this giving her an opportunity?!]

Imperial Physician Lin was quickly called over. When he took Shen Qinghuan's pulse, his heart was also filled with suspicion.

[This Consort Shen's pulse... is indeed weak, but there are no signs of poisoning. The potency of this medicine... could it be that it is merely a chronic poison that has not yet fully taken effect? Strange, the prescription given by the Empress should have taken effect much faster than this.]

Shen Qinghuan felt a secret triumph in her heart. Naturally, Imperial Physician Lin could not detect the traces of that chronic poison on her body because she hadn't drunk it at all. And the weak state she exhibited at this moment was entirely deliberate, compounded by the torture of the cold palace, making it difficult to distinguish true from false.

Having finished taking the pulse, Imperial Physician Lin cupped his hands and said, "Replying to Your Majesty, Consort Shen's health is indeed weak, but there is no major ailment. She should not be overworked for a short period. If she wishes to come close to visiting the Empress Dowager, this old servant suggests... having her stand further back and not lingering for long, lest the Empress Dowager be startled."

This reply both gave the Emperor a way out and blocked the Empress's intention to immediately drive Shen Qinghuan away, while also limiting the time Shen Qinghuan could spend in contact with the Empress Dowager.

The Emperor pondered for a moment and finally nodded. "Granted. Eunuch Su, take Consort Shen to kneel outside the screen; she must not disturb the Empress Dowager's recuperation."

"Thanking Your Majesty for your boundless grace!" Shen Qinghuan offered a weak expression of gratitude once more. She knew this was her best opportunity.

Led by Eunuch Su, she was brought outside the screen to a spot a few steps away from the Empress Dowager's couch and knelt down. Although separated by the screen, she could sense the Empress Dowager's faint breathing.

Quietly activating her jade bracelet, she expanded her perception to the absolute limit, concentrating her mind to listen to the Empress Dowager's weak inner thoughts.

[Huan'er... Huan'er... you have come... Imperial Mother has missed you so... cough, cough...]

[Your Majesty... why does Your Majesty not trust Huan'er... Qinghuan is innocent...]

[That piece of jade... the jade pendant... must be returned to Huan'er... It belonged to her mother...]

[The Jade-Guarding Clan... secret... must not let outsiders know...]

[Your Majesty, do not make mistakes any longer...]

The Empress Dowager's inner thoughts were intermittent and vague, but the information revealed within them made Shen Qinghuan's pupils suddenly contract!

"Jade-Guarding Clan"!

"Jade pendant"!

This jade pendant was a keepsake left by her mother? Could it be that the jade bracelet and that jade pendant, and even the "Jade-Guarding Clan," were related?

Her mother's identity had always been a mystery. She only knew that her mother was a legitimate daughter of the prestigious Shen clan in Jiangnan, but she knew very little about her mother's familial origins and the jade pendant she had worn since childhood.

The words "Jade-Guarding Clan," along with the Empress Dowager's obsession with the "jade pendant" in her inner thoughts, undoubtedly opened a brand new chapter regarding her parentage and the secret of the jade bracelet!

A monstrous wave raged in Shen Qinghuan's heart, but on the surface, she still maintained that weakness and piety. She knew that this summons by the Empress Dowager was by no means accidental. This was not merely her glimmer of survival, but the key to unlocking the mystery of her birth and the deeper secrets of the jade bracelet!

And the Emperor's words, "Imperial Father's mistakes should not be repaid by her," coupled with the mention of the "Jade-Guarding Clan" in the Empress Dowager's inner thoughts, unquestionably bound her destiny tightly to the imperial family and an ancient secret.

A true storm had only just begun. And she was already standing at the very center of the storm.

chapters.title: Imperial Physician's Inner Thoughts, the Truth of the Poison Emerges
chapters.content:
Shen Qinghuan knelt outside the screen, seemingly devoutly praying for the Empress Dowager, while her mind was actually completely immersed in listening to the surrounding inner thoughts. In particular, the few imperial physicians surrounding the Empress Dowager's bedside were the focal point of her attention at this moment.

These imperial physicians were all masters of medicine within the palace. The most senior among them was Imperial Physician Lin, and the rest were also experienced imperial doctors. However, their inner thoughts all without exception revealed helplessness and suppression.

Imperial Physician Lin, possessing the deepest seniority, was furrowing his brows tightly at this moment, beads of fine sweat oozing from his forehead, his inner thoughts a tangled mess:

【The Empress Dowager's poison... is truly bizarre. Her pulse clearly shows a chronic and stubborn illness, yet it leaves no trace. The daily decoction, seemingly nourishing, actually harbors hidden mysteries. The Empress's methods... are truly ruthless.】

【I know this medicine is a chronic poison, but the dosage is extremely small, and the medicinal properties are extremely covert, making it impossible for ordinary imperial physicians to detect. To think she could pull this off without a sound...】

【The Empress gave a strict order, under no circumstances allowing the slightest word to leak out. If not for the sake of my entire family's lives, how could I assist an evildoer?】

【This poison... if it could be deciphered, one would surely go down in history... What a pity, this old man's skills are lacking, and moreover, I am firmly manipulated by the Empress, leaving me to simply watch the Empress Dowager grow weaker day by day...】

Shen Qinghuan's heart gave a cold shiver. As expected, the Empress Dowager had been poisoned! And it was a chronic, rare poison, to the point that even an imperial physician like Lin Lin was helpless, or rather, lacked the power to do anything. More importantly, the mastermind behind the scenes turned out to be none other than the Empress!

She continued to delve deeper into the inner thoughts of the other imperial physicians.

Imperial Physician Wang, somewhat younger in age but possessing superb medical skills, had a pale complexion at this moment, appearing extremely anxious:

【This symptom is clearly the result of a rare poison! Why do Imperial Physician Lin and Imperial Physician Zhang avoid discussing it? The daily prescriptions, seemingly beneficial, actually complement the toxicity and accelerate the outbreak of the poison... This, this is simply a crime of treason!】

【The Empress... The Empress used both coercion and temptation, threatening my family's lives... How can I speak the truth? If I speak, my entire family will be buried along with me! Yet, watching the Empress Dowager like this... my heart feels like it's being torn apart by knives!】

【What a pity... The medicinal properties of this poison are extremely special, originating from... If it could be deciphered, one would surely go down in history!】

Imperial Physician Wang's inner thoughts allowed Shen Qinghuan to capture key pieces of information:

Confirmation of the poison's nature: This was not a simple illness, but a rare poison.

Confirmation of coercion and temptation: The Empress not only used enticements but also threatened the imperial physicians with the lives of their families.

Revealing the origin of the poison: In Imperial Physician Wang's inner thoughts, that utterance of "What a pity, this poison originates from..." though cutting off abruptly, left a huge hook. The origin of this poison was clearly extraordinary, possibly even related to some mysterious faction or secluded clan. And his phrase "If it could be deciphered, one would surely go down in history" further hinted at the rarity and complexity of this poison.

Shen Qinghuan locked her gaze onto Imperial Physician Wang. From his inner thoughts, she sensed intense struggle and dissatisfaction toward the Empress. This was an individual who could be won over! The deep-seated benevolence of a physician within him, along with his indignation at the Empress's actions, would be the breakthrough point she could utilize.

Imperial Physician Zhang, another veteran imperial doctor, had inner thoughts that appeared even more numb and cowardly:

【Sigh, serving the monarch is like living alongside a tiger, and serving the inner palace is even more like walking on thin ice. How can the Empress Dowager's life compare to the lives of my entire family? The Empress said that as long as I keep my mouth shut, the Zhang family can rise to great prominence...】

【It's just an old life anyway. Who could ever detect this poison? I'll just treat it as diagnosing and curing an illness, and as for the rest, I know absolutely nothing!】

His inner thoughts revealed deep selfishness and a desire to save his own skin, which made him a person difficult to break through, though not entirely without weaknesses.

Shen Qinghuan sorted through these inner thoughts one by one, gaining complete mastery over the Empress's conspiracy in her heart.

On the surface, the Empress was worried about the Empress Dowager's condition and kept vigil personally; in reality, she was secretly poisoning the Empress Dowager and coercing the imperial physicians into concealing the truth. She was committing murder against the Empress Dowager to achieve her goal of monopolizing power in the inner palace, and perhaps even harboring designs on the imperial court!

If she did not possess the jade bracelet, such a conspiracy would be entirely unknowable to her.

She could even imagine how, once the Empress Dowager passed away, the Empress would utilize her appearance as an "abandoned consort of the cold palace" alongside the narrative of "a failed blessing ritual turning into a disaster," splashing dirty water on her all over again and driving her completely to a dead end.

However, she had already grasped the core evidence, the truth of the poison!

Shen Qinghuan pondered in her heart. She could not act rashly right now; the imperial physicians were manipulated by the Empress, and speaking out rashly would only lead them to self-destruction while alerting the enemy. She needed a perfect timing, an opportunity that would allow the imperial physicians to speak out and deal a fatal blow to the Empress.

And Imperial Physician Wang was her most crucial chess piece. The struggle within his heart and the benevolence of a physician would be the key to shaking the entire situation.

She began to observe Imperial Physician Wang's actions. Every time Imperial Physician Wang took the Empress Dowager's pulse, he would subconsciously linger for a few extra moments, his brows furrowed tightly, his eyes carrying a trace of reluctance and pain. When he stepped back, he would cast a quiet glance at Imperial Physician Lin, seemingly seeking some kind of confirmation or comfort, but Imperial Physician Lin would always avoid his gaze.

Shen Qinghuan quietly utilized the jade bracelet, dispersing a faint spiritual energy around Imperial Physician Wang in an attempt to capture deeper inner thoughts.

【This poison... is called "Bone-Eroding Fragrance," colorless and odorless. Once it enters the body, it slowly erodes the internal organs, causing one to waste away and die in agony. The method of refining this poison is known only to the legendary "Hundred Herbs Sect"...】

Shen Qinghuan's heart suffered a massive shock! "Bone-Eroding Fragrance"! "Hundred Herbs Sect"!

This information was practically explosive!

A name that sounded like a martial arts sect was actually tied together with imperial secret poison! This indicated that the Empress's sphere of influence extended far beyond the interior of the imperial court, and might even be colluding with a mysterious organization in the jianghu (martial arts world)!

This was no longer merely a struggle within the inner palace; it had escalated to the level of the jianghu and the imperial court.

The "Hundred Herbs Sect," as the name implied, was bound to be related to poisons and medicinal herbs. If one could find this "Hundred Herbs Sect," perhaps they could find the antidote, or even discover a method to counter the Empress!

This discovery re-invigorated Shen Qinghuan somewhat. She knew that she had to survive, and must rapidly accumulate strength so that one day, she could explore the secrets of this "Hundred Herbs Sect."

She re-examined everyone in the hall. The Emperor's guilt, the Empress Dowager's obsession, the Empress's ruthlessness, Consort Li's scheming, Consort De's ambition, and the struggles and helplessness of the imperial physicians...

All of this constituted the complex situation she currently found herself in.

She knew that now was not the time for her to expose the truth. Her "frail and sickly" persona was her protective coloration. She needed to wait, waiting for an opportunity that would allow her to safely expose the truth and bring down the Empress with a single blow.

And before that, she needed to gather as much information as possible, especially regarding "Bone-Eroding Fragrance" and the "Hundred Herbs Sect."

She quietly focused the energy of the jade bracelet once more on listening to the imperial physicians' inner thoughts. She needed to understand more details about this poison and the possibility of an antidote.

【The Empress Dowager's body can hold out for at most seven days.】 Within Imperial Physician Lin's inner thoughts carried a trace of despair.

【Seven days... If the Empress Dowager passes away, His Majesty will surely fly into a rage, and no matter how brilliant the Empress's methods are, it will be hard to silence public opinion.】 Imperial Physician Wang's inner thoughts were filled with even greater anxiety.

Seven days!

Shen Qinghuan's heart tightened. She only had seven days! Within these seven days, she had to find a way, without exposing the abilities of the jade bracelet, to bring the Empress Dowager out of danger and expose the Empress's true face.

Time was running out.

Her gaze fell once again upon Imperial Physician Wang. This young imperial physician was the only person she could trust and the only object of cooperation. The benevolence of a physician within his heart and his dissatisfaction with the Empress's actions would be her last hope.

Shen Qinghuan reined in her thoughts, continuing to maintain her frail, sickly, and devout posture. But she knew that within the depths of her heart, towering waves had already been stirred up.

"Bone-Eroding Fragrance," "Hundred Herbs Sect," the Empress Dowager's life, the Empress's conspiracy, and the mystery of her own background...

All the clues were like scattered pearls on the ground; she needed to pick them up one by one and string them into a complete chain in order to pull the Empress completely off her horse and seek justice for herself, for the Empress Dowager, and even for her family.

A smoke-free war had already entered its white-hot stage. And she was the only chess player capable of seeing the direction of every single piece.

chapters.title: The Empress's Inner Thoughts, the Framing Plot Becomes Clear
chapters.content:
Shen Qinghuan knelt outside the screen, the surrounding inner thoughts pouring in like a tidal wave. While maintaining her frail and sickly posture of prayer, she concentrated her mental energy on the Empress, the biggest tumor hidden beneath the magnificent phoenix robe.

The Empress wore a fitting expression of sorrow, occasionally picking up a handkerchief to gently wipe the corners of her eyes, as if she were truly a filial daughter-in-law worried about her mother-in-law's critical illness. However, her inner thoughts displayed a completely different, ferocious visage.

【This old hag should be about done for. The imperial physicians all say she won't last seven days. Hmph, the "Bone-Eroding Fragrance" I administered is naturally colorless, odorless, and even those stubborn old fools couldn't detect it! She's thrown her weight around her entire life, and now her time is up!】

【That bitch Shen Qinghuan actually dares to show her face! Good, she's come at just the right time. Once the Empress Dowager dies, this bitch will make the best scapegoat! I've already prepared the "evidence," a few cursed objects and several pieces of paper inscribed with words of malediction, all hidden away in her dilapidated room in the cold palace. When the time comes, I'll claim that she harbored resentment, cursed the Empress Dowager, and used witchcraft to murder her. No matter how reluctant His Majesty is, for the sake of the royal family's dignity and to provide an account for the Empress Dowager's death, he will have no choice but to have her hacked to a thousand pieces!】

Shen Qinghuan's fingers trembled imperceptibly. Sure enough, this Empress was so vicious that she intended to frame her with all the blame! And she had even prepared the "evidence," hiding it right in her dilapidated room in the cold palace!

This poisonous woman's meticulous mind and ruthless methods were simply appalling. She wanted not only the Empress Dowager's life, but her life as well, and even intended to saddle her with the crime of witchcraft and cursing the Empress Dowager, leaving her infamous for eternity!

【At that time, once the Empress Dowager dies, I will immediately burst into tears and faint, acting grief-stricken to the extreme. His Majesty will surely pity me. I'll then take the opportunity to push my maternal niece into the palace to solidify the status of the Empress's clan.】

【Once the Empress Dowager passes away, I can rightfully take charge of the Phoenix Seal without any further constraints. Those old ministers at court will also be intimidated by the Empress Dowager's death and won't dare to casually meddle in the affairs of the inner palace anymore. As for Uncle... it's about time to carry out the next step of the plan.】

The "Uncle" and the "next step of the plan" mentioned in the Empress's inner thoughts made Shen Qinghuan's nerves tense up once again.

"Uncle" was the Empress's biological older brother, the Minister of Personnel, and a second-rank official holding immense power at court. The secret agreement between the Empress and her uncle actually involved "court interests"?

Could this be related to more than just inner palace struggles? Could it involve the court, or even the succession of imperial power?

【Uncle said that as long as the Empress Dowager dies, dissidents can be thoroughly eliminated. Although His Majesty appears autocratic, he is actually indecisive; as long as we control public opinion and the court officials, this realm... will sooner or later belong to our Zhao family!】

A chill spread through the depths of Shen Qinghuan's heart. This was no longer as simple as merely plotting against the Empress Dowager! The Empress's ambition was actually grand enough to want to control the entire realm, and even hand over imperial power to her maternal Zhao family on a silver platter!

This had escalated to the level of treason and usurpation!

Could her father's "traitorous collusion with foreign enemies" case from back then also be related to the Zhao family? With the Zhao family's power being so vast, infiltrating the court and the common people, and even colluding with the jianghu's "Hundred Herbs Sect" to poison someone, could her father's crime back then also be a trap set by the Zhao family to eliminate dissidents?

In an instant, countless clues began to intertwine in Shen Qinghuan's mind. Her father's old case, the Empress Dowager's death, the Empress's ambition, Uncle's power, the "Bone-Eroding Fragrance" and the "Hundred Herbs Sect"...

She suddenly understood that she was not merely an abandoned consort swept into an inner palace struggle; she was a crucial figure pushed by fate to the center of the storm! The jade bracelet on her wrist was not just a mind-reading tool, but the key for her to unravel all the mysteries and even alter the pattern of the realm!

The greed and venom in the Empress's inner thoughts drove Shen Qinghuan's anger to its peak. She was going to make this poisonous woman taste the consequences of her own actions within the trap she had designed!

On the surface, Shen Qinghuan remained frail and submissive, but her fingernails had dug deep into her palms, forcefully suppressing the raging fury in her heart.

Consort Li's inner thoughts came through once again as she quietly sized up the Empress, muttering internally:

【That seductress of an Empress is acting really well. But the triumph deep in her eyes can't be hidden from me. Hmph, does she think she can rest easy once the Empress Dowager dies? I refuse to believe His Majesty will completely listen to her every word.】

Consort Li was not entirely brainless; she was merely deceived by the Empress's facade and failed to detect the deeper poisonous plot, but her vigilance was something Shen Qinghuan could utilize.

Consort De's inner thoughts also leaked out:

【The Empress Dowager is gravely ill, and my son has a strong prospect of ascending the throne. But if this Shen Qinghuan manages to stay, will His Majesty rekindle old feelings? No, I must find a way to make His Majesty thoroughly disgusted with her.】

Consort De's focus remained on the position of the crown prince. Her sense of threat from Shen Qinghuan's appearance meant that in certain aspects, her goals might align with the Empress's, though she was not an absolute ally of the Empress.

Everyone's inner thoughts were like a densely woven net, and Shen Qinghuan clearly saw every node in the net, as well as the intricate relationships among them.

She knew that she could not make a move right now; she had no chance of winning, and no evidence to prove that the Empress had poisoned and plotted against the Empress Dowager. The Empress controlled the imperial physicians, held the "evidence," and even had Uncle's support at court. She had to find the perfect timing for a counterattack.

And this timing had to be before the Empress Dowager passed away!

If the Empress Dowager died and the Empress immediately shifted the blame onto her, she would have a hundred mouths and still be unable to clear her name.

Within seven days, she had to bring the Empress Dowager out of danger and thoroughly expose the Empress's conspiracy for all to see, ruining her reputation completely!

Shen Qinghuan cast her gaze toward the Empress Dowager's bed. The Empress Dowager, with her eyes tightly closed, was her only hope and her only lifeline.

The "Bone-Eroding Fragrance" and "Hundred Herbs Sect" mentioned in Imperial Physician Wang's inner thoughts resurfaced in her mind.

The antidote! She had to find the antidote!

Or, find ironclad evidence proving that the Empress Dowager had been poisoned!

Shen Qinghuan's mind rapidly began to calculate.

Step one: Self-preservation. She must first deal with the batch of fabricated "witchcraft evidence" in the cold palace. This was the Empress's most direct method of framing her. She needed to quietly move or destroy this "evidence," leaving the Empress thinking her plan had succeeded, only to strike empty air.

Step two: Win the trust of the imperial physician and seek cooperation. She needed to make covert contact with Imperial Physician Wang and have him tell the truth. But how to protect his family? This was a tricky problem.

Step three: Find the antidote or evidence. If Imperial Physician Wang could provide more information about the "Bone-Eroding Fragrance" and the "Hundred Herbs Sect," she might find a breakthrough.

Step four: The timing for a counterattack. The timing of exposing the truth was paramount; it had to be when the Empress Dowager was at death's door, or when the Emperor came to visit, allowing her to deliver a decisive blow that left the Empress unable to refute it.

Shen Qinghuan knew that these seven days would be the most crucial seven days of her life.

She glanced over the people in the hall, who wore various masks and harbored their own hidden agendas in their hearts. And she, possessing the jade bracelet and the ability to pry into human hearts, would become the sole "god-view" player in this palace game.

The Emperor's inner thoughts came through once again, carrying a trace of helpless sigh:

【Imperial Mother... please hold on a little longer...】

【Shen Qinghuan... you... I truly have failed you...】

Shen Qinghuan's gaze landed once more on the Emperor. The Emperor's guilt was the soft spot in his heart and also a weakness she could exploit. He did not entirely trust the Empress; he was merely blinded and suppressed by the Empress's facade and her family's power.

And the Empress's remark that "Uncle... it's about time to carry out the next step of the plan" gave her a vague sense that the Empress Dowager's death was not just about the Empress monopolizing inner palace power, but the first step of the Qin family in subverting the court and even imperial power.

She felt as though she beheld a massive net shrouding the entire Daqi court and even the jianghu. And she, a former abandoned consort of the cold palace, had been swept into it, perhaps becoming the sole breaker of the game.

This discovery made the burden on her shoulders heavier, but at the same time, it ignited an even deeper fighting spirit within her.

She collated all the information from the inner thoughts, forming a clear tactical situation map of friend versus foe in her mind.

The Empress was the mastermind, Uncle was the accomplice, and perhaps even a greater mastermind behind the scenes.

Imperial Physician Lin and Imperial Physician Zhang were coerced individuals, while Imperial Physician Wang was a potential breakthrough point.

Consort Li and Consort De were bystanders with their own calculations, currently posing no substantial threat to her, and perhaps even becoming indirect assists.

The Emperor was a wavering and crucial figure whose intentions would determine the ultimate direction.

The Empress Dowager was the victim and also her lifeline.

Shen Qinghuan closed her eyes, masking all emotion in her gaze.

Right now, what she needed to do was wait for the opportunity.

An opportunity that would allow her to make a comeback against the wind and make all her enemies taste the consequences of their own actions.

An opportunity that would allow her to leap from an abandoned consort of the cold palace into a phoenix in control of the overall situation.

chapters.title: The Emperor's Inner Voice, Complex Emotions, and Suspicion
chapters.content:
Shen Qinghuan knelt outside the folding screen, the surrounding inner voices buzzing like a swarm of bees. But right now, her mental energy was entirely focused on the man clad in a bright yellow dragon robe, the Emperor of Daqi, Xiao Yan.

He was currently standing with his back to her, by the Empress Dowager's bedside. Beneath his wide dragon robe, his figure appeared somewhat weary. His hands tightly clasped the Empress Dowager's withered hands, and that filial devotion was so genuine in this moment.

[Mother... you must not be alright! I cannot lose you!]; this was the anguish of a son, straight from the marrow of his bones.

[Imperial Physician Lin, I command you, by whatever means necessary, protect the Empress! If any harm comes to her, I will not spare you!]; this was the majesty of an emperor, coupled with acute anxiety over the Empress Dowager's condition.

Yet, in the very next instant, his inner voice abruptly shifted. A web of complex emotions intertwined, causing Shen Qinghuan's heart to tighten in tandem.

[The Empress... she has acted so grief-stricken today. Is it genuine filial piety, or...?] During the Empress Dowager's critical illness, the Empress personally brewed and delivered medicine every single day, yet the Empress Dowager's condition has not improved; instead, she grows weaker by the day. Could there be hidden truths in all this that I am unaware of?

A flicker of elation stirred in Shen Qinghuan's heart. The Emperor was indeed not entirely foolish; he did not completely trust the Empress, and was even harboring suspicions! Without a doubt, this was her greatest asset in counterattacking the Empress! The Emperor's doubt would serve as the spark with which she would ignite the truth.

[The Zhao family... their power grows ever more formidable. The Lord Uncle holds absolute sway at court, and I am constrained at every turn. If the Empress Dowager were to pass away at this moment, the Zhao family would inevitably seize the opportunity to rise and completely hollow out my imperial authority. I cannot let such a thing happen!]

The Emperor's inner voice revealed his wariness and dread regarding the Zhao family's power. He knew of the Zhao family's ambitions and was guarding against them in secret. This indicated that he was not entirely hoodwinked by the Zhao family; rather, due to certain constraints, he was temporarily powerless to strike back.

[Shen Qinghuan... she has come as well. The last time she entered the Cold Palace, she was so resolute and filled with resentment, yet today she is so frail, and yet insists on coming to pay her respects to the Empress Dowager. Her intentions... are they true?]

[Is she truly as innocent as she appears on the surface? If not for her, why did Imperial Father back then...]

"If not for her, why did Imperial Father back then..."

These half-spoken words pierced like a sharp shard of ice straight into Shen Qinghuan's heart. Her father! The old case of the Shen family! The Emperor's inner voice once again inextricably linked her father's case to "her," Shen Qinghuan herself, and even to "Imperial Father," the late Emperor.

What on earth did this signify? Could it be that her father was not entirely innocent? Or was it that back then, while the case outwardly appeared to be her father's crime, it was actually meant to cover up an even deeper secret, and she, Shen Qinghuan, happened to be the "key" or the "sacrificial lamb" to that secret?

Did this have any connection to the "Jade-Guarding Clan" and the "jade pendant" mentioned in the Empress Dowager's inner voice? Could her father's case have been a purging of the Shen family carried out by the late Emperor for some specific purpose? And was the Empress Dowager aware of this, even feeling remorse toward Shen Qinghuan because of it, which was why she had always cherished her?

Shen Qinghuan's heartbeat accelerated. This "information" was simply too massive! It concerned not only her father's innocence, but her own destiny and the true secret of the jade bracelet!

She forcibly suppressed the turbulent waves within her heart and continued to listen to the Emperor's inner voice.

[I feel a sense of guilt toward Qinghuan... Back then, I readily believed slanderous words and, in a moment of impulse, cast her into the Cold Palace without conducting a thorough investigation. She was originally innocent, but now... she is an abandoned consort of the Cold Palace, finding it difficult ever to rise again. If I forcibly restore her rank, I fear it will trigger turmoil across the court, and the Zhao family will seize the opportunity to launch a rebellion.]

[But the Empress Dowager... the Empress Dowager has always cherished Qinghuan, and has even mentioned many times her hope that I would treat her well. If I can seize this opportunity to comfort the Empress Dowager and cause her condition to improve, even if only temporarily...]

The Emperor's inner voice revealed guilt and pity toward Shen Qinghuan, yet this emotion was suppressed by the pressures of reality and the consideration of solidifying imperial power. It wasn't that he didn't love Shen Qinghuan; rather, the responsibilities of an emperor and his dread of the Zhao family prevented him from acting as he pleased.

He wanted to use Shen Qinghuan to appease the Empress Dowager while simultaneously balancing the court factions to prevent the Zhao family from growing too arrogant. He was both a victim and a calculating monarch. He recognized Shen Qinghuan's value, and he recognized her predicament.

[Right now, the most important thing is the Empress Dowager's condition. If she can wake up, perhaps she can tell me some of the truth. As for Imperial Physician Lin... I always feel they are concealing something.]

The Emperor's suspicion of the imperial physicians coincided completely with Shen Qinghuan's discovery! Without a doubt, this was her greatest breakthrough. The Emperor harbored doubts about Imperial Physician Lin, yet was hamstrung by a lack of evidence. And Shen Qinghuan happened to hold the truth.

[If Shen Qinghuan can truly make the Empress Dowager improve, then... I might consider giving her some compensation. But this compensation can only be in secret; it must never shake the Empress's position on the surface.]

The Emperor's "compensation" to Shen Qinghuan was limited; he remained constrained by the Empress's power and influence. This made Shen Qinghuan clearly realize that to completely turn the tables, relying solely on the Emperor's pity and guilt was far from enough. She had to rely on her own strength to expose the Empress and leave the Emperor with no other choice!

Gradually, things became clear in Shen Qinghuan's mind: the Emperor's inner world was a complex game of chess. He possessed emotions, but valued statecraft and power far more. He did not completely trust the Empress, yet lacked core incriminating evidence against her. He felt guilt toward her, but that guilt was not enough to allow him to break through the constraints imposed by the Zhao family.

And she, Shen Qinghuan, would be the fulcrum to leverage this game.

She needed not only to expose the Empress's crimes, but also to utilize the Emperor's suspicion, his guilt, and his filial piety toward the Empress Dowager to ultimately achieve her own goals.

She began to ponder: How could she skillfully reveal the secret of the imperial physicians and the crimes of the Empress to the Emperor without exposing the ability of the jade bracelet?

To directly accuse the imperial physicians would cause them to die-hard deny out of fear of the Empress, and they might even turn around and bite her back.

To directly accuse the Empress without conclusive evidence would prevent the Emperor from fully believing it.

She needed a perfect entry point; an opportunity that would prompt the Emperor himself to investigate and discover the truth.

Quietly, Shen Qinghuan cast her gaze toward Imperial Physician Lin. He was currently lowering his head in deep thought, his inner voice filled with helplessness and dread.

[The commands of Her Majesty the Empress cannot be disobeyed. If I speak the truth, my entire family, old and young...]

She shifted her gaze to Imperial Physician Wang. Imperial Physician Wang cast intermittent glances toward the Empress Dowager, his eyes carrying reluctance and struggle.

[Her Ladyship the Empress Dowager... am I truly powerless? "Bone-Corroding Fragrance"... Legend has it that only the "Hundred Herbs Sect" can cure this poison, but the "Hundred Herbs Sect" vanished from the world many years ago...]

The "Hundred Herbs Sect" had been mentioned once more, further confirming the extraordinary origins of the poison.

Shen Qinghuan's breath hitched slightly. How could she make Imperial Physician Wang step forward willingly? Or, at the very least, allow her to find a lead on the "Hundred Herbs Sect"?

She realized that relying on herself alone, isolated in the information-starved Cold Palace, made it impossible to accomplish this task. She needed allies, intelligence, and power.

She had to make the Emperor generate a deeper level of suspicion regarding the Empress Dowager's condition, prompting him to conduct a thorough investigation on his own initiative.

She knew that the Emperor's inner voice had touched upon "Why did Imperial Father back then...?", which was undoubtedly the breakthrough point for her father's old case. The Empress Dowager had also mentioned the "jade pendant" and the "Jade-Guarding Clan." All of this pointed toward a colossal secret.

Her path of vengeance was not merely to wash away her grievances, but to unveil this astonishing secret hidden beneath the imperial power!

She repeatedly retraced this information in her mind, analyzing everyone's weaknesses and the points that could be exploited.

The Emperor's weaknesses: filial piety, dread of the Zhao family, thirst for the truth.

The Empress's weaknesses: ambition, suspicion, arrogance.

The imperial physicians' weaknesses: concern for their families, pursuit of medical mastery (Imperial Physician Wang).

Within Shen Qinghuan's mind, a bold plan gradually began to take shape. She would utilize the Empress Dowager's yearning for her, the Emperor's guilt toward her, and his suspicion of the imperial physicians to guide the Emperor into taking the initiative.

She poured all her focus into "eavesdropping" on the Emperor. This man held the power over her life and death, and also held the key to unlocking all the mysteries.

She would let him know that she was not merely an innocent abandoned consort; she also held secrets that he could not afford to ignore.

She would let him know that the Empress whom he trusted was the true venomous snake.

She would let him know that she, Shen Qinghuan, was the only one he could truly trust and the one who could help him stabilize the imperial court.

Shen Qinghuan took a deep breath. She knew she had to leave behind some "catalysts" during this meeting so that the Emperor, in his subsequent investigations, would remember her and direct his suspicions in the direction she had preset.

Imperceptibly, she raised her head, looking at the Emperor's back with eyes that seemed veiled in a layer of mist.

She wanted him to know that her existence was not just a memory of the past, but the crux of the future situation.

And she was ready, to undergo nirvanic rebirth amidst this bloody storm of the imperial court and take control of everything!

chapters.title: The Empress Dowager Regains Consciousness, Murmuring About Past Events
chapters.content:
Inside the Cining Palace, the oppressive atmosphere was like solidified lead, weighing heavily upon everyone's heart. In the incense burner by the Empress Dowager's bedside, sandalwood curled upwards, yet it failed to dispel the pervasive scent of medicine and the shadow of death.

Shen Qinghuan still knelt outside the folding screen, frail yet devout. However, her mental faculties had never been so intensely concentrated; all her perception was gathered in the faint heartbeat of the Empress Dowager and her blurred inner voice. She knew that within this seven-day limit, the Empress Dowager was her only hope.

Suddenly, a faint moan came from the bed, immediately followed by the sound of the Empress Dowager's throat struggling to swallow.

"Mother!" Emperor Xiao Yan's voice carried a trace of a tremor. He lunged forward, tightly grasping the Empress Dowager's withered hand.

Imperial Physicians Lin and Wang immediately stepped forward as well, anxiously observing the Empress Dowager's reactions.

Shen Qinghuan's heartbeat accelerated abruptly. She clearly "heard" the Empress Dowager's weak inner voice, which at this moment sounded somewhat clearer than before.

[It hurts so much... cough, cough... my whole body hurts... so cold...]

[Emperor... Emperor, you've come... Mother is not going to make it...]

Following that, the Empress Dowager's eyelids fluttered, and those clouded eyes slowly opened a crack under Imperial Physician Lin's calls.

Everyone in the hall held their breath.

"Mother, you're awake!" Xiao Yan's voice carried pleasant surprise and agitation.

The Empress Dowager slowly rolled her eyes, her dazed gaze sweeping across everyone in the hall. When her gaze landed on the Empress, a flash of imperceptible disgust and fear abruptly crossed those clouded pupils, though it lasted merely a fraction of a second, Shen Qinghuan captured it precisely.

The Empress's inner voice rang out immediately:

[This old hag, why hasn't she died yet? She actually woke up! Dammit! Could she have discovered something? Even if she did, there's neither proof nor evidence!]

Outwardly, she maintained a polite and appropriate look of concern, but deep within her eyes flashed a trace of imperceptible panic.

The Empress Dowager's gaze shifted away with difficulty, sweeping past Consort Li and Consort De, and finally, her line of sight crossed over the screen, vaguely landing in the direction where Shen Qinghuan was kneeling.

Though separated by the screen, Shen Qinghuan clearly "sensed" that within those eyes, a glimmer of light seemed to peer through, a long-lost warmth.

[Huan'er... is Huan'er here?] The Empress Dowager's hoarse voice came from the bed, so weak it was almost inaudible.

Xiao Yan hurried to say, "Yes, Mother. Qinghuan is here; she has been praying for you outside the screen this whole time."

The Empress Dowager seemed to receive confirmation, a faint, almost imperceptible smile appearing on her face.

[Huan'er... cough, cough... you have suffered...]

[Unjust... You were wronged...]

"Wronged!"

This single word exploded like a thunderclap in Shen Qinghuan's heart! The Empress Dowager really knew! She knew she had been wronged!

This word was simultaneously and clearly transmitted to the ears of Emperor Xiao Yan. His body violently stiffened, and the grip on the Empress Dowager's wrist involuntarily tightened.

"Mother, what did you say? What injustice?" Xiao Yan anxiously pursued, casting a gaze filled with deep contemplation and confusion toward Shen Qinghuan's direction.

The Empress's inner voice turned instantly sharp:

[Dammit! What is this old hag spouting nonsense about?! Wronged? Is she referring to Shen Qinghuan's case? Impossible! I clearly made it watertight!] She stared fixedly at the Empress Dowager, feeling restless and anxious within.

Consort Li's inner voice:

[Wronged? There really was something fishy about that case involving the abandoned consort of the Cold Palace back then? What does Her Ladyship the Empress Dowager mean by these words?]

Consort De's inner voice:

[This old hag wouldn't want to overturn the case right before she dies, would she? That won't do at all. If Shen Qinghuan can make a comeback, my son's position as Crown Prince...]

The Empress Dowager seemed not to hear Xiao Yan's inquiries. Her gaze grew somewhat unfocused again, and her voice became even weaker, faltering and intermittent as though sinking into some distant memory.

[And... that piece of jade... jade... cannot be given to the Zhao family...]

"That piece of jade!"

Shen Qinghuan's heart gave a violent leap! "That piece of jade" in the Empress Dowager's mouth formed a clear echo with the cold jade bracelet currently on her wrist! This jade bracelet was a relic from her mother! And the Empress Dowager's previous inner voice had also mentioned a "jade pendant" and the "Jade-Guarding Clan"!

This piece of jade must not be given to the Zhao family?! This indicated that the Zhao family might be coveting this jade, and perhaps even connected to the secret it held!

This piece of information pointed directly to the Empress's natal family, the Qin clan, and even linked the ambitions of the Qin clan to the jade bracelet on her wrist!

Xiao Yan's brow furrowed tightly, and his inner voice came again:

[Jade? What jade? What is Mother talking about? The Zhao family?]

[Mother just said "wronged"... Could Qinghuan's case truly hold hidden circumstances? The Zhao family... what on earth have they been hiding from me?]

The Emperor's suspicions were already beginning to be ignited by the Empress Dowager's words! This was precisely what Shen Qinghuan had hoped to see! The Empress Dowager's brief clarity was like parting a layer of mist before the Emperor's eyes.

The Empress Dowager's words continued, but her voice was now as weak as a mosquito's. Had it not been for Shen Qinghuan's mind-reading skill, it would have been entirely impossible to hear.

[Jade-Guarding... Tribe... ancestral precepts... Your Majesty... cough, cough... must not...]

[Back then... back then it was them... Your Majesty... do not repeat your mistakes...]

Within the Empress Dowager's inner voice, there was a vague leakage of anxiety regarding the ancestral precepts of the "Jade-Guarding Clan," alongside resentment and warnings directed at a certain "them." Who on earth were "they"? Did it refer to the Zhao family, or an even more mysterious force?

And that phrase, "Your Majesty, do not repeat your mistakes," was laden with a heavy warning tone. The Empress Dowager seemed to be admonishing the Emperor not to tread down the path of a past mistake. Did this error relate to her father's old case? Or to that piece of jade?

Imperial Physician Lin's inner voice was complex at this moment:

[Her Ladyship the Empress Dowager is muddled in her mind and speaking deliriously. The Emperor must not take these words seriously.]

Outwardly, he dared not speak aloud, but inwardly, he desperately wanted to guide the Emperor into attributing the Empress Dowager's words to delirious ravings brought on by illness.

As for the Empress's inner voice, it was a mess of panic and annoyance:

[Damn old hag! Spewing utter nonsense even as she's dying! What jade? What injustice? What Zhao family! Just what does she know?!]

Her sharp gaze swept across Shen Qinghuan, as though guessing whether Shen Qinghuan had heard anything from the Empress Dowager.

Shen Qinghuan lowered her eyelids, concealing all her emotions deep within her heart. Although the Empress Dowager's lucidity was brief, the information she revealed was like sparks, already beginning to ignite a raging fire of suspicion within Xiao Yan's heart.

The Empress Dowager lapsed back into a coma, but the keywords she had murmured, "wronged," "that piece of jade," "the Zhao family," "the Jade-Guarding Clan," were branded like seals into the hearts of both Shen Qinghuan and Xiao Yan.

Xiao Yan looked at the Empress Dowager, who had plunged back into unconsciousness, his expression growing increasingly heavy. He turned back to look at Shen Qinghuan, a deeper sense of probing and complexity in his eyes.

[She... was she truly wronged back then? Why is Mother so fixated on her...]

Shen Qinghuan knew that this suspicion held by the Emperor had paved the way for her subsequent actions. She was no longer an isolated and helpless abandoned consort of the Cold Palace; she had the Empress Dowager as a "stubbornly lingering" backing, and furthermore, she possessed this wavering trust from the Emperor.

She raised her head slightly, her gaze intersecting with the Emperor's for a fleeting second. In that glance, she revealed no sorrow or resentment; there was only a frail calmness and... a trace of imperceptible depth. She wanted the Emperor to feel that she was not a simple person; she possessed her secrets, and her own bargaining chips.

Xiao Yan withdrew his gaze, always feeling that today's Shen Qinghuan seemed somewhat different. The calm and resilience faintly revealed beneath that frailty gave him an inexplicable sense of familiarity and palpitations.

He looked back at Imperial Physician Lin: "Imperial Physician Lin, could what the Empress Dowager just said carry any deeper meaning?"

Imperial Physician Lin's face turned pale as he bowed and said, "Reporting to Your Majesty: the Empress Dowager is critically ill, her mind is muddled, and much of what she says is dream-babble. Your Majesty need not take it to heart."

[Dammit! Why is the Emperor pursuing this! I cannot speak the truth! The lives of my entire family...]

Behind Imperial Physician Lin, a trace of struggle flashed in Imperial Physician Wang's eyes. He wanted to speak up, but was awed by Imperial Physician Lin's inner voice, and in the end, he remained silent.

Inwardly, Shen Qinghuan sighed softly. It seemed that just a few delirious utterances from the Empress Dowager were still not enough to make the imperial physicians break the Empress's shackles. She needed a more direct stimulus.

However, the information just revealed by the Empress Dowager was already sufficient for her ensuing plan.

"Wronged," "that piece of jade," "the Zhao family," "the Jade-Guarding Clan"... These clues would string together her father's old case, the Empress's conspiracy, and the secret of the jade bracelet.

She knew she had to act as quickly as possible. The seven-day limit would pass in the blink of an eye.

A true struggle for power officially commenced amidst the Empress Dowager's brief lucidity and a few vague murmurs. And Shen Qinghuan, grasping mind-reading, had already seized the initiative.

chapters.title: The First Hint, Leading Them into the Trap
chapters.content:
Inside the Cining Palace, the atmosphere grew increasingly oppressive. After a brief moment of lucidity, the Empress Dowager's condition took a sharp turn for the worse; her breathing grew even weaker, and her complexion was as pale as paper. The medicinal smell pervading the air grew thicker, pressing down on people's chests until it was hard to breathe.

The Empress's proper face was now plastered with "grief" and "anxiety." From time to time, she gently stroked the Empress Dowager's forehead, calling out to her softly. Yet, Shen Qinghuan clearly "heard" the irrepressible wild joy deep within her heart.

[This old hag is finally going to die! The "Bone-Eroding Fragrance" is truly formidable; once its medicinal properties take effect, even old man Lin is at his wit's end! She is bound to die!]

[When the time comes, I will be able to rest easy once and for all and seize absolute power! As for that bitch Shen Qinghuan, she can just wait to be buried with the Empress Dowager!]

Shen Qinghuan sneered inwardly. The Empress was preparing to launch her "final blow"! Her current euphoria happened to be her best flaw.

She looked at Xiao Yan. The Emperor's face was filled with worry and exhaustion; he tightly gripped the Empress Dowager's hand, a deep sorrow knitted between his brows. He did not entirely believe Imperial Physician Lin's "gibberish." Those two words, "injustice" and "jade," were like two thorns pricking at his heart, leaving him unable to find peace. From time to time, his gaze swept over Shen Qinghuan and the imperial physicians, carrying a silent urge and anticipation within his eyes.

Shen Qinghuan knew the time had come. Before the Empress could make her move, she had to light that fuse.

Slowly and with great difficulty, she propped herself up. Every step she took was extremely sluggish, as if each one exhausted every ounce of her strength. Her face was pale, her lips tinged with blue, and her tottering figure looked as though she might collapse at any moment.

"Qinghuan, you are unwell. You needn't keep kneeling." Xiao Yan saw her struggle, a trace of pity in his voice.

Shen Qinghuan shook her head weakly, her voice hoarse: "This concubine... wishes to be closer to the Empress Dowager... to pray for her..."

She inched step by step toward the Empress Dowager's couch, coming closer to the positions of Imperial Physician Lin and Imperial Physician Wang. She saw Imperial Physician Wang bowing his head to tidy his medicine chest. Next to him lay a few packages of herbs, one of which emitted a faint, delicate fragrance and had just been taken out.
