As she drew near the medicine chest, she deliberately tripped heavily, her body tilting forward out of control.

"Ah..." she let out a faint exclamation, her body looking as though it was about to crash right into Imperial Physician Lin's medicine chest.

"Careful!" Xiao Yan cried out instinctively, wanting to step forward to catch her, but he was too far away to reach her in time.

Imperial Physician Wang was quick-witted and sharp-eyed; he grabbed Shen Qinghuan, preventing her from falling. However, Imperial Physician Lin's medicine chest was still knocked over "inadvertently" by her, sending the herbs inside scattering across the floor, including that very package of herbs emitting the delicate fragrance.

"I'm sorry... Imperial Physician Wang... This concubine was clumsy..." Shen Qinghuan's face grew even paler, fine beads of sweat breaking out on her forehead, making it look as though she truly lacked the physical strength to stand.

Imperial Physician Wang quickly said, "As long as Your Ladyship is unhurt, these herbs don't matter." He bent down and began to pick up the scattered medicinal materials.

Right at that moment, Shen Qinghuan looked down at the scattered herbs on the floor with eyes that seemed glazed over with a layer of mist, as if she had only just caught sight of them by chance. Her voice was extremely low, carrying the weakness of illness and feigned ignorance of medicine, yet every single word clearly reached the ears of Imperial Physician Wang and the Emperor.

"This... what kind of herb is this? Why... why is there a hint of... a faint pungent smell to it? This concubine has heard... that there is a certain poison... which also smells pungent, and after taking it... it causes the body to itch unbearably, as though ten thousand ants were gnawing at the heart... and ultimately... ultimately causes a person's entire body to ulcerate and die..."

Her voice grew softer and softer, as if she had exhausted all her remaining strength, before she gave a few light coughs, weakly supporting herself on Imperial Physician Wang's arm and putting on an appearance of being unable to hold herself up.

Yet, these few remarks of hers were like a thunderclap, instantly exploding in the hearts of Imperial Physician Wang and the Emperor!

Imperial Physician Wang's hand trembled violently. He picked up the package of herbs on the ground that emitted that pungent, delicate fragrance, shock and terror suddenly flashing in his eyes.

[Pungent smell... ten thousand ants gnawing at the heart... whole body ulcerating... How could she possibly know about these?! This... aren't these the symptoms after the "Bone-Eroding Fragrance" takes effect?! She... how could she know the side effects of the "Bone-Eroding Fragrance"?!]

Imperial Physician Wang's inner voice was filled with shock and panic. Almost instinctively, he tightly clutched that package of herbs in his hand, his terrified gaze fixing upon Shen Qinghuan.

Shen Qinghuan sensed the turmoil within Imperial Physician Wang's heart. She knew her "lead-in" had been successfully planted.

Emperor Xiao Yan also knitted his brows at this moment. His sharp gaze darted to the herbs on the ground, then to Imperial Physician Wang, and finally back to Shen Qinghuan, his inner voice filled with doubt and confusion.

[Pungent smell? Whole body ulcerating? This Shen Qinghuan... how would she know about these things? She is a discarded consort in the Cold Palace who usually only interacts with coarse-handed matrons; how could she understand the symptoms of such rare poisons? Could it be... could it be that she really knows something?!]

[Before her death, Mother said "injustice," and also mentioned the "Zhao family" and "jade"... And now Shen Qinghuan brings up the symptoms of the poison... Among all this, there must be a connection of which I am unaware!]

Xiao Yan's suspicion had reached its peak! Shen Qinghuan's seemingly casual words directly stimulated the most sensitive nerve in his heart. He knew the Empress Dowager had been poisoned, and he suspected the Empress; now, for Shen Qinghuan to happen to describe symptoms similar to those of the "Bone-Eroding Fragrance," this was by no means a coincidence!

As for the Empress's inner voice, it was a state of swirling suspicion and uncertainty:

[What is this bitch babbling about?! A discarded consort from the Cold Palace, how would she know these things?! Does she know something?! Impossible! She has never set foot out of the Cold Palace; how could she possibly know the secret of the "Bone-Eroding Fragrance"? Could it be the Empress Dowager? Did the Empress Dowager reveal something when she woke up? Damn it!]

The Empress's gaze was like a poisoned arrow, nailing itself firmly into Shen Qinghuan. Though she remained calm on the surface, her heart was already churning with towering waves, and she even began to wonder if Shen Qinghuan was trying to bluff her.

Shen Qinghuan weakly closed her eyes, as if she had slipped back into unconsciousness. She could not let the Empress detect any abnormality in her; she needed to maintain this facade of "frail ignorance."

Imperial Physician Wang clutched the package of herbs, his inner struggle reaching its absolute limit. The symptoms Shen Qinghuan had just described were almost identical to the miserable state after the "Bone-Eroding Fragrance" took effect! The sense of justice inherent in him as a healer, along with his anxiety over the Empress Dowager's condition, had been inadvertently ignited by Shen Qinghuan at that moment.

[This Shen Qinghuan... where on earth did she find out about this?! Could it be that she isn't innocent, but rather... an insider?! If she really knows something, then the Empress Dowager's poison...]

[No! I cannot let the Empress Dowager die like this, with her grievances unredressed! This poison, I must find a way...]

A craving for the "truth" and a sense of "justice" flashed through Imperial Physician Wang's mind. Subconsciously, he cast his gaze toward the package of herbs. Shen Qinghuan's words had undoubtedly planted a seed of doubt deep within his heart. He began to wonder whether the herbs he routinely handled also harbored similar "pungent smells" or "toxic properties."

And this was precisely what Shen Qinghuan had hoped for. She did not need Imperial Physician Wang to stand up and accuse the Empress right away; she only needed to plant the seed of doubt in his heart, prompting him to start actively thinking, observing, and searching for clues.

She knew that Imperial Physician Wang was a healer, and healers possessed the instinctive urge to save lives and heal the wounded. Once he began to doubt and connected it to the poison the Empress Dowager had suffered from, he would seek out the truth for the sake of his medical ethics and his own conscience.

Xiao Yan's gaze shifted back and forth between Shen Qinghuan, Imperial Physician Wang, and the Empress. Although he could not hear Imperial Physician Wang's inner voice, he saw shock and deep contemplation in the physician's eyes.

[Shen Qinghuan... her words are not entirely groundless. Imperial Physician Wang's reaction is so violent; could there really be something wrong with these herbs?]

[I must thoroughly reinvestigate this matter in private. As for Imperial Physician Lin... he is likely being threatened by the Empress. But Imperial Physician Wang... he seems to be wavering.]

The scale in Xiao Yan's heart had begun to tilt toward Shen Qinghuan. He no longer viewed her as a simple discarded consort of the Cold Palace, but rather as a wronged individual who might hold the key to certain secrets.

He looked at Eunuch Su beside him, a trace of an imperceptible command flashing in his eyes. Eunuch Su immediately understood and quietly withdrew from the hall. He was going to make arrangements for a private investigation.

A sense of relief washed over Shen Qinghuan inwardly. She knew her first hint had succeeded. The Emperor's suspicion and Imperial Physician Wang's doubt had both been successfully ignited by her.

All she needed to do was quietly wait for this spark to rage into a prairie fire.

Inside the hall, although the Empress maintained a calm expression, deep down, she felt an unprecedented sense of crisis. She stared fixedly at Shen Qinghuan, as if she wanted to see right through her. She always felt that today, this discarded consort of the Cold Palace was somewhat unusual.

At the opportune moment, Shen Qinghuan gave a few more light coughs, her body trembling slightly as if she were about to collapse at any moment.

"Your Majesty... This concubine... this concubine feels a bit dizzy..." she said weakly.

Xiao Yan immediately stepped forward and supported her arm: "Qinghuan, go rest in the back. Eunuch Su will arrange for someone to escort you back to the Cold Palace."

[I cannot let anything happen to her here. If something happens to her, Mother will likely become even more unsettled. Besides... she may truly know something; I need time to verify it.]

Shen Qinghuan obediently curtsied: "Thank you for Your Majesty's grace."

She slowly stood up, every step as heavy as if her legs were filled with lead. She departed the Cining Palace, knowing full well that the seed she had left behind was already beginning to stir up ripples deep within the palace walls.

Imperial Physician Wang still gripped that package of herbs, staring at it with a complex look in his eyes.

The Emperor gazed deeply at the Empress Dowager, already plotting how to conduct a thorough, private investigation in his mind.

As for the Empress, standing behind them, she tracked Shen Qinghuan's departure with a gaze that bordered on venomous, her heart filled with bewilderment and vigilance.

Shen Qinghuan knew she had to bring the truth to light within these seven days. And right now, she had taken the most crucial first step.

chapters.title: The "Coincidental" Exposure of Evidence
chapters.content:
The atmosphere inside the Cining Palace grew even more oppressive due to the worsening condition of the Empress Dowager, and undercurrents churned because of Shen Qinghuan's "unintentional" words just moments before. The seeds of suspicion had already been sown by the Emperor, Xiao Yan, and doubts had sprouted in Imperial Physician Wang, but Shen Qinghuan knew this was still not enough to utterly crush the Empress. She needed more direct, more devastating evidence.

Supported by a trusted maid of Eunuch Su, she walked slowly out of the main hall of the Cining Palace, making her way along the long, covered veranda. Outwardly, she appeared utterly frail, but in reality, her mind was in a state of high concentration. The jade bracelet on her wrist emitted a faint, cooling sensation, capturing every single inner voice in the vicinity.

Just now, she had deliberately paid attention to the inner thoughts of Imperial Physician Lin. This physician, who had been bought off and threatened by the Empress, was filled with inner terror and struggle.

[Dammit! Why won't the Empress Dowager just die?! His Majesty is already starting to suspect something. If this drags on and the truth comes out, I'm afraid I won't keep my head!]

[The banknotes given by the Empress, did I hide them securely enough? And that "prescription adjustment annotation," I must never let anyone find it! That's the evidence of me bribing the eunuch to alter the Empress Dowager's dosage!]

Shen Qinghuan's heart stirred. Banknotes and prescription annotations! This was precisely the ironclad proof she needed!

At this moment, Imperial Physician Lin was following the Emperor with a flustered expression to handle the Empress Dowager's condition. Having been unsettled by Shen Qinghuan's "nonsense" just moments before, he was now attempting to reorganize his medicine chest to prevent the Emperor from discovering anything amiss.

An idea struck Shen Qinghuan. She had to make these items "coincidentally" expose themselves before Imperial Physician Lin could thoroughly conceal them.

She continued walking outward, deliberately slowing her pace, swaying her body a few times as if she were about to faint at any moment. Passing a turn in the corridor, her steps grew weak, and her body lurched, directly crashing into the wall.

"Ow!" she let out a faint cry of pain, her body sliding down smoothly as she slumped limply to the ground.

The maid supporting her was startled and hurriedly helped her up. "Consort Shen, are you alright?"

"I... my head is spinning so much..." Shen Qinghuan clutched her forehead, putting on an appearance of utmost frailty.

The very second she fell, the jade bracelet on her wrist glowed faintly, and she clearly "heard" the inner thoughts of Imperial Physician Lin. At that moment, Imperial Physician Lin was hurriedly walking out from the main hall, preparing to head to the dispensary.

[Hurry! Hurry! His Majesty wants me to go brew the medicine immediately! I must hurry and dispose of these things to avoid prolonged nights and dreams of trouble!]

Seizing the opportunity while she sat collapsed on the ground and the maid was bent over supporting her, Shen Qinghuan seemingly unintentionally extended her finger, lightly hooking a flash of silver. That silver flash was precisely the banknote Imperial Physician Lin had hidden inside his sleeve pocket, intending to stuff it deep into the inner layer of his robes at the first opportunity.

She knew from his inner thoughts that this banknote was proof of his heavy bribery by the Empress, and it even bore the personal seal of Her Majesty.

At the same time, she deliberately tilted her body slightly backward, her back lightly brushing against the ground. Not far behind her, while Imperial Physician Lin had been frantically organizing his medicine chest earlier, a crumpled piece of paper had accidentally slipped out through a gap in the chest. At this moment, it lay quietly on the ground, enveloped in a patch of shadow.

This slip of paper was the "prescription adjustment annotation" mentioned in Imperial Physician Lin's inner thoughts; it recorded with special techniques the traces of how the Empress Dowager's medicine dosage had been quietly altered, along with some notes on the side effects of certain medicinal herbs. It was the criminal evidence of the Empress instructing him to tamper with the medicine.

The scene of Shen Qinghuan's fall was caught precisely by a trusted follower of Eunuch Su who was trailing behind the Emperor; a young eunuch named Xiao Anzi. Xiao Anzi was Xiao Yan's confidant since childhood, clever by nature and utterly loyal to the Emperor.

Seeing Shen Qinghuan fall so ill and weak, Xiao Anzi felt a pang of pity and was about to step forward to help when he suddenly caught sight of something flashing under the moonlight on the ground right where Shen Qinghuan had slipped.

He stepped forward and, by the dim light of the lantern, unexpectedly discovered a crumpled piece of paper on the ground.

[Huh? What is this?] Xiao Anzi wondered to himself, reaching out to pick it up. He habitually unfolded the paper, but upon seeing the contents, his pupils abruptly constricted.

The slip of paper was chillingly recorded in a special handwriting:

"Empress Dowager's prescription: Astragalus halved, motherwort increased by one qian, monkshood... trace amounts, pay attention to dryness and heat. This is an imperial inner court urgent decree; ensure utmost secrecy."

Although Xiao Anzi was not an imperial physician, he had served the Emperor for many years and had some passing familiarity with palace medicinal herbs. He knew that monkshood was highly toxic, and even trace amounts could cause extreme damage to the body! As for the increase and decrease of astragalus and motherwort, while seemingly ordinary, under certain circumstances they could react antagonistically with other herbs and worsen a patient's condition! More importantly, the words "imperial inner court urgent decree" and the handwriting vaguely seemed somewhat similar to the script of a certain close attendant by the Empress's side!

[This... isn't this the Empress Dowager's prescription?! Monkshood?! Who dares to give monkshood to the Empress Dowager?! And they call it an "imperial inner court urgent decree"?!] Massive waves crashed in Xiao Anzi's heart, and a huge wave of fear and suspicion instantly enveloped him. He immediately linked this to the Empress Dowager's suddenly worsened condition and Shen Qinghuan's "unintentional" words from earlier.

At that exact moment, the corner of his eye caught sight of Shen Qinghuan being helped up by the maid. Her weak fingers seemed to brush against something, and then a corner of something slightly peeked out from Imperial Physician Lin's sleeve pocket.

Without thinking much, Xiao Anzi tightly clenched the paper in his hand, swept a vigilant gaze across his surroundings, and then seamlessly followed after Shen Qinghuan while secretly observing Imperial Physician Lin.

Imperial Physician Lin was currently hurrying past them, his inner thoughts filled with agitation and unease:

[Dammit! That bitch Shen Qinghuan! His Majesty is starting to suspect something; I must hurry and dispense the medicine, then dispose of these hot potatoes!]

He subconsciously touched his sleeve pocket, and relief washed over his heart.

[Good, the banknotes are still there.]

However, the exact moment he brushed past Shen Qinghuan and accelerated his pace, the banknote Shen Qinghuan had hooked out, due to her frail body and "unsteady" movement, happened to catch lightly, yet with pinpoint precision, against the edge of a protruding stone brick near Imperial Physician Lin's cuff.

Rip...

A sound of fabric tearing so faint as to be practically imperceptible was nearly lost in the silent night.

Yet, Xiao Anzi's ears caught it sharply. His gaze locked onto the scene as he saw a corner of Imperial Physician Lin's sleeve pocket torn open into a small slit.

Immediately following that, a stack of neatly folded banknotes slid smoothly out from the torn slit, dropping straight to the ground beside Imperial Physician Lin's feet.

Imperial Physician Lin was completely oblivious. Anxious to hurry and dispense the medicine, he paid no attention to the anomaly at his feet.

But Xiao Anzi saw it crystal clear! He even caught sight of a familiar phoenix pattern vaguely showing on the edge of the banknotes; that was the personal seal of the Empress!

[Banknotes! They're banknotes! And they have the Empress's seal on them! This Imperial Physician Lin... has he really been bought off by the Empress?!]

The shock in Xiao Anzi's heart was beyond measure. He instantly understood that this was by no means a coincidence! A piece of paper with bizarre prescription annotations, a stack of banknotes bearing the Empress's personal seal; both had been "coincidentally" discovered by him within a mere span of time! And all of this had happened after Shen Qinghuan appeared and "unintentionally" touched the medicine chest!

He recalled the Emperor's earlier guilt toward Shen Qinghuan, the Empress Dowager's utterance of "injustice," and Shen Qinghuan's words about "a pungent smell and full-body ulceration"...

Everything connected!

Shen Qinghuan hadn't stumbled upon this by chance; she was deliberately guiding events! Although frail, she possessed a level of insight unreachable by ordinary people!

Hesitating no longer, taking advantage of the moment when Shen Qinghuan and the maid had walked far away and Imperial Physician Lin had strode off quickly, Xiao Anzi swiftly bent down and picked up the banknotes from the ground. He carefully tucked both the banknotes and the slip of paper into his bosom.

[This is an earth-shattering secret! I must report this to His Majesty immediately!]

In his inner thoughts, aside from shock, there burned a surge of loyalty toward the Emperor and hatred toward the Empress. He knew that if this evidence proved true, the Empress's crimes would be utterly unpardonable!

Though Shen Qinghuan had walked far away, the range of the jade bracelet was sufficient for her to clearly capture every tremor of Xiao Anzi's inner thoughts.

A cold, imperceptible smirk curled the corner of her lips.

Very well.

She had precisely utilized Imperial Physician Lin's panic, Xiao Anzi's loyalty and cleverness, and the disguise of "coincidence" to deliver the most vital evidence right into the hands of the person the Emperor trusted most.

This evidence, combined with the Empress Dowager's earlier words of "injustice" and "jade," along with Shen Qinghuan's "unintentional" mention of the poison's side effects earlier, was enough to make the Emperor immediately launch a secret investigation and swiftly lock onto Imperial Physician Lin and the Empress!

She knew that upon seeing this evidence, the Emperor's inner thoughts would erupt with immense fury and shock. And that shock would be her most powerful weapon in her subsequent counterattack against the Empress.

Shen Qinghuan was helped back to the Cold Palace by the maid. Along the way, she maintained her sickly and feeble facade on the outside, but inside, her mind surged with vast waves.

She recalled that in Imperial Physician Lin's inner thoughts, aside from his terror of the Empress and the banknotes, a faint trace of a clue regarding the "Outer Palace" had flashed by.

[This prescription was passed down from the "Outer Palace"; the Empress is merely the middleman...]

"Outer Palace"? What did that mean? Were they people from outside the palace? Or some secret organization outside the imperial grounds?

This made her realize that the Empress was not acting alone; behind her, a larger, deeper faction might be hidden. Was this connected to the "Hundred Herbs Sect" she had heard about earlier?

This clue of the "Outer Palace" undoubtedly laid down an even deeper foreshadowing for the plot to come. The fall of the Empress was merely the first step; the true enemy might still be lurking behind the scenes, waiting to be unmasked.

Shen Qinghuan returned to the Cold Palace. Sitting on the dilapidated bed, she looked at the jade bracelet on her wrist emitting a faint glow.

This game had only just begun. And she had already delivered a ticking time bomb with absolute precision straight to the Empress's feet.

Now, it all depended on when that bomb would detonate.

chapters.title: The Emperor's Fury, the Empress Investigated
chapters.content:
Late at night, in the Hall of Mental Cultivation within the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

Candlelight flickered, illuminating the livid face of Emperor Xiao Yan behind the dragon desk. His eyes were bloodshot, the veins bulging on his tightly clenched fists. Right before him on the desk lay the crumpled, annotated medical prescription and a stack of bank notes bearing the Empress's private seal.

Xiao Anzi knelt on the floor, trembling with terror, reporting everything he had seen and heard to Xiao Yan, including the poison symptoms Shen Qinghuan had "unintentionally" mentioned.

"Your Majesty, every word this slave has spoken is true! This slave would never dare to utter a single falsehood!" Xiao Anzi's voice shook, cold sweat soaking his inner garment.

Xiao Yan remained silent, simply staring dead at the evidence. His inner voice at that moment was like a volcanic eruption, the magma of his rage almost consuming his entire being.

[The Zhao woman! What a Zhao woman! What a supreme Empress of the realm! How dare she plot against my birth mother?! How dare she tamper with the Empress Dowager's prescription?! Astragalus halved, motherwort increased by an ounce... a trace of aconite?! And that Imperial Physician Lin actually dared to go along with it! Do they all take me for a fool?!]

[Shen Qinghuan... She... how could she possibly know these things? Those words of hers... could they be true? Did she deliberately lead me to discover this evidence?! To think she possesses such cunning and means?!]

Anger, shock, disbelief, and a newfound scrutiny toward Shen Qinghuan intertwined in Xiao Yan's heart. He recalled the Empress Dowager's cry of "injustice," and then Shen Qinghuan's deep, calm eyes. Right now, all the clues pointed to a horrifying truth; the Empress, a woman of the Zhao clan, had attempted to murder the Empress Dowager and frame Shen Qinghuan!

"Guards!" Xiao Yan slammed his hand down on the dragon desk, producing a deafening crash.

The guards and eunuchs on duty outside the hall shuddered and hastily dropped to their knees.

"Go at once and drag Imperial Physician Lin to me in chains! Furthermore, place the Empress's residence under strict guard; no one is permitted to enter or leave!" Xiao Yan's voice carried an irrepressible fury, every single word seemingly squeezed out from between his teeth.

"Y-Your will is obeyed!" Eunuch Su hurriedly acknowledged the command, then rushed out of the study with a retinue of guards.

Immediately afterward, Xiao Yan turned his gaze to Xiao Anzi: "Interrogate every single physician, maid, and eunuch who handled the Empress Dowager's prescription tonight! Not a single one is to be missed!"

"This slave obeys!" Receiving his orders, Xiao Anzi sprang up and strode away.

Xiao Yan sat upon the dragon throne, his body trembling slightly from rage. He closed his eyes; in his mind's eye, he saw the tragic sight of the Empress Dowager on the brink of death, and then the pale, helpless face of Shen Qinghuan. He had once believed himself to be a just and brilliant sovereign, yet he never imagined that right under his very nose, such a treasonous and deranged atrocity had taken place!

[The Zhao woman! How dare she! Does she think I am unaware that her Zhao clan's power has swelled over the years, casting covetous eyes upon both the outer court and the inner palace? Does she think I do not know she has been secretly colluding with officials to hollow out my imperial authority?! And now, she actually dares to strike at my own mother! Her crimes are unforgivable!]

[Shen Qinghuan... her jade bracelet... the jade spoken of by the Empress Dowager... the Zhao clan... What connection is there between all of this? Could it be that the Zhao clan is plotting not just for the throne of the inner palace, but for something even deeper... the secret of that jade?]

Xiao Yan's suspicions had escalated from the mere murder of the Empress Dowager to a suspicion of high treason by the Zhao clan. The fury in his heart far exceeded anything anyone could imagine.

The Hall of Eternal Spring.

Empress Zhao sat anxiously inside her bedchamber. The palace maid she had sent out to gather information had yet to return, and the Empress Dowager's brief spell of lucidity, coupled with Shen Qinghuan's "ramblings," filled her with a profound sense of unease.

"Someone come! Go and inquire again! How is the Empress Dowager precisely? Has that bitch been spouting more nonsense?" the Empress commanded anxiously.

Just at that moment, the sound of hurried and chaotic footsteps suddenly echoed from outside the bedchamber.

"By imperial decree! Her Majesty the Empress shall receive the decree!"

Eunuch Su's shrill voice rang out from outside the hall, carrying an unusual, bone-chilling coldness.

The Empress's heart tightened, a vague sense of foreboding washing over her. She hurriedly smoothed her robes, walked out to the hall doors, and knelt in salute: "This concubine respectfully welcomes the Emperor's decree!"

However, Eunuch Su did not proclaim any decree; instead, he simply waved his hand. A group of fully armed imperial guards flooded into the Hall of Eternal Spring like a tide, sealing off the entire palace tightly.

"Eunuch Su, what is the meaning of this?" The Empress's expression underwent a drastic change, her premonition amplifying instantly.

Eunuch Su remained expressionless, his voice chillingly devoid of any emotion: "Empress, by imperial decree, the case of the Empress Dowager's poisoning is of paramount importance. His Majesty has ordered this servant to thoroughly search the Hall of Eternal Spring. Until the truth of the case comes to light, the Empress is not permitted to step even half a step outside the Hall of Eternal Spring!"

"What?!" The Empress abruptly stood up, her eyes filled with disbelief and panic.

[Poisoned? A thorough investigation?! How is this possible?! How did the Emperor find out? Who leaked the news?! Imperial Physician Lin?! Or that bitch Shen Qinghuan?!]

"Eunuch Su! This palace is the Empress! The Emperor actually suspects me?!" The Empress forced herself to remain calm, attempting to use her status to suppress Eunuch Su.

Eunuch Su was unmoved: "This is His Majesty's decree. It would be best for the Empress to cooperate with the investigation. Guards! Detain every single maid and eunuch in the Hall of Eternal Spring! Search thoroughly for any and all suspicious items!"

The imperial guards and eunuchs swung into action immediately, storming every corner of the Hall of Eternal Spring and beginning to rummage through chests and cabinets.

Watching this chaotic scene, the Empress's inner voice was filled with terror and boiling rage:

[Xiao Yan! How dare you! How dare you treat me this way?! I have borne children for you and managed your inner court! Just because of a few rambling words from that bitch, you dare to place me under investigation?!]

[Damn it! Who was it? Who leaked the secret? That trash Imperial Physician Lin! If it truly was him, I will make him wish he were dead!]

She stared fixedly at Eunuch Su, trying to read something from his face, but he remained like an icy sculpture.

At that moment, a guard stepped forward and whispered a few words into Eunuch Su's ear. Su's expression grew even heavier.

"Empress," Eunuch Su looked at her, his tone freezing, "Imperial Physician Lin has already confessed to a portion of his crimes. You would do well to consider how you will report to His Majesty; once implicated, regret will come too late!"

"Imperial Physician Lin?! He confessed?! That useless piece of trash!" The Empress's mind reeled, her complexion instantly turning as pale as paper. She knew that once Imperial Physician Lin confessed, her crimes could no longer be concealed!

[Xiao Yan! How could you treat this palace thus?! My Zhao clan will not let you go! You dare to investigate me?! Aren't you afraid I will expose the scandalous secrets from before your ascension]

The Empress's hatred for Xiao Yan reached its absolute peak. She even roared threats against the Emperor in her heart, hinting that before Xiao Yan ascended the throne, the Zhao clan had helped him cover up certain unmentionable "scandals." This "hook" once again hinted at a deeper, darker transaction and secret existing between the Emperor, the Empress, and the Zhao clan as a whole.

Meanwhile, the Cining Palace (Cining Palace).

Following the removal of Imperial Physician Lin, the speed at which the Empress Dowager's condition was worsening miraculously slowed down. Seized by unease after Lin was taken away, Imperial Physician Wang had proactively reported to the Emperor that the poison afflicting the Empress Dowager bore an extreme resemblance to the symptoms of "Bone-Corroding Fragrance" which he had once seen in ancient texts, and he thoughtfully mentioned Shen Qinghuan's description of the poisoning symptoms.

Hearing this from Imperial Physician Wang, Xiao Yan found his suspicions corroborated, cementing his belief that Shen Qinghuan's words had not been unintentional.

Under Xiao Yan's orders, Imperial Physician Wang was given a free hand to cautiously administer antidotes to the Empress Dowager based on his knowledge. Though the poison could not be completely eradicated, at least the Empress Dowager's condition was temporarily stabilized, and her life was out of danger.

"The Empress Dowager's breathing has steadied somewhat, and her pulse is stronger than before. Your Majesty, Her Majesty's life is temporarily secure." Imperial Physician Wang wiped the sweat from his brow and reported respectfully.

Xiao Yan let out a breath of relief. Looking at the Empress Dowager's peaceful sleeping face, the anger in his heart subsided slightly.

[Mother is safe for the moment. Thank goodness. Shen Qinghuan... she has rendered a massive service. It seems I truly wronged her.]

Consort Li and Consort De, along with other imperial consorts, had originally been kneeling nearby in trembling fear, terrified of drawing fire onto themselves. Hearing that the Empress Dowager's condition had temporarily stabilized, and learning the news that the Hall of Eternal Spring was being thoroughly investigated, they felt a complex mix of emotions.

Consort Li's inner voice:

[The Hall of Eternal Spring is being investigated! Excellent! That bitch of an Empress is finally going down! And Shen Qinghuan... this abandoned consort from the cold palace actually possesses such means? How did she know all of this? She truly is unfathomable! However, out of regard for the imperial family's face, the Emperor probably won't depose the Empress right away, but will find an excuse later. Is my opportunity finally coming?]

Consort De's inner voice:

[Once the Empress falls, the position of Crown Prince... my son's opportunity has arrived! But Shen Qinghuan... what kind of variables will her emergence bring to the inner palace? Will she also become a threat?]

The consorts harbored their own hidden agendas, but at this moment, they all deeply felt that a massive storm had completely swept through the inner palace. The fall of the Empress seemed to have become a foregone conclusion. And at the very center of this storm was the long-neglected abandoned consort of the cold palace, Shen Qinghuan.

The Cold Palace.

Shen Qinghuan lay quietly on the dilapidated wooden bed, feeling the faint undulations pulsing from the jade bracelet on her wrist, a fatigue born of energy depletion, yet the joy in her heart far outweighed the exhaustion.

She clearly "heard" everything happening far away in the Hall of Mental Cultivation and the Hall of Eternal Spring: Xiao Yan's thunderous rage, the Empress's panic, Imperial Physician Lin's confession, and the temporary stabilization of the Empress Dowager's condition.

She knew her first move had been a complete, flawless success.

With the Empress under investigation, her first wave of vengeance had found initial release. The Emperor's suspicion had likewise transformed into trust and guilt.

Yet Shen Qinghuan felt no satisfaction from this alone. She knew this was merely the beginning.

Within the Empress's inner voice, that sentence, "Xiao Yan, how dare you risk exposing the scandals from before your ascension..."; served like a massive fishhook, reminding her once more that deeper, darker secrets existed between the Empress and the Emperor, and even between the Qin clan and the imperial house.

She had a premonition that the fall of the Empress was merely the tip of the iceberg regarding the palace's inner secrets. The true game of chess was only just beginning.

Placing her hand over the jade bracelet on her wrist, her gaze grew profound.

"Xiao Yan, one day I will know all your secrets. Qin clan, your crimes certainly do not stop here either."

Outside the cold palace, the night was profound, but within Shen Qinghuan's heart, a raging fire of vengeance had ignited. She had transformed from an abandoned consort waiting to be slaughtered into a goddess of vengeance wielding a sharp blade, capable of piercing human hearts.

chapters.title: The Empress Dowager Awakens, Shen Qinghuan Gains Favor
chapters.content:
The Empress Dowager's residence, Cining Palace.

Following a night of meticulous treatment by Imperial Physician Wang, coupled with Xiao Yan sparing no expense in mobilizing the palace's rarest medicinal herbs, the Empress Dowager slowly opened her eyes at the break of morning.

Her gaze was weak yet lucid as it swept over Emperor Xiao Yan and Imperial Physician Wang waiting by the bedside.

"Mother, you're awake!" Overjoyed, Xiao Yan leaned over hurriedly, tightly clasping the Empress Dowager's hand.

The Empress Dowager coughed softly a few times, her voice hoarse and faint: "Emperor... you... have you been guarding here all night?"

"Yes, this son has guarded Mother the entire time." Xiao Yan's heart was filled with guilt and self-reproach, knowing that if not for Shen Qinghuan, his mother would likely have...

"Empress Dowager, how are you feeling?" Imperial Physician Wang stepped forward as well, inquiring cautiously.

The Empress Dowager nodded slightly: "Much better... just a bit weak and limp in the body." She felt a lingering sensation of heat deep within her body, but it was no longer the excruciating pain of a thousand ants devouring her soul.

"Empress Dowager, the poison you contracted is called 'Bone-Corroding Fragrance.' Thanks to His Majesty's brilliance in uncovering the Empress..." Realizing the glance Xiao Yan threw his way, Imperial Physician Wang immediately altered his wording, "thanks to His Majesty's brilliance in promptly uncovering Imperial Physician Lin's crimes, coupled with the... reminder from Consort Shen, we were able to temporarily control the condition."

Hearing this, a trace of confusion flashed across the Empress Dowager's eyes before clarity returned. She struggled to recall the faint, bizarre words Shen Qinghuan had spoken before she lost consciousness, regarding the pungent smell and the poisonous symptoms of total bodily ulceration. At the time, her mind had been blurred, and she had assumed it was merely Shen Qinghuan's raving nonsense. Hearing Imperial Physician Wang bring it up now, and connecting it to the torment she had suffered, everything suddenly fell into place in her mind.

"Shen Qinghuan... it was her?" the Empress Dowager murmured.

Xiao Yan nodded quickly: "Yes, Mother. If not for Qinghuan that day... this son would likely still be kept in the dark. Imperial Physician Lin has confessed; he acted under the Empress's instigation to secretly add the catalyst for 'Bone-Corroding Fragrance' into your prescription, adjusting the dosage with the intent to murder Mother and frame Qinghuan..."

Xiao Yan briefly recounted Imperial Physician Lin's confession and the evidence discovered to the Empress Dowager. Naturally, he omitted the detail of Xiao Anzi finding the evidence, attributing it entirely to his own thorough investigation. He remained unaware that Shen Qinghuan possessed the heaven-defying ability of mind-reading.

Upon hearing this, a wave of incredulous fury surged instantly across the Empress Dowager's pale face.

"The Zhao woman! That vicious harlot! How could she be so malicious?! This palace treated her well, yet she repays kindness with such enmity!" Trembling with rage, the Empress Dowager's chest heaved violently.

"Mother, calm your anger! Please preserve your imperial health!" Xiao Yan soothed hurriedly.

"Not only did she try to murder this palace, she even wanted to frame Qinghuan... That child Qinghuan... how much grievance she must have suffered at the time!" The Empress Dowager looked at Xiao Yan, her eyes filled with guilt and pity, "Emperor, this mourning mother wronged her previously! When I was gravely ill that day, my mind was muddled, and I listened to the slander of villains... How... how is she doing now?"

A warm feeling bloomed in Xiao Yan's heart; he knew the Empress Dowager genuinely cared for Shen Qinghuan.

"Mother, rest assured, Qinghuan is unharmed. This son has already sent someone to bring her here to wait upon Mother," Xiao Yan said.

He knew that allowing Shen Qinghuan to serve the Empress Dowager right now served both as restitution to her and as a legitimate justification for her return to the center of the inner palace. The Empress Dowager's favor and staunch protection carried far more weight than an imperial decree.

Before long, led by Eunuch Su, Shen Qinghuan walked slowly into Cining Palace. She retained her frail and pale appearance, yet her eyes carried a trace of firmness and poise.

"This concubine pays her respects to the Empress Dowager, and to Your Majesty," Shen Qinghuan greeted gracefully.

"Qinghuan!" The moment she saw Shen Qinghuan, a look of maternal affection and agitation burst forth in the Empress Dowager's eyes. Struggling to extend a hand, she called out, "Come quickly, let this mourning mother take a good look at you!"

Shen Qinghuan stepped forward, kneeling beside the bed, and gently placed her hand over the Empress Dowager's outstretched palm. The Empress Dowager's weak fingers, carrying a trace of chill, gently stroked Shen Qinghuan's pale cheek.

"Good child... you've suffered!" Tears welled up in the Empress Dowager's eyes, "This mourning mother is sorry for you! I was muddled! I listened to the wicked words of that Zhao woman and allowed the Emperor to banish you to the cold palace! Do you know... those few words of yours... saved this mourning mother's life!"

Shen Qinghuan lowered her eyelashes, her voice soft: "The Empress Dowager flatters this concubine; I merely overheard a bit of pharmacology by chance. If it could be of any benefit to Your Majesty, it is this concubine's good fortune."

The more humble and "ignorant" she appeared, the more it convinced the Empress Dowager and Xiao Yan of her purity and innocence, thereby throwing the Empress's wickedness into even sharper relief.

"Silly child!" The Empress Dowager gripped Shen Qinghuan's hand with increased strength. At that very moment, the Empress Dowager's fingers accidentally brushed against the cold jade bracelet on Shen Qinghuan's wrist.

The originally icy jade bracelet, the moment the Empress Dowager's fingertips touched it, unexpectedly grew slightly warm, radiating a trace of gentle, moist aura as if responding to the touch.

A hint of confusion flashed across the Empress Dowager's eyes.

[This jade bracelet... why is it somewhat warm? And it feels as though I've seen it somewhere before...]

Deep within the Empress Dowager's mind, a vague image faintly surfaced: a young girl, wearing a similar jade bracelet on her wrist, smiling brilliantly under a pear tree. But the image vanished in an instant; the Empress Dowager merely felt a sense of familiarity without being able to capture a clear memory.

Shen Qinghuan's heart skipped a beat. The bracelet's reaction caught her off guard. She didn't know what the Empress Dowager had sensed, but she knew this jade bracelet was bound to have some mysterious connection to her own background, the Empress Dowager, and even the imperial family. This only solidified her determination to uncover the secrets of the jade bracelet.

"Qinghuan, stay in Cining Palace to wait upon me for the time being. This mourning mother cannot do without you by my side." The Empress Dowager looked toward Xiao Yan, her eyes full of entreaty, "Emperor, these past few days my health has grown increasingly frail; I cannot be without this child to tend to me. She has also suffered grievances; keeping her by my side allows me to personally guide her."

Naturally, Xiao Yan understood the Empress Dowager's intention. This meant Shen Qinghuan would openly and honorably leave the cold palace and return to the center of power.

"Mother speaks rightly. It is Qinghuan's fortune to be able to serve Mother. This son will naturally comply with Mother's decree." Xiao Yan looked at Shen Qinghuan, a complex emotion in his eyes.

[Qinghuan... she has achieved a great merit this time. Mother is also willing to protect her. Now that she is out of the cold palace, her status will no longer be what it once was. Only... is she truly the innocent Shen Qinghuan? Those eyes... seem to conceal many things I cannot see through.]

Shen Qinghuan gave an internal, cold smile. Xiao Yan, oh Xiao Yan, are you only starting to doubt now? Pity, it is far too late.

She bowed in salute: "Thank you, Empress Dowager, for your boundless grace. Thank you, Your Majesty."

chapters.title: Restoring Noble Consort Rank, Bestowed the Residence of Tangli Palace
chapters.content:
The Cining Palace was warm and peaceful, the atmosphere filled with the joy of the Empress Dowager and Shen Qinghuan's reunion. However, this serenity was soon broken by an imperial decree announcement.

"The imperial decree has arrived!" Eunuch Su's shrill voice echoed from outside the hall, carrying its customary authority.

A sharp glint flashed in Xiao Yan's eyes upon hearing this. He knew this was the optimal opportunity for him to smoothly go with the current, officially rescue Shen Qinghuan from the Cold Palace, and bestow upon her a legitimate status.

"Qinghuan, receive the decree!" Xiao Yan personally supported the Empress Dowager and signaled for Shen Qinghuan to kneel.

Shen Qinghuan knelt as instructed, though her heart was secretly on guard. She knew this decree was by no means a simple superficial favor.

Eunuch Su unfolded the bright yellow imperial decree and read aloud in a ringing voice:

"By the grace of Heaven, the Emperor decrees: Noble Lady Shen of the Consort rank, having suffered false accusations and entered the Cold Palace, endured many trials. Yet her nature is pure and virtuous, benevolent, filial, and respectful. During the Empress Dowager's serious illness, she served with utmost loyalty and offered meritorious advice, truly serving as a model for palace consorts. Remembering the bitterness of her wrongful suffering, she is specially pardoned from her crimes in the Cold Palace, her rank as a consort is restored, and she is bestowed the residence of Tangli Palace. Let this be known!"

With the reading finished, Eunuch Su handed the imperial decree to Shen Qinghuan.

"Imperial Consort Shen, congratulations!" A trace of complexity laced Eunuch Su's tone. He knew very well that the "Imperial Consort Shen" before him was no longer the former Consort Shen who could be easily manipulated at will.

Shen Qinghuan accepted the imperial decree with unruffled composure.

The Empress Dowager looked at the decree, a trace of dissatisfaction flashing in her eyes.

[This child of an emperor is far too petty! Qinghuan saved my life and suffered such a great injustice; restoring her to a consort rank would have been fitting, so why downgrade her to an imperial concubine? Still... well, having just emerged from the Cold Palace, her rank shouldn't be too high to avoid drawing jealousy and hatred, and it also gives her time to slowly adapt. Although Tangli Palace is secluded, it is quiet and independent, which suits Qinghuan well for recuperating her energy.]

Xiao Yan whispered in the Empress Dowager's ear, "Imperial Mother, do not be anxious. Qinghuan has just come out of the Cold Palace, and too high a rank easily invites envy. The concubine rank is only temporary; once her health recovers, we can slowly elevate her."

He turned his gaze toward Shen Qinghuan, deep thought in his eyes.

[Shen Qinghuan... this jade bracelet of yours, what secrets are truly hidden in your thoughts? I am placing you in Tangli Palace both to set Imperial Mother's mind at ease and to make it convenient for me to observe you in secret. Tangli Palace has a unique geographical location, backed by the rear mountain, its connection to the outer perimeter of the imperial palace is secluded, yet it is not too far from Imperial Mother's Cining Palace, making it convenient for her to visit Imperial Mother. Though it seems remote, it is actually the most suitable place to recuperate and prepare, and it also facilitates... certain arrangements of mine.]

Shen Qinghuan sneered inwardly. Xiao Yan truly was a suspicious emperor. He wanted to use her to keep the Empress in check while also suppressing her through a "demotion," achieving certain surveillance or exploitative goals through the location of "Tangli Palace."

Yet she did not care. What she wanted was not empty fame, but real power.

"This concubine thanks Your Majesty for your boundless grace, and thanks Her Majesty the Empress Dowager." Shen Qinghuan bowed respectfully.

Tangli Palace.

Led by Eunuch Su, Shen Qinghuan arrived at her new residence.

Tangli Palace was situated in the northeast corner of the inner court, far from the clustered front halls of the other consorts. Surrounded by a dense forest of pear trees, it indeed appeared quite secluded and remote. Although the palace was not as lavish and magnificent as the Hall of Everlasting Spring, it was a thousand times better than the dilapidated rooms of the Cold Palace. The interior was elegantly decorated; though somewhat aged, everything was cleaned meticulously, evidently having undergone hasty repairs.

"Imperial Consort Shen, this is your Tangli Palace. His Majesty specially ordered the Imperial Household Department to renovate it overnight. Do you find it satisfactory?" Eunuch Su asked with a beaming smile.

Shen Qinghuan looked around her surroundings. Though the palace was not large, it featured an independent courtyard, complete with a main hall, side halls, and wing rooms. What satisfied her most was a small door at the back of the courtyard, which seemed to lead deeper into the pear forest. Beyond the pear forest, as she had once heard idle court servants gossip, it connected to the rear mountain. This geographical location planted the seeds of a plan in her mind.

"You have worked hard, Eunuch Su." Shen Qinghuan smiled faintly.

She "heard" Eunuch Su's inner thoughts:

[This Imperial Consort Shen is truly unfathomable. Having just emerged from the Cold Palace and facing such arrangements by His Majesty, she remains utterly expressionless and composed. Her future is likely boundless. It seems I must curry some favor with her.]

Shen Qinghuan understood the situation clearly. Eunuch Su was a pragmatic fence-sitter, but he was also an important set of eyes and ears close to the Emperor. She needed to make use of him for her own purposes.

"Eunuch Su must be exhausted from the journey. Here are some pastries; please have a taste, Eunuch." Shen Qinghuan signaled Nanny Wang beside her to hand the prepared snacks and a small ingot of silver to Eunuch Su.

Eunuch Su's eyes lit up as he quickly accepted them. "Oh my, Imperial Consort Shen is far too polite! This servant does not deserve this!" Yet his hands accepted the items with lightning speed.

"You flatter yourself, Eunuch. I ask for your kind care and support in the future," Shen Qinghuan said.

"Naturally! Naturally!" Eunuch Su smiled so broadly his eyes vanished, mentally calculating how to report Shen Qinghuan's "sensibleness" and "gentleness" back to the Emperor.

After Eunuch Su departed, Shen Qinghuan, accompanied by Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li, thoroughly inspected Tangli Palace.

"Mama, Eunuch, although this place is remote, its greatest virtue is the quiet. From this day forward, we shall make our proper plans here," Shen Qinghuan said with a solemn tone. "Every blade of grass, every tree, every brick and tile here could potentially be an eye and ear of the Emperor. You must exercise the utmost caution and vigilance, and show not the slightest anomaly."

"This maid (this servant) obeys!" Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li hastily acknowledged.

Shen Qinghuan walked to the back courtyard and pushed open the small door leading into the pear forest. Beyond the door was a quiet path winding into the depths. Shaded by lush trees and untrodden by people, it was indeed a secluded place.

[By placing me here, besides surveillance, the Emperor probably intends to keep me 'quiet.'] Shen Qinghuan thought, [Yet he never expected that this remote place would make it even easier for me to move.]

She took a deep breath, inhaling the fresh air within the pear forest.

The nightmare of the Cold Palace was past, but the path of revenge had only just begun. The Emperor's checks and balances, the Empress's conspiracies, the undercurrents of the inner court; these would all be the challenges she must face next.

At this moment, however, she was no longer that Consort Shen who could be slaughtered at will. Armed with mind-reading abilities, harboring the secret of the jade bracelet, possessing the protection of the Empress Dowager, and now owning her independent residence, she was fully equipped.

Tangli Palace would be the starting point of her resurgence, and the center from which she would weave a massive intelligence network of inner thoughts.

She knew she would step out from here, step by step, to control the entire inner court, and perhaps even the entire world.

chapters.title: Settling into Tangli Palace, Sweeping Away Spies
chapters.content:
After Eunuch Su left, Tangli Palace appeared exceptionally quiet and secluded. Shen Qinghuan did not rush to arrange her bedchamber; instead, she instructed Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li to first sort out the daily necessities. As for herself, she leisurely strolled around the inside and outside of the palace, seemingly admiring the scenery at will, while her mind was actually completely immersed in the abilities of the jade bracelet, beginning a comprehensive "thought-scan" of her new residence.

More than a dozen palace maids and eunuchs sent by the Imperial Household Department were currently tending to their respective duties, busily moving newly delivered items. Shen Qinghuan's gaze swept over them carelessly, and a chaotic wave of inner thoughts immediately flooded into her mind.

[This Tangli Palace is truly remote, and the pickings are lean. If I had known, I should have gone to serve Imperial Noble Consort Li instead.] This was the internal grumbling of a young eunuch, full of complaints.

[This Imperial Consort Shen looks like a sickly ghost, how long can she live? Over at the Empress's side...] This was the thought of a palace maid, laden with disdain and probing intent.

Shen Qinghuan remained expressionless. She knew that among these newcomers, not all of them could be innocent. The Empress, and even the Emperor, would plant their own spies here.

She concentrated her mental energy, beginning a deeper level of screening.

"Xiaotao, place that vase over there on the windowsill," Shen Qinghuan softly instructed a palace maid who was wiping a table.

[This vase is so vulgar, Imperial Consort Shen's taste is truly terrible. However... Her Majesty the Empress instructed me to keep a close eye on her movements during the Hour of Mao (5 to 7 AM) and the Hour of Zi (11 PM, 1 AM), especially that jade bracelet on her wrist...]

A chill ran through Shen Qinghuan's heart. This palace maid named Xiaotao was undoubtedly a plant placed by the Empress. Furthermore, the Empress seemed to hold an unusual level of attention toward the jade bracelet on her wrist.

"Xiaodezi, go sweep up the fallen leaves in the courtyard," Shen Qinghuan instructed another young eunuch busy in the courtyard.

[This chore is so exhausting. When I went to deliver things to the Hall of Everlasting Spring last time, I heard Steward Wang say the Empress has been in a terrible temper lately, and Imperial Physician Lin was dragged out and beaten half to death... Fortunately, I'm just a nobody, no one will notice me.]

This Xiaodezi was merely an ordinary servant; apart from complaints, his inner thoughts carried no malicious intent. Shen Qinghuan marked him as "harmless."

She walked past every servant, carefully distinguishing their thoughts.

The Empress's Spies:

Xiaotao (Palace Maid): Her inner thoughts explicitly mentioned "Her Majesty the Empress instructed," "keep a close eye on the movements during Mao and Zi hours," and "the jade bracelet on her wrist." She was a primary surveillance target.

Liuzhi (Palace Maid): Complained internally that Shen Qinghuan wasn't as generous as the Empress, privately gossiping about Shen Qinghuan's "odd habits" with other servants and plotting how to claim credit from the Empress.

Old Geng (Sweeping Eunuch): Mentioned "silver given by the Qin family steward" internally, plotting to report any slight movement in Tangli Palace back to the Hall of Everlasting Spring.

The Emperor's Spies (or ordinary Imperial Household Department spies with low loyalty):

Xiaoliu (Errand Eunuch): Mentions internally that "Eunuch Su instructed me to observe Imperial Consort Shen's words and actions more closely," but his thoughts are mostly filled with a desire for financial perks and fantasies of rising high. Low loyalty; can be turned.

Dongmei (Senior Maid): Carries a trace of vigilance and observation, but without explicitly mentioning who sent her, only stating that "His Majesty sent her to serve Imperial Consort Shen well" and observing whether she behaves herself. Relatively neutral; can be won over.

Ordinary Servants (Simple inner thoughts, concerned only with survival):

Most of the remaining maids and eunuchs harbored ordinary thoughts such as complaining about hard work, desiring rewards, or missing family members, with no ill intentions.

Shen Qinghuan formed a clear classification of these servants in her mind. She knew that directly purging these spies was a poor strategy, as the Empress and Emperor would immediately send replacements, merely alerting the enemy. The smartest approach was to turn them around and use them to her own advantage.

She cast her gaze toward Xiaotao. Since the Empress was paying attention to her "special habits" and the jade bracelet, perhaps she could use this maid to deduce certain clues in reverse.

As night fell, the busyness of Tangli Palace gradually subsided. Shen Qinghuan set up a small banquet in the side hall, summoning all the palace maids and eunuchs.

"Everyone, you've worked hard today." Shen Qinghuan raised her teacup, her tone gentle yet weary. "This concubine has just emerged from the Cold Palace, my body has yet to fully recover, and I am unfamiliar with the affairs of the court. From now on, the internal and external matters of Tangli Palace will rely upon all of you. As long as you remain loyal, this concubine will certainly not treat you poorly."

As her voice trailed off, Nanny Wang timely presented a tray holding a small pouch of silver and some fine silks.

"This is a small token of Her Ladyship's appreciation, bestowed upon you all," Nanny Wang said with a beaming smile.

Seeing the rewards, the servants immediately knelt in gratitude, their inner thoughts filled with surprise and appreciation.

[This Imperial Consort Shen is actually so generous with her spending!]

[Splendid! Finally, there are rewards! Much more generous than those aged consorts in the Cold Palace!]

However, the inner thoughts of Xiaotao and Liuzhi were mixed with a trace of disdain:

[Trying to buy us off with a little loose change? Her Majesty the Empress gives much more!]

[She's just putting on an act now; once we uncover her secrets, she's dead meat!]

Shen Qinghuan sneered inwardly. She knew these rewards were merely the first step.

"Xiaotao," Shen Qinghuan specifically called upon Xiaotao, her tone carrying a hint of intimacy. "Come here. I see your hands are deft; could you help me sort through some old items these past few days? The ones brought from the Cold Palace are somewhat disorderly."

A ripple went through Xiaotao's heart.

[Sort through old items? Is this a test of me? Perfect, this gives me a chance to observe her up close.]

"This maid obeys," Xiaotao hurried forward.

"Xiaoliu," Shen Qinghuan then looked at the young eunuch. "You are quick-witted. Starting tomorrow, you shall go to the Cining Palace every day to pay respects on my behalf, inquire about the Empress Dowager's health along the way, and then report back to me."

Xiaoliu was overjoyed.

[Go to the Cining Palace! What a plum assignment! I can gather information, run into Eunuch Su, and perhaps build some connections for a future promotion!]

"This servant obeys!" Xiaoliu eagerly accepted.

Shen Qinghuan's arrangements seemed casual, but they were actually filled with strategic depth. She kept Xiaotao by her side to facilitate close observation and control, while dispatching Xiaoliu to the Cining Palace, where he could not only check on the Empress Dowager but also unconsciously report back, even proactively providing her with intelligence.

Over the next few days, Shen Qinghuan outwardly appeared quite "frail" and "harmless." Aside from paying her daily respects to the Empress Dowager at the Cining Palace, she spent most of her time recuperating within Tangli Palace. She had Nanny Wang manage daily affairs in an orderly fashion while dedicating most of her energy to monitoring the servants' inner thoughts.

She discovered that Xiaotao was indeed very dutifully keeping watch on her.

One early morning, Shen Qinghuan deliberately rose during the Hour of Mao (5 to 7 AM), sitting by the window and exposing the jade bracelet on her wrist to the morning light. She noticed Xiaotao's peripheral vision constantly fixed upon her.

Xiaotao's inner thoughts:

[She's sitting by the window again during the Mao hour. Every time she sits here, the jade bracelet emits a faint glow. Her Majesty the Empress said I must watch whether she has special 'breathing' habits or possesses any 'strange arts.' She seems to be absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth... Could she really possess some kind of demonic magic?]

A jolt went through Shen Qinghuan's heart. The Empress actually suspected her "breathing techniques" and "strange arts," and had even noticed the faint glow of the jade bracelet! This indicated that behind the Empress, there might well be someone knowledgeable about the existence of certain extraordinary beings. This deepened Shen Qinghuan's awareness of the secret of the jade bracelet and the potential dangers it posed.

She deliberately maintained this "habit" for a few days to make Xiaotao convinced it was her routine, and then ceased to force it.

She also secretly observed Liuzhi and Old Geng. Liuzhi frequently whispered privately with Xiaotao, exchanging "intelligence" about her. Old Geng would deliberately linger for a moment in certain corners while sweeping, seemingly "reporting" something. Shen Qinghuan did not expose them, merely recording the times and locations of their reports in secret.

As for Xiaoliu and Dongmei, Shen Qinghuan adopted a policy of conciliation.

When Xiaoliu returned from the Cining Palace, she would proactively ask about the Empress Dowager's condition and occasionally reward him with small amounts of loose silver.

Xiaoliu's inner thoughts:

[Imperial Consort Shen is truly kind! Not harsh like Her Majesty the Empress. Following Imperial Consort Shen brings good rewards! Eunuch Su said Imperial Consort Shen is currently favored by the Empress Dowager; who knows, perhaps I'll rise to great prominence in the future!]

Shen Qinghuan knew Xiaoliu was already beginning to lean toward her. He would unconsciously "tell" her news from the Cining Palace and the outside world, and even some court secrets, through his inner thoughts.

Dongmei was much more cautious. Shen Qinghuan would occasionally chat idly with her, asking about inner court precedents and the preferences of various consorts, displaying a thirst for knowledge regarding palace affairs. Though Dongmei kept her distance, her inner thoughts began to reveal appreciation for Shen Qinghuan:

[Though Imperial Consort Shen is young, she is meticulous and attentive to court affairs. It seems His Majesty was right to send me here.]

Shen Qinghuan knew Dongmei was a capable maid; as long as she could demonstrate sufficient capability and prospects, Dongmei would sooner or later become her confidante.

Days passed, and Shen Qinghuan firmly established her footing in Tangli Palace. Outwardly, she was a quiet "Imperial Consort Shen" recovering from illness, but inwardly, she had already constructed a massive intelligence network through mind-reading. The spies planted by the Empress and the Emperor had now become marionettes dancing on the strings of her hands, unknowingly transmitting the most crucial information to her.

Sitting in her bedchamber within Tangli Palace, Shen Qinghuan toyed with the jade bracelet in her hand. She knew this tranquility was only temporary. The Empress's focus on her went far beyond simple sorcery and curses. The secret of the jade bracelet, the bloodline within her; these would all be her strongest trump cards in this palace struggle, as well as her most fatal weaknesses.

And she was already fully prepared to face every challenge to come.

chapters.title: Xiao Yunzi and Qingdai, Initial Confidants
chapters.content:
Under Shen Qinghuan's covert control, daily life in Liyu Palace appeared calm on the surface. Aside from offering her daily greetings at the Cining Palace, she spent her days peacefully "recovering from illness" within her own residence. Outwardly, she lived a secluded life and avoided trouble, but her ability to hear inner thoughts acted like an invisible net, gathering information from all over Liyu Palace and even its surrounding areas.

Among these mixed and chaotic thoughts, two voices gradually caught her attention.

One belonged to a sweeping eunuch named Xiao Yunzi. His inner voice always carried a cunning unbefitting his age and a deep dissatisfaction with palace life.

[These old bastards, pushing the dirtiest and hardest chores on me again! Hmph, just you wait until I rise in the world; I'll settle accounts with every single one of you!]

[When can I ever leave this haunted place... I heard there's a path behind the Imperial Kitchens that loops outside the palace walls... No, that's just an old wives' tale. Who would actually know the secret passages of the palace...]

Xiao Yunzi was a clever, ambitious, yet oppressed low-ranking eunuch. Shen Qinghuan judged that he longed to climb higher but lacked the opportunities and connections. Though vague, his passing thoughts about a "secret palace passage" were enough to arouse Shen Qinghuan's vigilance and curiosity.

The other voice belonged to a rough-chore maid named Qingdai. Her inner thoughts carried a sense of simplicity and forbearance.

[Imperial Consort Shen looks sickly, but she's really kind and gives out lots of rewards. Not like the other mistresses, who resort to beating and scolding at the drop of a hat.]

[The Concubine's complexion is still not very good. If only she could use some blood-circulating and stasis-dissolving herbs, like motherwort or angelica... Too bad I'm just a menial maid; nobody would listen to me anyway.]

Qingdai was a loyal, honest, and kind-hearted maid. She held a deep awe for palace life, yet lacked opportunities due to her humble origins. Her thoughts repeatedly mentioned ordinary folk herbs, suggesting a basic understanding of pharmacology, which piqued Shen Qinghuan's interest.

Shen Qinghuan decided to start with these two individuals to cultivate her first batch of confidants.

---

Winning over Xiao Yunzi:

One afternoon, as Shen Qinghuan was taking a stroll in the courtyard, she happened to see Xiao Yunzi being ordered by several senior eunuchs to carry heavy stone basins. He was panting heavily, his face drained of color, while the nearby eunuchs occasionally mocked him.

[Serves this dead Yunzi right! Who told him to have a sharp tongue and not know how to flatter his betters?]

[Hmph, let's see if I don't go report him for slacking off the moment he drops that load!]

Shen Qinghuan sneered inwardly. She signaled Nanny Wang: "Nanny Wang, go see if Xiao Yunzi is feeling unwell. If he is, let him rest. How can they make a single person bear such heavy work?"

Catching Shen Qinghuan's cue, Nanny Wang immediately understood. She stepped forward and scolded, "You old good-for-nothings! How could you push such heavy labor onto Xiao Yunzi? He is a person from Imperial Consort Shen's palace. Can you afford the consequences if he gets worked to exhaustion?!"

Hearing the phrase "a person from Imperial Consort Shen's palace" and noticing Nanny Wang's grim expression, the eunuchs turned pale with fright. They hurriedly apologized and scrambled forward to help.

Xiao Yunzi looked at Shen Qinghuan with gratitude, his mind filled with shock and moving emotion:

[Imperial Consort Shen actually spoke up for me? She... she's helping me! That's wonderful! Finally, someone is willing to help me!]

By twilight, Shen Qinghuan summoned Xiao Yunzi to the side hall.

"Xiao Yunzi, are you feeling better?" Shen Qinghuan asked gently, handing him a cup of hot tea.

Flustered and grateful, Xiao Yunzi immediately dropped to his knees: "Thank you for your concern, Your Ladyship. This servant is much better."

"I see that you are a clever and diligent boy. However, there are many rules in this palace. If you wish to establish yourself, you must learn to read the room and know when to advance or retreat." Shen Qinghuan changed the subject, her tone carrying a hint of deep meaning. "I bailed you out today, but do you know what would happen in the future without my protection?"

Xiao Yunzi trembled with fright, his inner voice filled with terror:

[The Concubine is warning me! I understand! She wants my loyalty! Yes! Only by following her can I ever hope to rise up!]

"This servant understands! From now on, this servant will be utterly loyal to Your Ladyship, through fire and water!" Xiao Yunzi kowtowed repeatedly.

Shen Qinghuan nodded with satisfaction.

"I am busy with matters on ordinary days, and it is inconvenient for some of my eyes and ears to show themselves. Seeing that you are sharp, I want you to handle some private matters for me. Are you willing?"

Joy surged wildly in Xiao Yunzi's heart; he knew Shen Qinghuan was offering him a chance.

[Wonderful! I finally have an errand! This means Her Ladyship trusts me! I must perform well and seize this opportunity!]

"This servant is willing! This servant will not shrink from death!" Xiao Yunzi's voice trembled with excitement.

"Very good." Shen Qinghuan's lips curled slightly. "Remember, whatever tasks I entrust to you must be kept strictly confidential. Do not reveal even half a word to anyone. Otherwise, I have plenty of ways to make you wish you were dead."

This combination of grace and severity completely subdued Xiao Yunzi. He knew that Shen Qinghuan might look gentle, but her methods were ruthless. He felt both the joy of being valued and the weight of intimidation.

---

Winning over Qingdai:

Shen Qinghuan then shifted her focus to Qingdai. She assigned Qingdai to manage her daily medicinal soups and simple herbal incense.

One day, Shen Qinghuan deliberately put on a weak display, coughing softly.

Qingdai's inner voice:

[Her Ladyship's complexion is so poor, her face pale, and her pulse floating... These are symptoms of dual deficiency of Qi and blood. If she could drink some Danshen and Astragalus root soaked in water, and use mugwort for fumigation, she would feel much better. But... as a menial maid, how could I dare speak out of turn?]

Hearing these thoughts, Shen Qinghuan's heart stirred. She wasn't truly suffering from a deficiency of Qi and blood, but Qingdai's intuition and judgment regarding pharmacology deepened her interest in this maid.

"Qingdai," Shen Qinghuan called out, her voice tinged with a hint of frailty, "I've been feeling rather fatigued lately. Do you know of any folk remedies to help perk me up?"

Hearing this, Qingdai's body shuddered as she hesitated for a moment.

[Is Her Ladyship asking me? Can I... can I speak? Will I be considered to have overstepped the rules?]

Though she struggled internally, the memory of Shen Qinghuan's kindness and trusting gaze gave her the courage to speak.

"Replying to Your Ladyship, this servant... this servant knows of some ordinary herbs that might benefit Your Ladyship. For instance, soaking Danshen and Astragalus in water can invigorate blood and replenish Qi; burning mugwort in the room helps calm the mind and dispel the cold..." Qingdai spoke cautiously, her speed increasing as a light gleamed in her eyes, as if the floodgates of her knowledge had been opened.

Listening to her, Shen Qinghuan showed pleasant surprise: "Oh? You actually understand these things? Well said! I have never even heard of such methods. Go ahead and try it. If it works, I will reward you handsomely."

Overjoyed, Qingdai's mind overflowed with the thrill of validation:

[Her Ladyship is actually letting me try! That's wonderful! I can finally do something useful! This is Her Ladyship giving me a chance!]

"This servant obeys!" Qingdai hurriedly withdrew, full of vigor as she went to prepare the herbs.

A few days later, Qingdai carefully brewed the Danshen and Astragalus tea for Shen Qinghuan and perfumed the room with mugwort. Although Shen Qinghuan knew her health was fine, she deliberately put on a show of recovery, lavishing Qingdai with praise, silver, and fabrics.

"Qingdai, you truly are clever. Seeing that you have quite a grasp of these herbs, I will leave my daily recuperation in your hands from now on. Speak freely if you have any insights," Shen Qinghuan said, her tone laden with trust and promotion.

Flustered and moved to tears, Qingdai felt overwhelmed.

[Her Ladyship... she really trusts me! She treats me as an important person! I must serve Her Ladyship well and repay her kindness!]

"This servant will not fail Your Ladyship's trust. I swear my allegiance to the death!" Qingdai knelt, her voice resolute.

Shen Qinghuan knew that Qingdai's loyalty stemmed from her innate kindness and sincerity. Once someone like her chose a master, they would remain blindly dedicated. Though her herbal knowledge was simple, in the palace, it might play an unexpected role at a critical moment.

The cultivation of her initial confidants was complete.

By this point, Shen Qinghuan had Nanny Wang and Eunuch Li acting as "stewards" in Liyu Palace, alongside Xiao Yunzi and Qingdai serving as her "eyes, ears, and assistants." Xiao Yunzi was clever, adept at gathering intelligence, and possessed an extraordinary "yearoning" for secret palace passages, which might provide clues for exploring palace secrets in the future. Qingdai was honest with a basic understanding of folk herbs, which could prove useful in recognizing and detoxifying poisons down the road.

Shen Qinghuan knew very well that fighting alone in the treacherous inner court was a dead end. Having loyal and reliable confidants was the key to her foothold and counterattack.

Looking at her confidants bustling about Liyu Palace, a shred of warmth rose in Shen Qinghuan's heart. This warmth did not stem from the satisfaction of power, but from the connection of being needed and trusted. She knew she was no longer alone on this path of revenge. And Liyu Palace would become the true starting point where she wove a massive web of intelligence derived from inner thoughts, using it to take total control of the board.

chapters.title: Imperial Consort Li's Provocation, Verbal Counterattack
chapters.content:
Although Shen Qinghuan had only reclaimed the rank of an imperial concubine and moved into Liyu Palace as a "Pin," her sudden leap from a discarded consort in the Cold Palace was enough to cause ripples throughout the inner court. Especially against the backdrop of the Empress Dowager waking up and the Empress being investigated, Shen Qinghuan, the "meritorious hero," had become the center of attention.

Yet, some rejoiced while others worried. In the harem, the slightest disturbance could touch a sensitive nerve. Among them, Imperial Consort Li was the first one who couldn't sit still.

Imperial Consort Li, named Lin Wanrou, came from the prestigious Lin family. She possessed gorgeous looks, an arrogant disposition, and relied on the Empress's favor to run amok in the harem. She had always looked down upon Shen Qinghuan, believing her humble background could never compare. Seeing that Shen Qinghuan not only survived the Cold Palace but fell into good fortune, winning the Empress Dowager's favor and the Emperor's grace to restore her rank, filled her with a mixture of jealousy and hatred.

That day, Shen Qinghuan headed to the Cining Palace to offer her customary greetings. Passing through the Imperial Garden, she happened to run into Imperial Consort Li parading past with a large entourage of maids and eunuchs. Clad in a magnificent goose-yellow court dress, her hair adorned with pearls and jade, Consort Li glanced around brightly, acting as though the entire Imperial Garden was her stage.

With sharp eyes, Consort Li immediately spotted Shen Qinghuan approaching calmly not far away, accompanied by Nanny Wang and Qingdai. A flash of contempt crossed her eyes; then she plastered on a fake smile and greeted her with feigned surprise.

"Oh my, if it isn't Imperial Consort Shen? Look at that complexion; truly much better than when you were in the Cold Palace!" Consort Li's tone was dripping with obvious sarcasm, her voice intentionally raised so that surrounding servants cast curious glances.

Shen Qinghuan stopped in her tracks and looked at Consort Li indifferently. She could clearly hear Consort Li's inner voice:

[This bitch actually didn't die! And she dares to swagger around! Look at that poverty-stricken look of hers; even coming out of the Cold Palace can't hide her lowly bones. Hmph, let's see how I put her in her place publicly today!]

Shen Qinghuan sneered inwardly, keeping her expression calm on the surface. She knew Consort Li wanted to use the opportunity to humiliate her publicly and make her lose face.

"Thank you for your concern, Consort Li. Thanks to the immense blessings of the Empress Dowager, Qinghuan is quite well." Shen Qinghuan's voice was calm, devoid of any ripples, as if she hadn't caught the sarcasm at all.

Seeing her so calm, Consort Li grew even more displeased.

[What is she putting on airs for? I want to see how long you can keep that up!]

"It is truly great fortune that Imperial Consort Shen could emerge from that filthy place called the Cold Palace," Consort Li sighed with feigned pity. "It's just that this palace heard the Cold Palace is extremely yin and heavy, plagued by dampness year-round, the absolute worst place for eroding the body. Imperial Consort Shen must take extra care; you wouldn't want to leave behind any lingering ailments that might affect your future childbearing."

These words were venomous in the extreme. Not only did they rub in Shen Qinghuan's Cold Palace history, but they also cursed her to "affect childbearing," arguably one of the most vicious curses in the harem. The surrounding servants changed color slightly upon hearing this, but out of fear of Consort Li's power, no one dared to speak out.

Both Nanny Wang and Qingdai were burning with anger. Nanny Wang even wanted to step forward to reason with her, but Shen Qinghuan stopped her with a single look.

Shen Qinghuan's gaze fell upon Consort Li, an imperceptible trace of coldness flashing in her eyes. She clearly heard Consort Li's thoughts:

[Let's see how much longer this bitch can endure! Publicly mocked by me, she must be trembling with anger inside, right? Hmph, the Empress said people like her should rot in the Cold Palace forever!]

The corners of Shen Qinghuan's lips curled into a smile that wasn't quite a smile.

"You speak too seriously, Consort Li." Shen Qinghuan spoke softly, her voice light yet every single word clear. "The Cold Palace is indeed impoverished, but hardship tempers the mind. When Qinghuan was in the Cold Palace, I practiced self-cultivation daily and realized many truths. For instance... the most poisonous thing in this world is not the dampness of the Cold Palace, but the jealousy and resentment of those who look bright and glamorous on the outside, yet possess hearts as venomous as snakes and scorpions."
